score.title: The rise and fall of the Amazon Soy Moratorium
score.summary: [背景] 亚马逊大豆禁令是一项自愿性零毁林协议，旨在遏制巴西亚马逊地区因大豆种植扩张导致的森林破坏。该协议曾是保护政策的重要案例，但近期面临挑战。[方法] 文章通过分析遥感监测的森林砍伐数据、大豆生产供应链信息及相关政策文件，评估禁令的成效与演变。[发现] 1) 禁令实施初期有效降低了与大豆直接相关的毁林率；2) 但近年来砍伐率有所回升，部分原因是大豆种植转向其他地区或规避协议；3) 法律挑战和市场压力松动削弱了禁令的执行力。[贡献] 揭示了自愿性供应链承诺的脆弱性，为完善热带森林保护政策提供实证依据。[局限] 信息不足，需查原文确认具体局限，可能包括间接土地利用变化、时间范围的选取及因果推断的挑战。[精读] 值得精读其对政策机制演变的分析及对未来保护的启示。

item.title: Food systems transformation would reshape global agriculture
item.abstract: Abstract Food systems are a major contributor to exceeding planetary boundaries 1–3 and poor quality diets are a key mortality risk globally 4 . Projected population and income growth could exacerbate these challenges 5 . In response, there are calls for transformation towards healthy and sustainable food systems 6–8 . However, the scale and distribution of the impacts of this transformation on agriculture are underexplored. Here we show that, by 2050, the transformation of food systems towards healthy diets (adoption of the EAT– Lancet reference diet), improved productivity and halving of food waste results in a fundamental restructuring of global agriculture, aspects of which break with historical trends. Scenario simulations using a multimodel ensemble of ten global economic models show a 6% median decrease in agricultural land (+1% to −26%) compared with 2020 levels. By 2050, agricultural production would be 17% lower than business-as-usual projections (−2% to −32%) and, economically, the value of this production is US$1.6 trillion (26%) lower (+8% to −58%). Within this, the value of livestock production would be substantially lower than current 2050 projections (−49% to −83%), while vegetable, fruit, nut and legume production value would increase by 23% (−33% to +106%). Results are dependent on the assumed policies to achieve the transformation scenario. We highlight a more active role for food policy to consider the benefits of such a transformation (improved population health and reduced environmental pressures) and navigate the political economy of its impacts.

score.title: Highly fragmented European wetlands with uneven restoration needs
score.summary: [背景] 湿地提供重要的生态系统服务，但面临农业扩张、城市化等威胁，大尺度精细制图对于保护与恢复规划至关重要。以往欧洲湿地制图在类型分辨率和空间覆盖上仍不足。[方法] 利用卫星影像与机器学习方法，对欧洲国家六种半自然开放湿地类型进行空间精准制图，并量化土地利用干扰强度，评估湿地破碎化程度与恢复需求的空间格局。[发现] 1) 欧洲湿地高度破碎化，斑块面积小且分布零散；2) 不同国家与区域间湿地面临的土地利用压力差异显著；3) 恢复需求存在明显的不均衡性，部分区域亟需优先干预。[贡献] 首次在大洲尺度上提供半自然湿地类型的高分辨率空间分布与干扰图谱，为跨国湿地保护与恢复政策提供数据支持。[局限] 论文摘要信息有限，模型精度、具体湿地类型定义、数据源及时相需查原文确认。[精读] 值得关注其遥感制图方法论与机器学习分类策略，对于生态恢复空间规划有一定方法参考价值。

score.title: Plants are a powerful proxy for global tidal marsh methane fluxes
score.summary: 该研究针对潮汐沼泽甲烷排放驱动因素认知不足、传统盐度预测性能低的问题，[方法] 收集87项研究、2094个甲烷通量测量数据，采用随机森林和广义加性模型，解析植物物种、盐度、纬度及季节对全球潮汐沼泽甲烷通量的影响。[发现] 1) 植物物种是甲烷通量最重要的单因子预测变量，单独解释62%的变异性，优于传统的盐度指标；2) 结合纬度、季节和土壤盐度的多因子模型可解释71%的变异性；3) 植物功能类型也能解释54%的甲烷通量变异性；4) 多盐沼泽的甲烷排放可抵消1%至39%的碳固存，取决于植物物种和全球变暖潜能值。[贡献] 首次证实植物物种可作为全球潮汐沼泽甲烷通量的强有力简单代用指标，显著提高全球尺度甲烷排放估算准确性，助力全球碳核算。[局限] 基于已发表数据的荟萃分析，空间和植物物种覆盖度可能受现有研究限制，未考虑植物性状、土壤微生物等潜在机制。[精读] 对一般生态研究有参考价值，但与用户当前核心课题无关，无需精读。

item.title: Plants are a powerful proxy for global tidal marsh methane fluxes
item.abstract: Methane (CH 4 ) emissions can reduce the climate benefits of tidal marshes. Yet the drivers of tidal marsh CH 4 emissions remain poorly quantified, and salinity, the most well-established proxy for tidal marsh CH 4 fluxes, has low predictive performance. Here, we demonstrate that plant species out performs salinity as a single predictor of global tidal marsh CH 4 fluxes, providing a powerful and simple predictor on its own. A multiproxy approach combining plant species with other predictors (i.e., latitude, salinity, season) further improves predictions of global CH 4 fluxes. For our analysis, we compiled 87 studies with 2,094 mean measurements of CH 4 fluxes and used random forest and generalized additive modeling to investigate the relationship among CH 4 fluxes, salinity, and plants. We found that plant species was the most important predictor of CH 4 fluxes globally. Our model of plant species alone explained 62% of the variability in CH 4 fluxes and when including latitude, season, and soil salinity, explained 71%. We also developed a model with plant functional type for when plant species flux data are not available. We found that plant functional type alone explained 54% of the variability in CH 4 fluxes, underscoring the influential role of plants. Previously, polyhaline marshes were thought to have low CH 4 emissions. Here we show that CH 4 fluxes from these marshes offset between 1% and 39% of carbon sequestration, depending on the plant species present and selected global warming potential value. This plant species-based approach significantly improves global CH 4 flux estimates in tidal marshes and facilitates global carbon accounting.

item.title: N -(3-methylbutyl)acetamide mediates male–male courtship in Bactrocera dorsalis through behavioral threshold modulation
item.abstract: Male–male courtship, observed across diverse taxa, is often regarded as an evolutionary paradox. Here, we address this paradox by demonstrating that such behavior in the globally invasive pest Bactrocera dorsalis arises as a byproduct of a context-dependent shift in the mating filter. We identify N -(3-methylbutyl)acetamide (MBA) as a critical signal that accumulates under high male density and female scarcity. At a threshold amount (~ 1,800 ng), MBA broadens the male’s mating filter, lowering the acceptance threshold for potential partners, thereby elevating courtship motivation and inducing hyperactivity. This broadened filter enables males to court suboptimal but potentially available females (e.g., mated or older individuals) that would otherwise be ignored, while also incidentally triggering male–male courtship. This behavioral shift is rapidly reversible upon encounter with virgin and young females, preserving an innate preference for these optimal partners. By identifying MBA as a chemical signal of mate unavailability, we reinterpret male–male courtship as a neutral byproduct of an adjustment of the mating filter under female scarcity, a trade-off between maximizing mating opportunities and accepting the incidental cost of misdirected courtship. This work bridges behavioral ecology with physiology, offering a mechanistic framework for how social environments dynamically reshape mate acceptance thresholds.

item.title: Dielectric levitation optical tweezers for powerful mesoscale biomanipulation
item.abstract: Optical tweezers (OT), a cornerstone of micromanipulation, are fundamentally constrained by substrate-induced adhesion and friction, limiting their application to mesoscale objects and fragile biological specimens where overcoming these resistive forces requires physiologically damaging laser powers. Here, we overcome this long-standing challenge by introducing dielectric levitation optical tweezers (DL-OT), a multiphysics platform that seamlessly integrates alternating-current dielectric levitation with optical traps. By using negative dielectrophoresis (n-DEP) to actively neutralize the normal force, DL-OT eliminates solid – solid contact and near-wall viscous drag. Crucially, we demonstrate the fundamental superiority of this active physical levitation over traditional passive antiadhesion coatings. This physical decoupling enables the smooth translation of large biological samples using low, biologically safe optical powers (~15 mW) rather than nonviable levels (>150 mW). The creation of this frictionless environment not only boosts the maximum manipulation speed of standard microtargets by 40% but also enables the stable optical transport of previously intractable mesoscale objects (100 to 260 μm), including microgears and shrimp eggs. By preventing photothermal damage and mechanical deformation, DL-OT demonstrates very good biocompatibility, significantly enhancing cell viability postmanipulation. Building upon these advantages, we demonstrate advanced on-chip biofabrication protocols through the targeted, high-precision assembly of multicellular spheroids and the safe transport of patient-derived organoids, followed by their success in situ culture. By transforming OT from a microscale tool into a mesoscale assembly platform, DL-OT paves the way for breakthroughs in tissue engineering, regenerative medicine, and the bottom – up assembly of living systems.

item.title: Spatiotemporally controlled matrix softening facilitates deterministic crypt formation in human intestinal organoids
item.abstract: Spatially controlling morphogenesis is a challenge for many organoid systems that manifests as a limited understanding of self-organization of differentiating cells and leads to a high degree of heterogeneity in organoid morphometrics. Current methods to grow organoids rely on temporal presentation of soluble cues that are not controllably delivered, and little is known about the role of the extracellular microenvironment in this process. Here, we present a material-based strategy to spatiotemporally control morphogenesis of human intestinal organoids (HIOs) with predictable crypt morphometrics and cell composition that match their in vivo tissue counterparts. We first optimize culture conditions to generate more reproducible HIOs with predictable growth in phototunable poly (ethylene glycol)-based hydrogels, and then systematically investigate the role of light-mediated matrix softening in guiding crypt formation. The light dose delivered to crypt-sized regions adjacent to growing organoids is a key factor in maintaining organoid cell viability, as well as crypt budding and elongation. With optimized light doses, predictable epithelial shape changes result in programmable crypt formation, confirmed by the presence of proliferative (Ki67+) and niche-defining Paneth (Lyz+) cells. This methodology could be readily adopted for other budding and branching organoids to facilitate controllable changes in morphogenesis or cell migration. Sequential patterning approaches and more complex pattern designs could further open the parameter space to facilitate modeling of a wide array of engineered tissues for applications ranging from fundamental biology to disease modeling and translational medicine.

item.title: Compensation and colonization offset the impacts of biodiversity loss over time in grasslands
item.abstract: The biodiversity–productivity relationship (BPR) is crucial for understanding the consequences of biodiversity loss; yet, how this relationship evolves over time in natural ecosystems remains unclear. Several long-term biodiversity experiments with artificially assembled communities suggest that the BPR escalates over time, however, whether this pattern applies to natural ecosystems has not been explored. Here, we present the results of a 15-y removal experiment in the Inner Mongolia grassland, where gradients of plant functional group (PFG) richness and species richness were created through targeted removals from 2006–2009, followed by natural recolonization from 2010 onward. We found that both the PFG richness-based and species richness-based BPRs diminished gradually during the removal period (years 2–4) and decoupled in 9 out of 12 y after the cessation of removal (years 5–16), suggesting that the negative impacts of biodiversity loss do not necessarily escalate over time; rather, they may decrease. We identified that the temporal shift in BPRs resulted first from compensatory growth of remaining species and subsequently from new colonization by external populations. These results highlight that the impacts of biodiversity loss in natural ecosystems are strongly modified by assembly processes such as compensation and colonization. Therefore, models predicting the ecosystem consequences of biodiversity loss should consider these mechanisms. Ignoring them may lead to an overestimation of the long-term impacts of biodiversity loss in natural communities, particularly where surrounding landscapes harbor species pools capable of recolonization.

score.summary: [背景] 浮游植物向水中释放多种化学物质，在其周围形成藻际（phycosphere）微环境。传统上认为藻际内的化学梯度由理想扩散决定，但缺乏直接、微米级的实验测量来验证。[方法] 该研究利用拉曼显微光谱技术，原位测量了不同物种（半径2.5–60 µm）的单个浮游植物细胞周围岩藻黄质（fucoxanthin）的浓度分布，并基于空间依赖扩散系数模型解释了非理想扩散现象。[发现] 1) 岩藻黄质浓度随离细胞距离的增加下降比理想扩散预测的更快，表明扩散受非理想因素（如粘度、溶解度梯度）影响。2) 提出“洋葱状”藻际结构模型：小型亲水性溶质遵循理想扩散形成宽广而微弱的梯度，而不溶性化合物则被局限在细胞表面10–20 µm范围内，形成陡峭的有机物梯度。3) 实验证据表明岩藻黄质可作为海洋细菌的有效化学引诱剂，突显了这些局部化学线索对微生物互作的潜在深远影响。[贡献] 首次在微米尺度下直接测量并证实了藻际化学梯度的非理想特征，挑战了经典理想扩散假说，为微生物生态学提供了新的机理解释。[局限] 研究仅限于一种代谢物（岩藻黄质）和有限的浮游植物种类，通用性待扩展；微环境物理化学因素（如湍流）的影响未纳入。信息不足，需查原文确认。[精读] 建议关注方法学部分：拉曼显微光谱在单细胞水平上的应用细节，以及空间扩散模型的构建与验证。

item.title: Raman imaging of the phycosphere reveals sharp gradients of organic matter exuded by single phytoplankton cells
item.abstract: Phytoplankton cells exude a wide array of chemicals in the water column, generating a localized microenvironment known as the phycosphere. Although it is now well accepted that the phycosphere mediates interactions between phytoplankton and bacteria, the chemical gradients around individual phytoplankton cells have never been explicitly measured, and their shape has been classically assumed to be set by ideal diffusion. Here we used Raman microspectroscopy to obtain micrometer-scale measurements of the concentration profile of a phytoplankton metabolite (fucoxanthin) around individual phytoplankton cells of different species, having radii between 2.5 and 60 μ m. We found that fucoxanthin concentration decreases more rapidly with distance from the cell than predicted by ideal diffusion, showing that the phycosphere includes compounds whose diffusion is characterized by nonideal effects. We explain this observation using a space-dependent diffusivity model where nonideality arises from viscosity and solubility gradients in the extracellular environment. Our results suggest an onion-structured model of the phycosphere, in which small hydrophilic solutes that obey ideal diffusion generate broad but weak gradients, whereas insoluble compounds are retained within 10 to 20 μ from the phytoplankton cell surface and yield steep gradients of organic matter. These observations, supported by evidence that fucoxanthin can act as an effective chemoattractant for marine bacteria, show the existence of strong and highly localized chemical cues with potentially far-reaching impacts on microbial interactions in aquatic environments. These findings highlight the importance of directly measuring the microscale chemical landscape experienced by marine microbes.

item.title: Experimental drought drives divergent succession of soil microbiota
item.abstract: As droughts become increasingly severe and prolonged worldwide, understanding how belowground biodiversity changes over time under water limitation is critical for assessing ecosystem resilience. However, long-term and continuous observations of soil microbial responses to drought remain rare. Here, using a 6-y experimental drought in a tallgrass prairie ecosystem, we showed that experimental drought reshaped the community compositions of soil bacteria, fungi, and protists, accompanied by progressive declines in microbial diversity and biomass. Analyses of time–decay relationships and paired community differences between drought and ambient conditions revealed increasingly divergent successional trajectories of soil microbiota under drought. Although stochastic processes dominated community assembly overall, their relative importance declined over time, particularly for bacteria in drought-treated soils, suggesting increasingly strong deterministic environmental filtering imposed by drought. In addition, drought reduced microbial network size but increased the complexity and stability of bacterial networks by favoring drought-tolerant taxa. Furthermore, drought-driven shifts in microbial community compositions significantly altered functional genes and associated ecosystem functioning. These findings suggest that microbial communities may become less variable but more vulnerable, and the detrimental effects of biodiversity loss on ecosystems could be more severe in an increasingly drought-prone world.

item.title: Fusarium oxysporum –induced ABA signaling triggers root vascular remodeling for plant defense
item.abstract: Root vascular pathogens like Fusarium oxysporum (Fo) severely impact agriculture by colonizing the xylem, thereby disrupting the transport of water, nutrients, and signaling molecules within host plants. However, their effects on root growth and vascular development before xylem invasion, and the underlying molecular mechanisms, remain poorly understood. Here, we show that Fo triggers a rapid, systemic, abscisic acid (ABA) that seems to induce a developmental reprogramming in Arabidopsis that occurs prior to vascular colonization. This response is associated with root growth inhibition, disorganization of the root apical meristem, and alterations in xylem architecture. High-resolution imaging reveals that initial contact with Fo elevates root ABA levels, which parallels the modulation of key developmental pathways, including MIR165/PHB and VND7, which regulate vascular patterning and mediate premature xylem differentiation and remodeling. Phloem development is also affected, likely through disruption of CLE45–BAM3 signaling. Mutants impaired in endodermal ABA signaling, ELTPp:: abi1-1 , and secondary wall formation, cesa4, show constitutive elevated ABA levels, xylem defects, and enhanced resistance to Fo, suggesting that ABA-induced vascular remodeling contributes to the formation of structural barriers that limit infection. Additionally, Fo infection induces homogalacturonan demethylation in the stele, a modification associated with cell wall stiffening and reduced pathogen spread, which is constitutively observed in ELTPp:: abi1-1 . Overall, our findings reveal ABA-mediated vascular plasticity, including cell wall remodeling as a developmentally encoded root defense mechanism. They highlight how transient hormonal cues reprogram root architecture to limit pathogen invasion and suggest strategies for crop protection.

score.title: Zero-deforestation commitments in Indonesia’s palm oil sector achieve high compliance but no additionality
score.summary: [背景] 企业为应对公众压力而采用自愿性可持续采购承诺，但这类承诺的实际效果常不明确，可能仅实现供应商合规这一狭义目标，而未达成超越承诺前状况的额外性。印尼油棕行业是热带毁林的主要驱动力，评估其零毁林承诺（ZDC）的因果效应对保护政策至关重要。 [方法] 研究整合了企业ZDC实施信息、供应链联系数据及油棕特许地毁林地图，构建2018-2020年面板数据集，并使用双重差分等计量经济学方法评估ZDC对特许地毁林的因果影响。 [发现] 1) 与ZDC企业关联的特许地毁林率低，体现了高合规性；2) 然而，这些特许地在承诺前的毁林率已较低，承诺未带来显著的额外毁林减少，即没有额外性；3) 供应链复杂性可能限制企业影响供应商行为的能力，但相关数据有限。 [贡献] 首次通过细粒度供应链数据和因果推断，揭示了自愿性零毁林承诺在印尼的现实效果：虽能筛选低毁林供应商，却未能产生额外保护增益，对依赖此类承诺的保护策略提出警示。 [局限] 时间窗口较短（仅2018-2020年），长期效应未知；供应链数据覆盖率有限，可能遗漏间接供应商影响；未考虑承诺执行机制的差异。 [精读] 值得精读因果识别策略和供应链连接构建方法，但研究问题与用户当前核心方向距离较远。

item.title: Zero-deforestation commitments in Indonesia’s palm oil sector achieve high compliance but no additionality
item.abstract: In response to public pressure, companies have increasingly adopted voluntary sustainable sourcing commitments. Yet, it often remains unclear whether such commitments lead only to the narrow goal of supplier compliance, or also to the broader goal of additionality, benefits beyond what would have occurred without commitments. A company’s ability to influence its suppliers’ behavior partly depends on the complexity of supply chains, yet data on supply chain linkages are limited, inhibiting causal evaluations. Here, we evaluate the compliance and additionality of zero-deforestation commitments (ZDCs) in the Indonesian palm oil sector, a major driver of tropical deforestation. We compiled a detailed dataset that integrates information about corporate ZDC implementation, supply chain linkages, and maps of palm-driven deforestation in Indonesia. item.title: Opportunity and risk in achieving food production and conservation goals at high altitude: Evidence from the Tibetan Plateau
item.abstract: The Tibetan Plateau, the Earth’s highest and largest plateau, has a harsh environment for agriculture, and is a global biodiversity hotspot, raising the challenge of simultaneously satisfying food production and conservation goals. Currently, agriculture involves crop production on steep slopes and overgrazing, which threatens future productivity. The Tibetan Plateau is also undergoing climate change. We evaluate food production from 1990 to 2020 and use these results to model future trends and risks to food production on the Tibetan Plateau. We assess the feasibility of achieving both food production and conservation goals simultaneously under climate change scenarios. Food production increased 32.33% over three decades, providing 2,892.98 kcal d −1 cap −1 , more than enough to satisfy food self-sufficiency. Under climate change, the Tibetan Plateau will become warmer and wetter under Shared Socioeconomic Pathways (SSPs) SSP126, SSP245, and SSP585, which combined with agricultural advances (e.g., improved mechanization and irrigation), will likely result in increased yields even with a 10% reduction in cropland area—greater than the total area of all steeply sloping cropland, thereby allowing retirement of steeply sloping cropland and livestock reductions while still meeting food production goals. Meanwhile, key ecosystem services, including carbon sequestration, water retention, and habitat quality, are also projected to improve substantially. Nonetheless, the increasing frequency and severity of extreme weather events are expected to reduce food production, undermine current dietary requirements and may threaten the minimum nutritional intake required for humans.

score.summary: [背景] 冰冻圈生态系统是微生物独特栖息地，但冰川环境中细菌的进化辐射与生态适应机制尚不清楚。[方法] 本研究收集了282个Polaromonas基因组，构建泛基因组并重建进化历史，结合系统发育和比较基因组学分析，推断祖先栖息地及生境转变过程。[发现] 1) 祖先起源于冰川补给溪流，随后多次向水生和陆地生态系统扩散；2) 栖息地转变伴随显著的水平基因转移和基因丢失事件，可能是适应新环境的关键；3) 冰川环境的选择压力可能驱动了该菌属的快速分化和生态成功。[贡献] 揭示了冰冻圈对微生物多样化的塑造作用，为理解全球变化下微生物响应提供基础。[局限] 基于公开基因组数据，可能低估未培养多样性；生境转变时间尺度需进一步验证。[精读] 可重点关注其进化辐射分析方法和栖息地重建的研究设计。

item.abstract: Michoud et al. reconstruct the pangenome and evolutionary history of 282 Polaromonas genomes, predicting an ancestral origin in glacier-fed streams. item.summary: [背景] 冰冻圈生态系统是微生物独特栖息地，但冰川环境中细菌的进化辐射与生态适应机制尚不清楚。[方法] 本研究收集了282个Polaromonas基因组，构建泛基因组并重建进化历史，结合系统发育和比较基因组学分析，推断祖先栖息地及生境转变过程。[发现] 1) 祖先起源于冰川补给溪流，随后多次向水生和陆地生态系统扩散；2) 栖息地转变伴随显著的水平基因转移和基因丢失事件，可能是适应新环境的关键；3) 冰川环境的选择压力可能驱动了该菌属的快速分化和生态成功。[贡献] 揭示了冰冻圈对微生物多样化的塑造作用，为理解全球变化下微生物响应提供基础。[局限] 基于公开基因组数据，可能低估未培养多样性；生境转变时间尺度需进一步验证。[精读] 可重点关注其进化辐射分析方法和栖息地重建的研究设计。

score.title: Avian traits link divergent population responses to environmental change across North America
score.summary: [背景] 全球环境变化（如光污染、空气污染、气候变化和城市化）对生物多样性造成严重威胁，但不同物种的种群响应差异巨大，尤其是鸟类。理解哪些性状能够预测种群变化趋势，对于保护生物学至关重要。[方法] 本研究利用北美大陆尺度的长期鸟类种群监测数据（包括繁殖鸟调查和 Christmas Bird Count），结合光污染、空气质量、气候和城市化等多源环境数据，采用性状（体重、窝卵数、迁徙属性、栖息地选择等）分析和系统发育比较方法，检验性状如何调节不同环境压力下鸟类的种群趋势。[发现] 1）多种环境变化同时作用于鸟类种群，但其影响方向和强度因物种性状而异。2）光污染对多种鸟类有负面影响，尤其是小型、夜迁移物种；而气候变暖对部分北方物种有利。3）城市化和空气污染对种群的影响也表现出显著的性状依赖性，例如地面筑巢物种更易受城市化影响。4）总体而言，性状特征能够解释种群变化趋势的相当一部分变异，提示了基于性状的保护策略可行性。[贡献] 该研究首次在大尺度上系统揭示了多种环境变化与鸟类性状的交互作用，为预测未来环境变化下的物种脆弱性提供了框架，并指出了可以针对特定性状采取的保护措施。[局限] 由于数据限制，研究未能完全分离各环境因子的独立作用，且种群趋势可能受局部保护行动干扰；此外，性状数据库尚不完整，可能遗漏关键功能性状。[精读] 其方法论值得关注，特别是如何整合多源环境数据和系统发育控制，但主题与当前核心任务距离较远，可快速浏览以获得多环境胁迫集成分析的思路。

item.title: Scaling alternative proteins for net benefits
item.abstract: The rapid rise of alternative proteins is often framed as a necessary response to the environmental and ethical challenges of conventional livestock systems. Yet as these technologies scale, there is growing concern that, if poorly governed, they could reproduce many of the environmental and social shortcomings associated with industrial agriculture, from the concentration of corporate control to increasing energy demands and the further disconnection of food systems from ecosystems. In this Voices, we ask: how can the alternative protein transition be shaped to avoid repeating the mistakes of industrial agriculture?

item.title: Florida scrub-jay genomes across space and time reveal impacts of population decline and reduced gene flow
item.abstract: By analyzing genomes from 241 Florida scrub-jays across five populations and two time points, Nguyen et al. reveal substantial losses of genetic diversity and increased inbreeding following population decline and habitat fragmentation. item.title: Plant Invasions and Their Impacts Under Global Environmental Change
item.abstract: As one of the major global change factors (GCFs), plant invasions could be influenced by other GCFs, forming complex feedbacks that impact native ecosystems. This review synthesizes current knowledge on how GCFs influence nonnative plant invasions via direct effects on invasiveness and community invasibility, as well as indirect effects operating through mutualists, antagonists, and altered trophic networks. Critical research gaps involve the interactive effects of multiple GCFs (three or more), environmental variability, emerging GCFs, and systemic biases in study systems. Predictive models provide probabilistic, but still decision-relevant, forecasts of invasion risk under global change. Research priorities include multifactor and long-term experiments, explicit consideration of belowground mechanisms and trophic feedbacks, and the reformulation of invasion hypotheses within a global-change framework. These directions are critical not only for understanding nonnative plant invasions but also for managing range-shifting species in an increasingly dynamic world.

score.title: Ecological and Evolutionary Consequences of Parasitism
score.summary: [背景] 寄生是生物间负向利用的相互作用，但其影响常远超个体层面的危害，现有研究对寄生在多尺度上的生态与进化后果缺乏整合。 [方法] 本文为综述，从三个递进途径梳理文献：1）寄生引起宿主个体性状变化（形态、生理、行为、生活史）进而影响种群动态和遗传结构；2）宿主种群密度改变对群落与生态系统的级联效应；3）宿主性状变化独立地影响群落与生态系统。 [发现] 1）寄生可通过降低宿主生存率或繁殖力直接压制种群数量，也能通过改变宿主行为（如觅食、反捕食）间接影响种间关系；2）寄生效应在不同尺度上常出现不一致甚至相反的结果，如对个体有害但对种群或群落稳定有促进作用；3）案例涵盖多种宿主-寄生系统，包括动物、植物和微生物，展示了寄生在调节生态系统功能（如初级生产力、营养循环）中的角色。 [贡献] 提出分析寄生后果的多尺度框架，强调超越单一尺度的整合视角，为未来研究指明方向，尤其呼吁关注寄生在群落构建和生态系统功能中的普适机制。 [局限] 基于文献综述，未提供新数据或定量分析；案例多为动物系统，植物和微生物寄生的讨论相对薄弱；多尺度动态的预测模型尚待建立。 [精读] 若对寄生在群落和生态系统层面的间接效应感兴趣，可精读文中关于宿主性状介导的间接通路部分及未来研究方向。

item.title: Ecological and Evolutionary Consequences of Parasitism
item.abstract: Parasitism is an interaction defined by negative exploitation of one organism by another. However, the effects of parasites extend far beyond harm to a single individual. In this review, we explore three distinct pathways by which parasite effects on individual hosts translate into profound consequences at higher scales of biological organization. First, parasite-associated changes in individual host traits, including morphology, physiology, behavior, and life history, affect survival and reproduction, with consequences for host population densities and genotypic and phenotypic distributions. Second, changes in host densities affect ecological and evolutionary processes at the community and ecosystem levels. Third, changes in host traits independently affect communities and ecosystems. We illustrate each pathway using examples spanning the effects of parasites on host populations, communities, and ecosystems. This holistic approach showcases the discordant effects parasites can have across scales. We conclude with a discussion of open research questions, highlighting opportunities for studying the consequences of parasitism as a multiscale phenomenon.

item.title: Carrion ecology: concepts, interdisciplinary synthesis, and perspectives
item.abstract: ABSTRACT Carrion is a ubiquitous resource in both terrestrial and aquatic ecosystems, yet it has long been overlooked in ecological research. Over the past two decades, studies on carrion and the many organisms that exploit it have flourished, revealing not only wide‐ranging ecological functions but also significance far beyond ecology. This growing body of knowledge underscores the need for the formal recognition and consolidation of carrion ecology as a distinct ecological discipline. In this review, we begin by outlining the ecological features that make carrion a unique resource, provide practical definitions of scavenger and scavenging to reduce persistent ambiguities, describe carcass decomposition by linking stages with insect succession, and position carrion within a broader scientific context. Building on this foundation, we then pursue three main goals. First, we show how incorporating carrion ecology enriches ecological concepts and paradigms across levels of biological organisation, from individuals to ecosystems. Second, we emphasise how expanding knowledge of carrion ecology informs many disciplines beyond ecology. Third, we present a conceptual framework that integrates the diverse ecological functions of carrion across eco‐evolutionary timescales and addresses the structured and dynamic connections among the multiple disciplines concerned with carrion. By underscoring the ecological and interdisciplinary relevance of this resource, our framework not only clarifies the components and flows of the carrion system but also highlights opportunities for novel cross‐disciplinary collaborations. As carrion ecology continues to mature as a scientific field, we expect that this review and synthesis will consolidate current knowledge, stimulate innovative research across disciplines, and firmly position carrion ecology within the broader ecological and scientific landscape.

item.title: Species range contractions in geographic and environmental space
item.abstract: Species range contractions are a defining feature of the Anthropocene. Given their prevalence, a key question arises: do range contractions follow consistent patterns? Empirical studies have produced mixed results, revealing some emergent patterns, but also considerable variation among taxa. Here, we present a framework that seeks to explain this variation, conceptualising range contractions as the outcome of the interaction between species’ population growth rates and threat impacts, mediated by environmental conditions. Our framework shows how four primary patterns of range contraction arise, with a fifth emerging under incomplete threat spread. By describing when, where, and why particular patterns of decline occur, our framework advances understanding of species’ responses to global change and provides a basis for more generalisable conservation strategies.
authors: Ben C. Scheele, Geoffrey W. Heard, Simon Clulow, Jane A. Catford, Richard P. Duncan

score.title: Risks of heightened human–wildlife conflict when subsidies disappear
score.summary: [背景] 人为食物补贴（如垃圾、投喂）常导致野生动物种群增长，但减少这类补贴可能引发复杂的人-野生动物冲突。现有研究多关注补贴对种群数量的长期影响，较少关注补贴消失后行为改变的短期动态及其管理挑战。[方法] 本文为观点文章，基于现有案例和理论推导，分析补贴减少后野生动物行为改变的机制、后果及管理对策。[发现] 1) 补贴减少后，野生动物行为改变（如觅食策略调整）比种群数量下降更快，导致饥饿个体更频繁进入人类社区或攻击人畜，造成冲突短期急剧加剧；2) 这种过渡期可能被管理者忽视，从而采取不当应对（如扑杀），反而扩大冲突；3) 提前规划、逐步减少补贴、结合行为引导措施（如诱食替代）可缓解过渡期风险。[贡献] 提出冲突的“过渡动态”框架，强调行为与种群响应的不同步性，为冲突管理提供新视角。[局限] 为概念性探讨，缺乏实证数据支撑，具体阈值和持续时间因物种和环境而异，需个案评估。[精读] 讨论部分的管理启示值得快速浏览，但无需深入精读。

item.title: Risks of heightened human–wildlife conflict when subsidies disappear
item.abstract: Anthropogenic food subsidies often elevate wildlife populations. Reducing these subsidies may alter behavior more rapidly than population size, creating a transient period of heightened human–wildlife conflict. Recognizing these transitional dynamics can improve conflict mitigation and conservation outcomes while enhancing public safety for communities living alongside dangerous species.

score.title: Pre-emptive behaviour in a landscape of intergroup conflict
score.summary: [背景] 群体间冲突是动物界中强大的选择压力。传统研究关注冲突发生期间及事后的行为，但动物也会在预期可能的群体间遭遇时表现出行为可塑性。本文综合了多种社会性动物的研究，探讨了预期行为如何响应冲突威胁。[方法] 作者提出“群体间冲突景观”概念，描述动物如何在信息收集、资源使用、群体凝聚、同步性和群体内互动等方面进行预期调整。威胁程度由空间背景、竞争对手特征和个体动机等因素塑造，动物需平衡感知信息与过去交互记忆以做出决策。[发现] 1) 动物能根据以往经验和环境线索预测冲突概率，并提前调整行为，如减少觅食、增加警戒或改变群体空间结构；2) 这种预期行为影响群体动态和个体适合度，并可能进一步塑造种群动态和群落结构；3) 通过实验、技术和分析手段深入检验预期行为的后果，可深化对社会认知演化、种群动态和群落结构的理解。[贡献] 该综述首次系统整合了来自不同类群的证据，提出了统一的理论框架，突出了预期行为在塑造动物社会中的重要性，并指出了未来研究方向。[局限] 文章主要为概念性综合，缺乏定量模型和具体预测；多数证据来自少数类群，其普遍性有待验证。[精读] 对动物社会行为研究有理论参考价值，但与用户当前的光伏-入侵、野火等核心任务完全无关，不建议优先阅读。

item.title: Pre-emptive behaviour in a landscape of intergroup conflict
item.abstract: Intergroup conflict is a powerful selective force throughout the animal kingdom. While research has traditionally focused on actions during and after contests, animals also exhibit behavioural flexibility in anticipation of potential intergroup encounters. Synthesising findings from diverse taxa, we describe how social species adjust pre-emptive information gathering, resource use, cohesion, synchrony, and intragroup interactions across a heterogeneous ‘landscape of intergroup conflict’. We show how variation in threat level, driven by spatial context, rival characteristics, and individual motivation, affects these behaviours, and how balancing sensed information and memories of past interactions underlies associated decision-making. Testing the consequences of intergroup pre-emptive behaviour using experimental, technological, and analytical advances will develop understanding of its role in socio-cognitive evolution, population dynamics, and community structure.
authors: Josh J. Arbon, Andrew N. Radford

score.summary: [背景] 跨界保护区（TBPAs）已被探讨在生物多样性保护、自然对人类贡献和文化价值方面的作用，但淡水生物多样性长期被保护规划忽视。淡水生态系统拥有高水平的生物多样性，却面临极高威胁，亟需纳入保护策略。[方法] 本文为观点评论，基于Li等近期发起的讨论，强调将淡水维度整合进跨界保护区框架的必要性，通过总结已有文献指出代表性不足的问题。[发现] 1) 全球范围内，淡水生态系统在保护区网络中代表性严重不足；2) 淡水生物多样性受到多重胁迫，跨界合作保护是关键；3) 在TBPAs中明确纳入淡水目标可提升整体保护成效。[贡献] 文章开辟了跨界保护区讨论的新方向，提醒保护学界关注淡水生态系统的独特性与紧迫性。[局限] 作为简评，未提供经验数据或具体实施路线，分析依赖已发表研究，深度有限。[精读] 值得快速浏览以获取概念启发，但核心论据需追溯引用的实证文献。

item.title: Transboundary protected areas for freshwater biodiversity
item.abstract: Recently, Li et al. [1] initiated an important discussion about the role of transboundary protected areas (TBPAs) in biodiversity conservation, nature’s contributions to people, and cultural values. Their study opened an opportunity to broaden the discussion on freshwater biodiversity. This is essential because, for a long time and across many regions of the world, freshwater ecosystems, which have high levels of biodiversity, have been neglected when creating protected areas [e.g., 2–4]. Paradoxically, freshwater biodiversity is extremely threatened [e.g., 5] and, therefore, needs to be targeted in conservation strategies such as TBPAs [4].
authors: Valter M. Azevedo-Santos, Felipe P. Ottoni

score.summary: [背景] 物种池概念是群落生态学与生物地理学的核心，连接生态与进化过程，但现有定义主要关注当代生态过程，忽略了生成物种池的历史与进化过程。 [方法] 本文提出一个系统发育框架，通过推断生物地理区域内群落间的进化连接性来定义物种池，强调长期进化尺度的组装过程。 [发现] 该框架能够整合系统发育信息与生物地理分布数据，揭示区域种库的进化组成与群落间进化关系，为理解群落构建机制提供时间深度。 [贡献] 首次将系统发育维度系统性地纳入物种池概念，为群落生态学引入历史与进化视角，拓展了概念在保护生物地理学中的应用。 [局限] 框架依赖高质量的系统发育树和分布数据，在数据不足的类群或区域可能受限，且未提供具体实证检验。 [精读] 概念框架值得关注，尤其方法学部分对进化群落生态学者有启发，但需结合具体研究案例进一步评估适用性。

item.title: Rebuilding the species pool within a phylogenetic framework
item.abstract: The species pool is a fundamental concept with the potential to connect ecological and evolutionary processes in community ecology and biogeography. However, current definitions of the concept primarily focus on contemporary ecological processes, ignoring the historical and evolutionary processes that generated the species pool. We propose a phylogenetic framework that defines the species pool by inferring evolutionary connectivity between communities in a biogeographic region. Our framework is better suited to addressing questions regarding assembly processes occurring over long time periods, offering deeper evolutionary insights for community ecology and conservation biogeography.
authors: Sijia Yuan, Yuhao Zhao, Jean-Philippe Lessard, Thomas E. Martin, Thomas J. Matthews, Xingfeng Si

item.title: The carbon cost of forest fragmentation: Size matters
item.abstract: Forest conservation typically prioritizes total area, treating every hectare as interchangeable regardless of how the landscape is configured. Analyzing 17 million patches, Zou et al. reveal that per-area productivity rises superlinearly with patch size. Fragmentation can, therefore, erode carbon sequestration, exposing a hidden cost that challenges area-based conservation paradigms.
authors: Md. Mahadi Hasan, Nadiyah M. Alabdallah, Muhammad Waseem, Hui Liu

score.title: Biogeographical costs and opportunities of thermal adaptation
score.summary: [背景] 物种的地理分布受生态和进化过程共同影响，其中热适应如何塑造分布格局是宏观生态学核心问题。Brightly等人的研究揭示冷起源谱系极少形成amphitropical分布，这引发了关于适应特定热环境可能带来的生物地理限制与机会的探讨。[方法] 本文是一篇观点评论，基于对Brightly等人实证研究的分析和概念延伸，提出热适应的“生物地理成本与机会”框架。[发现] 1) 冷起源物种向暖气候区扩张时，可能面临热耐受上限限制等成本，导致分布范围狭窄；2) 相反，热适应可能在某些情况下促进物种扩散，形成机会，如暖适应谱系更易跨越赤道分布；3) 该框架有助于理解气候变化下物种迁徙和灭绝风险，因为热适应历史可能约束未来分布响应。[贡献] 本文提炼出热适应双向影响的统一概念，为预测物种分布动态提供了新的理论视角。[局限] 文章主要依赖单一案例研究，未进行定量分析或元分析，概念普适性仍需更多数据验证。[精读] 若关注物种分布建模与气候变化响应，可精读其中关于热适应如何作为约束条件的概念，但对具体方法帮助有限。

item.title: Biogeographical costs and opportunities of thermal adaptation
item.abstract: What determines where species occur and where they do not? Brightly et al. showed that cold-origin lineages are less likely to form amphitropical distributions. This raises questions about the biogeographical costs and opportunities of adapting to a particular thermal environment, with implications for species persistence or extinction under climate change.

item.title: Microbial contributions to host life history trade-offs
item.abstract: All organisms must allocate finite resources among growth, maintenance, and reproduction, generating trade-offs that constrain adaptation. Host-associated microbiomes are dynamic resource engines capable of generating and reallocating energy and resources for their hosts. In doing so, we argue they may recalibrate the trade-offs fundamental to host life history evolution.
authors: Lauren Petrullo, Gregory F. Albery, Aura Raulo, Amy R. Sweeny

pre.oneLine: 研究中国河流因景观堰导致的碎片化，量化其对河流连通性的影响，属于生态学应用研究。

score.title: Beauty, but at what cost? Ornamental weirs fragment China's streams
score.summary: [背景] 在中国，为促进乡村振兴和生态旅游，河流中大量建设装饰性堰，但其对河流连通性的生态影响尚未被系统评估。[方法] 本研究利用中国社交媒体平台（如抖音、小红书）提取装饰性堰的图片和位置信息，并结合高分辨率卫星影像验证和补充，在全国尺度上量化了装饰性堰造成的河流碎片化程度。计算了每个子流域的障碍物密度和树状连通性指数（DCI）。[发现] 1) 装饰性堰广泛分布于至少87个子流域，其密度中位数为每公里0.95个，DCI中位数为18.0（95% CI: 10.0–21.0），指示高强度碎片化。2) 与大型水坝相比，装饰性堰的密度显著更高，导致的连通性下降幅度更大，说明小型障碍物累积效应不可忽视。3) 装饰性堰建设多集中于旅游热点区域，景观收益与生态成本之间存在明显权衡。[贡献] 首次量化了装饰性堰对中国河流系统的碎片化影响，揭示了其隐蔽且累积的生态风险，为河流管理提供了决策依据。[局限] 数据来源依赖于互联网众包，可能遗漏未在社交媒体出现的堰；未进行现场验证，无法评估对鱼类洄游等实际生态过程的定量影响。[精读] 方法部分展示了利用多源遥感与社交媒体数据量化人为干扰的创新路径，值得参考；讨论部分对权衡的论述可启发保护规划。

item.title: Beauty, but at what cost? Ornamental weirs fragment China's streams
item.abstract: In rivers across China, ornamental weirs are being installed to facilitate rural revitalization and promote eco‐tourism. Despite the goal of improving landscape aesthetics, these structures have ecological impacts—particularly on river connectivity—that may be substantial but are largely undocumented. In this study, we use Chinese social media and high‐resolution satellite images to quantify river fragmentation caused by ornamental weirs. These structures are present in at least 87 sub‐basins across China and result in intensive river fragmentation, with a median density of 0.95 barriers per kilometer and a dendritic connectivity index of 18.0 (95% confidence interval: 10.0–21.0). Notably, as compared with large dams, ornamental weirs occur in significantly higher densities and cause greater reductions in connectivity. While landscape aesthetics undoubtedly benefit local tourism, developers of ornamental weirs should seek not to jeopardize effective river connectivity, which supports the freshwater biodiversity and fisheries on which local communities depend.
authors: Jingrui Sun, Yingyue He, Chengfei Yi, Julian D Olden, Huiying Yang, Martyn C Lucas

score.title: Biodiversity buffers the effects of drought on productivity most in drier grasslands and less so in forests
score.summary: [背景] 极端气候事件（如干旱）对生态系统生产力构成严重威胁，而生物多样性被认为能够缓冲这些影响，但不同环境条件下多样性效应的强弱是否变化尚不清楚。[方法] 该研究综合了全球75个草地和森林的生物多样性实验数据，分析了植物多样性对干旱下生产力的影响，以及环境背景（如干旱指数）的调节作用。[发现] 1) 在极端干旱事件中，植物多样性对生产力的缓冲效应更强；2) 在更干旱的草地中，多样性效应更显著，主要表现为物种间的互补性增强；3) 在森林中，多样性效应对干旱的缓冲作用较弱，可能与森林生态系统的结构复杂性有关。[贡献] 揭示了多样性-稳定性关系的气候依赖性，为预测气候变化下不同生态系统对干旱的响应提供了机制理解。[局限] 研究基于实验数据，可能难以完全反映自然生态系统的复杂性；不同实验的干旱强度和频率定义不统一。[精读] 值得关注其综合分析方法和对功能性状机制的讨论。

We found that the effects of plant diversity intensify in extreme drought and in more arid grasslands, driven by strengthened complementarity among species.

score.title: A New Framework to Empower Ecosystem Assessment Through the Integration of eDNA Inventories, Graph Theory and Niche Modelling
score.summary: [背景] 环境DNA（eDNA）数据的网络拓扑在生态评估中的意义尚未被充分挖掘，将网络分析转化为评估工具仍处于早期阶段。[方法] 本研究提出一个整合eDNA调查、图论（特别是graphlet分析）、生态位建模和机器学习的创新框架，并在186个湖泊的599份浮游植物eDNA数据上验证，这些湖泊覆盖了人为富营养化梯度。[发现] 1) 基于graphlet的网络拓扑指标能解释67%的人为梯度变异，评估效果显著；2) 这些指标与群落构建等生态过程紧密关联；3) 该框架可扩展应用于多种生态情景。[贡献] 首次将graphlet分析引入eDNA群落评估，提供了一种可跨系统移植的预测工具，深化了对生态系统功能的理解。[局限] 验证仅限于湖泊浮游植物，在其他生态系统和生物类群中的普适性尚待检验；富营养化梯度可能无法完全代表其他类型的人为压力。[精读] 方法部分对graphlet指标计算及其与机器学习的整合策略值得精读，可为发展基于eDNA的生态监测提供参考。

item.title: A New Framework to Empower Ecosystem Assessment Through the Integration of eDNA Inventories, Graph Theory and Niche Modelling
item.abstract: ABSTRACT Rethinking the ecological significance of network topology in the area of environmental DNA (eDNA) data represents a major challenge in ecology, as network structure fundamentally influences ecosystem functioning. However, translating network analysis into tools for ecological assessment is still in its infancy. Here, we present an innovative approach integrating eDNA inventories with graph theory (specifically graphlet analysis), niche modelling, and machine learning to build a predictive model for ecological assessment. We validated our approach using 599 phytoplankton inventories collected from 186 lakes spanning a gradient of human‐induced eutrophication. We demonstrated the effectiveness of graphlet‐based network topological metrics for ecological assessment (explaining 67% of the anthropogenic gradient variability), as well as their link with ecological processes. This framework offers a scalable and transposable approach to a wide range of ecological situations to obtain assessment tools grounded on graphlet‐based network topology, paving the way for a more comprehensive understanding of ecosystem functioning.

item.title: Including Fitness and Health Proxies Can Alter Our Understanding of Habitat Selection
item.abstract: ABSTRACT Habitat selection analyses, which discern the environmental conditions individuals select, often inform conservation planning. Through a literature review, we demonstrate that recent habitat selection studies rarely include fitness and health information. With a simulation study, we show that ignoring such information could support the protection of sink habitats. Our case studies demonstrate how health and fitness proxies can modify our understanding of habitat selection: (1) incorporating mass gain of thick‐billed murres shows the energetic benefit of areas deemed secondary by a naive resource selection function; (2) including number of chicks in a step selection function (SSF) exposes the complex relationships glaucous‐winged gulls have with landscapes impacted by humans; and (3) including external signs of trauma in the movement kernel of SSFs demonstrates other ways in which narwhal distribution can be altered. We urge movement ecologists to collect and use health and fitness data to improve ecological inference and conservation action.
authors: Marie Auger‐Méthé, Fanny Dupont, Alyssa Eby, Kyle H. Elliott, Nigel E. Hussey, Devin A. Lyons, Marianne Marcoux, Allison Patterson, Shabnam Shadloo, Courtney R. Shuert

score.title: Gastropod shells record larval migration from deep-sea hydrothermal vents to the euphotic zone
score.summary: [背景] 深海热液喷口是离散且短命的栖息地，其特有无脊椎动物的分布与演化依赖幼虫扩散，但微小的浮游幼虫难以在野外追踪，迁移路径和高度一直未知。[方法] 该研究采集热液喷口帽贝的成体贝壳，通过高分辨率地球化学分析，对比贝壳变质前（幼虫期）和变质后（成体期）部分的氧同位素、钡和锰浓度，前者反映水温，后两者为热液流体的示踪剂。[发现] 1) 氧同位素指示幼虫经历过与透光带（0–200米）相当的温暖温度，远超底层冷海水；2) 热液流体标志元素（Ba、Mn）在成体贝壳中远高于幼虫期贝壳，排除幼虫始终滞留于喷口附近的可能；3) 结果证实浮游营养型幼虫能从深海喷口上升至大洋透光带，利用表层洋流扩散。[贡献] 首次以化学证据揭示热液物种的长距离垂直迁移，证实表层环流和温度对深海化能营养群落分布的关键影响，为建模深海生态系统连通性和保护区规划提供直接依据。[局限] 仅通过贝壳地球化学反推环境，无法实时追踪幼虫个体运动，且需假设贝壳生长记录不受后期成岩作用干扰；研究物种有限，其余热液物种是否类似迁移尚需验证。[精读] 方法部分的二次离子质谱和激光剥蚀分析值得地球化学背景读者参考，但其结论对理解和保护深海热液群落有重要生态学启示。

item.title: Gastropod shells record larval migration from deep-sea hydrothermal vents to the euphotic zone
item.abstract: Larval migration plays an essential role in determining the distribution and evolution of invertebrate animals endemic to hydrothermal vents—disjunct and ephemeral habitats in the deep sea. However, technical obstacles have prevented field observation or tracking of their free-swimming, microscopic larvae. Our geochemical analyses of pre- and postmetamorphic parts of shells revealed that the plankton-feeding (planktotrophic) larvae of vent-endemic limpets migrate to the upper layers, in or near the euphotic zone (0 to 200 m). Oxygen isotopes indicated that the larvae experienced warm temperatures approximating conditions in the euphotic zone above the vent sites, whereas barium and manganese concentrations as proxies for hot vent fluids were much higher in postmetamorphic than in premetamorphic shells, dismissing retention under hydrothermal influence. Our results provide evidence for the influence of surface currents and temperature on the distributions of chemosynthetically nourished vent communities in the deep sea. These findings also contribute to modeling deep-sea ecosystem connectivity and planning protected areas.
authors: Takuya Yahagi, Kentrao Tanaka, Tomihiko Higuchi, Kotaro Shirai, Naoto Takahata, Yuji Sano, Shigeaki Kojima, Yasunori Kano

score.title: Methane oxidation in African and European rivers depends on stream size and wetland connectivity
score.summary: [背景] 河流是甲烷的重要自然排放源，其净排放取决于甲烷生成与氧化（MOX）的平衡，但MOX速率的空间格局和驱动因素尚认识不足。[方法] 作者收集了非洲和欧洲河流的广泛数据集，分析MOX速率的空间变异，并探讨其与河流大小、湿地连通性、悬浮物、pH和溶解态营养盐等潜在驱动因子的关系。[发现] 1) MOX速率在非洲森林湿地溪流中最高，且随流域面积增大而增加；2) 在大河中，MOX是比扩散逸散更重要的溶解态甲烷去除途径，其在非洲溪流中的平均贡献（37%）高于欧洲溪流（9%）；3) MOX速率与悬浮物、pH和营养盐等的关系并不符合文献中受控实验预期的模式，而是主要受河流大小和湿地连通性驱动的空间格局所主导。[贡献] 该研究基于大尺度实地数据，揭示了河流甲烷氧化速率的宏观控制因素，强调了河流网络结构与湿地格局的重要性，为改进甲烷排放模型提供了关键参数。[局限] 研究为观测性，无法完全分离各因子的交互影响；非洲与欧洲样点覆盖可能不均衡，且对小型溪流和洪泛森林的代表性可能受限。[精读] 方法和讨论部分对理解生态系统甲烷动态的尺度依赖性有参考价值，但整体与用户研究方向距离较远。

item.title: Methane oxidation in African and European rivers depends on stream size and wetland connectivity
item.abstract: Rivers are large natural sources of methane (CH 4 ) resulting from the net balance of inputs from methanogenesis and removal by methane oxidation (MOX). Here, we use an extensive dataset collected from African and European rivers to investigate spatial patterns and causes of variability of MOX. The MOX rates were highest in African streams draining flooded forests and increased with river catchment size. In large rivers, MOX represented the more important pathway of dissolved in-stream CH 4 removal compared to diffusive degassing to the atmosphere; but this relative share was minimal in small rivers and was, on average, higher in African streams (37%) than European streams (9%). The relationships between MOX rates and potential drivers such as total suspended matter, pH, or dissolved nutrient concentrations did not follow the patterns expected from controlled experiments reported in the literature and reflected the broad spatial patterns across and within the studied river networks driven by stream size and wetland connectivity.
authors: Alberto V. Borges, Cédric Morana, Fleur A. E. Roland, William Okello, Mwapu Isumbisho, Jean-Jacques Bowanga, Likoko Kashala, Patrick Omeja, Willy Champenois, Steven Bouillon
item.summary: [背景] 河流是甲烷的重要自然排放源，其净排放取决于甲烷生成与氧化（MOX）的平衡，但MOX速率的空间格局和驱动因素尚认识不足。[方法] 作者收集了非洲和欧洲河流的广泛数据集，分析MOX速率的空间变异，并探讨其与河流大小、湿地连通性、悬浮物、pH和溶解态营养盐等潜在驱动因子的关系。[发现] 1) MOX速率在非洲森林湿地溪流中最高，且随流域面积增大而增加；2) 在大河中，MOX是比扩散逸散更重要的溶解态甲烷去除途径，其在非洲溪流中的平均贡献（37%）高于欧洲溪流（9%）；3) MOX速率与悬浮物、pH和营养盐等的关系并不符合文献中受控实验预期的模式，而是主要受河流大小和湿地连通性驱动的空间格局所主导。[贡献] 该研究基于大尺度实地数据，揭示了河流甲烷氧化速率的宏观控制因素，强调了河流网络结构与湿地格局的重要性，为改进甲烷排放模型提供了关键参数。[局限] 研究为观测性，无法完全分离各因子的交互影响；非洲与欧洲样点覆盖可能不均衡，且对小型溪流和洪泛森林的代表性可能受限。[精读] 方法和讨论部分对理解生态系统甲烷动态的尺度依赖性有参考价值，但整体与用户研究方向距离较远。

item.title: Predictors of extinction risk in large tropical forest mammals: From global to local
item.abstract: Studies can only guide conservation if their findings are informative at the scales at which practitioners and policy-makers operate. Yet, it is rarely tested whether large-scale studies reach similar conclusions to the smaller-scale studies on which conservation traditionally relies. We examine whether predictors of extinction risk are consistent across global, regional, and local scales, for 210 tropical forest mammal species (≥1 kg) that existed during the last 130,000 years, in 64 tropical forests, across three biogeographical realms. We found consistent predictors of extinction risk (body mass, generation length, diet, brain volume, and scansoriality) when analyses differed only in their spatial resolution. However, predictors differed when analyses also varied in their temporal extent. Macroecological findings about extinction risk can, thus, inform conservation at smaller scales, but they risk misidentifying threatened species if differences in temporal extent are not recognized.

score.title: Global biosphere productivity response to Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation collapse during Heinrich Stadial 4
score.summary: [背景] 大西洋经向翻转环流（AMOC）的减缓可能影响全球碳循环，但过去全球生物圈生产力如何响应AMOC变化尚不清楚。该研究利用冰芯中的空气氧三同位素（¹⁷Δ）重建了过去全球生产力，并借助气候模型分离驱动因素。[方法] 研究提取了极地冰芯中40.5–38.6 ka BP的气体，涵盖了海因里希冰阶4（HS4，一次AMOC显著减弱事件），测量了氧的三同位素组成以反演全球总初级生产力；同时使用全球气候模型进行淡水强迫实验，模拟AMOC崩溃对气候和植被的影响。[发现] 1）同位素记录显示，在约39.5 ka BP大气CO₂浓度上升后，全球生物圈生产力出现轻微增加。2）模型模拟表明，AMOC减弱导致北半球降温干旱，抑制生产力，但CO₂施肥效应刺激了陆地植被生长，两者相抵后全球生产力净增。3）这一结果意味着，在千年尺度上，CO₂施肥可能比AMOC引起的环流变化对生物圈生产力影响更大。[贡献] 首次将冰芯¹⁷Δ指标用于定量重建末次冰期全球生产力变化，为评估未来AMOC减缓的生态后果提供了古气候类比。[局限] 冰芯记录时间分辨率有限，且生产力重建依赖于生物圈氧同位素分馏模型的假设；模型模拟未考虑海洋生态系统响应和动态植被的完全耦合。[精读] 方法部分的三同位素原理和模型实验设计值得关注，但整体与用户当前研究方向距离较远，不建议优先精读。

item.title: Global biosphere productivity response to Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation collapse during Heinrich Stadial 4
item.abstract: The slowdown of the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation (AMOC) due to ongoing climate change raises concerns about its impact on the global carbon cycle. Understanding how global biosphere productivity may respond to such changes is essential for predicting the future carbon cycle, yet quantifying past global biosphere productivity remains challenging. We use triple isotope composition of air oxygen ( 17 Δ) trapped in polar ice cores to reconstruct the global biosphere productivity over the period 40.5 to 38.6 thousand years before the present (ka B.P.), covering Heinrich Stadial 4, a period of weakened AMOC. Our data reveal a slight increase in productivity following a carbon dioxide (CO 2 ) rise around 39.5 ka B.P. Freshwater hosing experiments using a global climate model indicate that the CO 2 fertilization effect on the terrestrial biosphere offsets productivity decline caused by consequences of AMOC slowdown. Collectively, our results suggest that global biosphere productivity slightly increases in response to AMOC slowdown and accompanying changes.

item.title: Vitronectin metabolically programs profibrotic macrophages in 3D cultures and idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis
item.abstract: Macrophages are key drivers of inflammatory and fibrotic diseases, and their activation is shaped by interactions in their tissue microenvironment. However, dissecting the processes that drive immunopathology has proved challenging, as traditional two-dimensional (2D) culture methods fail to capture the complex molecular environment that macrophages inhabit in vivo. To address this, we generated a 3D in vitro model to better mimic the in vivo biophysical microenvironment. We show that the extracellular matrix protein vitronectin promotes a previously unknown profibrotic macrophage phenotype in 3D that is characterized by increased expression of the nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD + ) ectoenzyme CD38, elevated glycolysis and mitochondrial metabolism, and synthesis of the immunomodulatory metabolite itaconate. This is validated in vivo where patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis have elevated vitronectin and MRC1 + CD38 + macrophages, while vitronectin-deficient mice were protected from an experimental model of lung injury and fibrosis. Thus, we uncover a previously unidentified link between the composition of tissue niches and macrophage profibrotic function via altered metabolic reprogramming.

item.title: Maize-based polyculture, not monoculture, sustained precolonial societies in the Brazilian Cerrado
item.abstract: Maize has long been argued to have played a key role in the transition to food production in the Americas. Recent work has even suggested that this included “monoculture” in parts of South America. Here, we report stable isotope data (δ 13 C, δ 15 N, and δ 18 O) of 101 human individuals from 37 late Holocene archaeological sites across the Cerrado (Brazilian savanna), Caatinga (dry forest), and Atlantic Forest biomes of central-eastern South America, in addition to present faunal baseline and radiocarbon dates. The results show cultural and economic diversity among archaeological traditions. Integrating archaeological, palaeoecological, and chronological data, we argue for the coexistence of a diversified and a more complex food production systems in the Cerrado biome, comparable to those of precolonial urban-scale populations practicing maize agriculture in the Amazon. These findings demonstrated that eastern South America populations practiced maize-based polyculture, reshaping current models of cultural and environmental dynamics in the Cerrado biome.

score.title: Inferring single-cell heterogeneity of bacteriophage lysis-associated life-history traits from population-scale dynamics
score.summary: [背景] 噬菌体裂解细菌的过程塑造种群动态与生态系统功能，但裂解特征（如潜伏期、爆发量）的单细胞异质性及其如何影响群体尺度后果仍知之甚少。 [方法] 作者以感染海洋蓝细菌Synechococcus WH8109的T4-like噬菌体Syn9为对象，提出了一种非线性感染动态模型，仅利用群体尺度的时间序列数据即可推断潜伏期与爆发量的异质性分布，并借助单细胞实验进行了验证。 [发现] 1) 群体数据能够可靠推断光遗传异质性，所获Syn9潜伏期变异程度超过此前在大肠杆菌噬菌体中的观察；2) 爆发量的变异性在很大程度上可由潜伏期的差异解释，表明两者之间存在共变关系；3) 用单一均值代表病毒特征会忽略显著的个体差异，影响对裂解影响的定量。 [贡献] 为缺乏单细胞数据时通过群体动态量化病毒特征异质性提供了可行路径，并建立了将特征变异纳入生态模型的框架。 [局限] 模型假设感染同步且忽略了可能的非遗传异质性来源；结果仅适用于烈性噬菌体的裂解过程，推广至温和或慢性感染需谨慎。 [精读] 方法部分对异质性推断的模型设计与验证值得关注，可为宏观生物生态学中利用群体数据反推个体差异提供借鉴。

item.title: Inferring single-cell heterogeneity of bacteriophage lysis-associated life-history traits from population-scale dynamics
item.abstract: Phage-induced lysis of bacteria transforms population dynamics, community structure, and ecosystem functioning. Scaling up infected cell fate to quantify population- and ecosystem-scale impacts requires estimates of viral life-history traits, including underlying heterogeneity in the timing, efficiency, and outcome of lytic infections. However, the variability of lysis-associated phage traits remains poorly characterized. Here, we infer single-cell heterogeneity in lysis-associated traits for an ecologically relevant system: Syn9, a T4-like cyanophage infecting Synechococcus strain WH8109, a representative of globally abundant marine cyanobacteria. We estimate the heterogeneous distribution of latent period and burst size using a nonlinear model of infection dynamics applied to population-scale time-series data. We then validate our inference approach using a single-cell assay—demonstrating the feasibility of inferring phage trait heterogeneity from population data even in the absence of single-cell experiments. The variation in Syn9’s latent period exceeds that previously found in coliphages and reinforces the limitations of representing viral traits with a single value. Moreover, by partitioning lytic events via the inferred heterogeneous latent period distribution, we show that realized burst size variability is largely explained by differences in latent period, providing a path forward to measure and integrate trait (co)variation into population and ecosystem models.

score.summary: [背景] 基因组大小变异是进化生物学的核心问题之一，现有假说多强调能量成本对插入缺失突变的选择，但在浮游植物等初级生产者中，营养限制可能更为关键。[方法] 本研究推导了基于核苷酸磷、氮成本及细胞营养需求的插入缺失突变选择系数模型，并结合比较基因组学与宏基因组数据验证。[发现] 模型显示，在低营养需求的浮游植物中，自然选择占主导地位，倾向于固定减小基因组大小的突变；该预测在小细胞和寡营养环境类群中得到支持。[贡献] 提供了一个整合营养经济与基因组进化的定量框架，首次将细胞层面的营养需求与基因组大小演化联系起来。[局限] 模型主要针对浮游植物，外推到其他营养限制环境或更大生物体需谨慎；未考虑基因重复等其它基因组变化机制。[精读] 方法部分的模型推导值得关注，但其结论与当前研究任务关联度低。

item.title: Effect of cellular nutrient economy on the evolution of genome size in phytoplankton
item.abstract: The origin of genome size variation remains a central question in evolutionary biology. While energetic costs have been proposed to influence genome size through selection on insertions and deletions (indels), nutrient availability may be a more relevant constraint in primary producers such as phytoplankton. We derived an expression for the selection coefficient of indels based on the phosphorus and nitrogen costs of nucleotides and the cellular nutrient requirements. Selection coefficient estimates indicate that natural selection dominates over genetic drift and favors the fixation of mutations that reduce genome size in phytoplankton with low nutrient requirements. Model predictions are supported by comparative genomics and metagenomic analyses. Together, this model provides a rigorous quantitative framework for understanding genome size evolution, particularly in small cells and oligotrophic environments, highlighting how nutrient limitation drives genome streamlining.

score.summary: [背景] 亨德拉病毒从果蝠溢出到马匹是一个严重的公共卫生问题，预测和管理溢出风险需要了解储存宿主种群内的感染动态。目前通常基于病毒基因组检测的感染率来推断风险，但检测到病毒核酸并不一定表明存在感染性病毒或足以传播的剂量。[方法] 本研究对亨德拉病毒的主要储存宿主——果蝠进行了全面调查，分析了来自5个地点、超过3年采集的6151份混合尿液样本的RT-qPCR数据。使用广义加性模型和排列分析评估了病毒检出率（混合尿液样本阳性比例）、病毒载量代理指标与马匹溢出事件的纵向关联。[发现] 1) 与溢出事件相关的病毒检出率高峰期，其高病毒载量样本比例显著高于无溢出时期。2) 长时间的低病毒载量和低检出率可能反映了样本中存在非感染性RNA或不足以实现跨种传播的病毒剂量。3) 将病毒载量指标与检出率结合可以改善溢出风险的预测。[贡献] 该研究强调在溢出风险评估中考虑病毒载量动态的重要性，超越单纯依赖检出率，提供了更准确的预测思路。[局限] 研究基于尿液混合样本，无法确定个体蝙蝠的精确感染状态；溢出事件关联分析可能受限于样本量和地点特异性。[精读] 本文的方法论和监测设计对于理解疾病溢出机制有参考价值，但与用户当前研究方向无关，无需精读。

item.title: Periodic shifts in viral load increase risk of Hendra virus spillover from Pteropus bats
item.abstract: Prediction and management of zoonotic spillover requires an understanding of infection dynamics within reservoir host populations. Spillover risk is commonly inferred from infection prevalence based on detection of viral genomic material, yet detection alone does not indicate the presence of infectious virus or a sufficient dose for transmission. We undertook a comprehensive investigation of Hendra virus shedding in its primary reservoir, Pteropus bats, analyzing quantitative PCR with reverse transcription (RT–qPCR) data from 6151 pooled urine samples collected across five sites over 3 years. We assessed longitudinal associations between viral prevalence (proportion of positive pooled urine samples), viral load proxies, and equine spillover, using generalized additive models and a permutation analysis. Peak prevalence periods associated with spillover events ( N = 5) had a higher proportion of samples with high viral loads than periods without spillover. Prolonged periods of low viral load and low prevalence likely reflect noninfectious RNA or doses insufficient for cross-species transmission. Incorporating viral load metrics alongside prevalence can improve prediction of spillover risk.

item.title: Satellite observations reveal widespread alteration of river thermal regimes by US dams
item.abstract: Dams are well known to alter river thermal regimes, but assessments of downstream temperature changes have been constrained to single dams, single basins, or specific seasonal windows, thus limiting knowledge of their widespread impacts. We used satellite-based thermal infrared observations to quantify river surface temperature differences up- and downstream of 287 large dams in the United States from 2013 to 2024 across all seasons. We found downstream river temperature differences for the majority (71%) of longitudinal river profiles. These downstream changes were typically warmer (60%) and, on average, were sustained or continued to increase within 20 km downstream of the dam. We also found that the magnitude and frequency of downstream alterations varied by dam type, with 91% of extreme (≥±4°C) differences occurring at dams with reservoirs. This work documents the thermal effects of large dams on downstream ecosystems across all seasons on a national scale.

score.summary: [背景] 陆地碳汇不仅取决于森林生物量积累，还取决于碳在植被中的储存时长，即植被碳周转时间（τ_veg）。现有研究多关注成熟林，但全球森林种群结构因再造林、干扰和土地利用变化而年轻化，幼龄林的生长、死亡模式和结构差异可能导致不同的周转趋势。 [方法] 利用覆盖温带、亚热带和热带的中国森林样地网络17年原位数据，分析成熟林与幼龄林τ_veg的长期变化，并探讨生长与死亡间的权衡、林分结构和环境因子的作用。 [发现] 1) 成熟林的τ_veg随时间下降，而幼龄林则增加，二者呈相反趋势。2) 这种分异由年龄特异的生长-死亡权衡驱动，并受林分结构和环境条件调节。3) 幼龄林快速生物量积累可能减缓τ_veg，挑战了气候变化下τ_veg普遍下降的预期。 [贡献] 首次基于长期样地数据揭示森林年龄对τ_veg趋势的调控作用，强调在碳循环模型中加入年龄结构的重要性。 [局限] 样地覆盖中国主要气候区，但未包括其他生物群区；未详细量化干扰历史影响。 [精读] 方法部分关于τ_veg计算和生长-死亡权衡分析值得参考，但对当前核心方向无直接支持。

item.title: Divergent long‐term trends in vegetation carbon turnover between mature and young forests
item.abstract: Abstract The terrestrial carbon sink depends not only on how much biomass forests accumulate, but also on how long that carbon remains stored in vegetation. This is known as vegetation carbon turnover time ( τ veg ), which varies with forest age, structure and climate. Furthermore, τ veg is widely expected to decline under climate change as warming and disturbance accelerate biomass loss. However, most evidence comes from mature forests, even as global forest demographics shift due to reforestation, disturbance and land‐use change. Younger forests differ in growth rates, mortality patterns and stand structure, which may create distinct turnover trajectories with rapid biomass accumulation potentially slowing τ veg . Here, we evaluated this possibility using 17 years of in situ data from a network of temperate, subtropical and tropical forest plots across China. We found that τ veg declined over time in mature forests but increased in younger ones. These opposing trends were shaped by age‐specific trade‐offs between growth and mortality, mediated by stand structure and environmental conditions. Synthesis . Our results demonstrate that forest age strongly influences vegetation carbon turnover and must be integrated into models to improve predictions of terrestrial carbon sink dynamics.

score.summary: [背景] 叶片经济谱和根系经济空间分别描述了植物地上和地下器官在资源获取与保守之间的权衡，但尚不清楚碳分子化合物如何与这些器官特异性经济策略相协调。[方法] 该研究以13种亚热带共存树种为对象，采用固态13C核磁共振技术量化叶和根中的关键碳官能团，并分析它们与叶片经济谱和根系经济空间的关系。[发现] 1) 叶片获取策略优先投资生理活性、富氮碳化合物，而非用于维持长寿的结构碳水化合物，防御性碳化合物与叶片经济谱解耦。2) 根系在保守梯度上表现为生物活性碳与防御化合物的权衡；在协作梯度上（从“自主”土壤探索到菌根真菌协作），根结构碳水化合物比例与碳分子多样性权衡。[贡献] 首次在分子水平揭示了地上和地下多维经济性状空间的碳化学基础分化，为理解植物整体策略权衡和物种共存提供了新机制。[局限] 研究仅限13种亚热带树种，推广到其他生物群系需谨慎；未直接测量菌根定殖率等协作梯度实据。[精读] 方法部分碳官能团定量及与经典经济性状的关联分析值得参考，可启发将功能性状扩展到植物入侵或干扰响应的碳化学维度。

item.title: Contrasting molecular‐level carbon traits underlying leaf and root economic strategies in a subtropical forest
item.abstract: Abstract Carbon constitutes the biochemical basis of plant survival and evolution. Plant trait‐based economic frameworks have revealed divergent strategic trade‐offs in leaves (leaf economics spectrum, LES) and roots (root economics space, RES). However, how carbon molecular compounds coordinate with organ‐specific economic strategies and whether they follow similar biochemical foundations remain unknown. We employed the solid‐state 13 C nuclear magnetic resonance to quantify key carbon functional groups in leaves and roots across 13 coexisting subtropical tree species and assess their coordination with LES and RES. The results showed contrasting coordination of carbon traits with economic strategies in leaves and roots. Specifically, leaves with the acquisitive strategy prioritized physiologically active and nitrogen‐rich carbon over structural carbohydrates used for longevity maintenance, while defence carbon compounds decoupled from the LES. However, roots exhibited a primary trade‐off where bioactive carbon aligned against defence compounds along the conservation gradient. Orthogonally, root structural carbohydrate proportions traded off against carbon molecular diversity, aligning to the root collaboration gradient from ‘do‐it‐yourself’ soil exploration to collaboration with mycorrhizal fungi. Synthesis. These findings highlight divergent carbon bases in shaping above‐ and below‐ground multidimensional economics trait space, providing new mechanistic insights into whole‐plant strategic trade‐offs that govern plant adaptations and species coexistence in heterogeneous environments.

score.summary: [背景] 入侵植物在新分布区常快速形成与本地种平行或不同的生长和防御纬度格局，但针对多种敌人（植食者、病原菌）的防御如何随纬度变化及其与环境驱动关系尚不确定。[方法] 该研究以入侵中国的喜旱莲子草及本地同属种莲子草为对象，通过自然种群调查和涵盖约50个种群的同质园实验，评估了生长及对多种敌人防御的纬度格局，并分析植物性状与来源地环境的关系。[发现] 1) 野外种群中，两种植物的叶片取食和病原感染在中间纬度最高，而植食者丰富度和丰度、根际真菌和病原菌丰富度均随纬度降低。2) 同质园中，本地种生长随来源地纬度升高而下降，但对主要昆虫植食者和根结线虫的抗性随纬度升高而增强。3) 入侵种的生长和防御与来源地纬度均无显著关系。4) 对常见叶部真菌病原的抗性在两种植物中均不随纬度变化。5) 本地种性状直接受气候影响，而入侵种性状仅体现间接效应。[贡献] 首次系统比较入侵种与本地同属种对多种敌人的防御纬度格局，揭示了生物互作纬度变异的复杂性，并强调入侵物种的响应并非由植食者单一驱动。[局限] 研究局限于中国纬度梯度，敌人类型虽多但未量化不同敌人的相对重要性；同质园环境可能未完全反映野外条件。[精读] 值得精读其实验设计、性状测量和纬度分析方法，对入侵生态比较研究有借鉴意义。

item.title: Latitudinal patterns in growth and defence against multiple enemies of an invasive species and its native congener
item.abstract: Abstract Some invasive plant species rapidly develop latitudinal patterns of growth and defence against herbivores in their introduced ranges, either parallel to or different from those of co‐occurring native plant species. However, how defences against multiple enemies relate to latitude and environmental drivers for co‐occurring native and invasive plant species remains uncertain. We assessed latitudinal patterns in growth and defences against multiple enemies for the invasive species Alternanthera philoxeroides and its native congener A. sessilis in China, with surveys of natural populations and a common garden experiment with ~50 populations. We explored how plant growth and defences were associated with source site environments. In natural populations, foliar defoliation and pathogen infection peaked at intermediate latitude, while herbivore richness and abundance, richness of overall rhizosphere fungi and pathogens decreased with latitude for both species. In the common garden, native species' growth decreased with source population latitude, while native plant resistance against the dominant insect herbivore and root‐knot nematode parasite increased with source latitude. Invasive species' growth and defences were unrelated to source population latitude. Resistance to a common foliar fungal pathogen did not vary with source population latitude for either species. Traits of native plants were consistent with direct effects of climate while those of invasive plants only reflected indirect effects. Synt hesis. The results underscore the latitudinal variability of biotic interactions across organisms and highlight how a species' growth and defence across latitude are not influenced by herbivores alone, but a suite of enemies and abiotic conditions.

item.title: Tree canopy shapes the survival of oak and beech saplings during the regeneration stage along an elevation‐driven temperature gradient
item.abstract: Abstract Climate change is increasing the severity and frequency of heatwave and drought events, affecting forest community composition through changes in the mediating microclimatic effect of dominant adult trees. Predicting these changes requires understanding how temperature interacts with biotic factors, such as canopy‐mediated facilitation and competition, during forest regeneration. Here, we investigate how the forest canopy modifies temperature‐ and light‐related constraints on sapling survival along an elevation gradient. We conducted a reciprocal transplant experiment using saplings of Fagus sylvatica and Quercus petraea along an elevation‐driven temperature gradient (100–1600 m) in the French Pyrenees. Saplings were planted under two tree‐neighbour conditions, under forest canopy and in open gaps, allowing analysis of the effects of temperature, canopy cover and their interactions on survival. The experimentally derived survival‐temperature relationships were then used to generate spatial projections of canopy effects on sapling survival under a warming scenario. Sapling survival declined with increasing elevation for both species, but responses differed between canopy conditions and species. Q. petraea survival decreased sharply under canopy at high elevation, whereas F. sylvatica showed reduced survival in open gaps at the lowest elevation. These patterns reflect contrasting biotic interactions along the thermal gradient: canopy competition constrains Q. petraea at high elevations due to heat limitation, while canopy facilitation benefits F. sylvatica at the lowest elevation by buffering heat and vapour pressure deficit. Spatial projections under climate warming suggested improved canopy effect for both species at lower elevations, whereas at higher elevations Q. petraea benefits from canopy, but F. sylvatica experiences degraded effects. Our findings highlight the key role of strain— the degree to which local conditions deviate from a species' physiological optimum — in shaping competitive and facilitative interactions. While environmental stress sets the external constraint, species strain determines whether the canopy cover functions as a buffer or an inhibitor. Synthesis . By altering microclimatic conditions, the tree canopy can either alleviate or intensify strain depending on the species, thus influencing sapling survival and establishment along thermal gradients. score.summary: [背景] 放牧优化假说认为适度采食可刺激植物生长，但以往验证多基于地上部分，地下生产力占草地总生产力一半以上，其补偿响应尚不明确。完整评估地上-地下补偿效应对草地可持续管理至关重要。[方法] 在青藏高原高寒草地开展3年牦牛放牧强度实验（无放牧、轻牧、中牧、重牧），并辅以控制模拟放牧实验分离去叶、踩踏和排泄物的独立影响，计算地上(ANPP)和地下(BNPP)净初级生产力的补偿指数。[发现] 1) 轻、中、重度放牧使ANPP较不放牧对照增加28%–43%，表现为显著过补偿；2) BNPP对放牧强度响应微弱，仅出现有限的补偿，导致总NPP仅呈微弱过补偿；3) ANPP过补偿幅度随时间下降，但BNPP与总NPP无此时间衰减；4) 模拟实验表明，去叶单独增加ANPP，踩踏与排泄物返回对ANPP、BNPP及补偿指数均无显著影响。[贡献] 首次综合证明高寒草地地上和地下生产力对放牧的补偿响应显著背离，警示仅依靠地上测量会系统性地高估补偿程度，为准确评估放牧草地生产力提供了全株视角。[局限] 3年周期可能未充分捕捉长期动态，模拟实验因子单一，且未涉及植物群落组成变化的间接效应。[精读] 推荐精读实验设计部分及补偿差异背后的碳分配机制讨论。

item.title: Above‐ground and below‐ground productivity shows divergent compensatory responses to grazing in an alpine grassland
item.abstract: Abstract The grazing optimization hypothesis suggests that moderate herbivory can stimulate plant growth and increase productivity, a phenomenon referred to as overcompensation. However, most evidence for this response is based on above‐ground responses, while below‐ground responses remain uncertain. Below‐ground productivity accounts for more than half of total grassland productivity, making it essential to assess whole‐plant responses. We conducted a 3‐year yak grazing‐intensity experiment, manipulating four levels of herbivory, and quantified compensation indices for both above‐ground (ANPP) and below‐ground (BNPP) net primary productivity relative to ungrazed controls. We complemented this with a controlled simulated‐grazing experiment to isolate the effects of defoliation, trampling and excrement on these compensation responses. Across light, moderate and heavy grazing treatments, ANPP increased by 28%–43% relative to ungrazed controls, suggesting clear overcompensation in above‐ground production. In contrast, BNPP showed little response to grazing intensity and exhibited only limited compensatory responses, such that total net primary productivity (NPP) showed only weak overcompensation. Over time, the magnitude of ANPP overcompensation declined, whereas no temporal attenuation was detected for BNPP or total NPP. Results from the simulated‐grazing experiment further showed that defoliation alone increased ANPP, while trampling and excreta return had negligible effects on ANPP, BNPP or their associated compensation indices. Synthesis . Our findings suggest that reliance on aboveground‐only measurements systematically overestimates the degree of overcompensation in grazed grasslands, underscoring the necessity of whole‐plant assessments for accurately evaluating grassland productivity.

score.summary: [背景] 气候变化导致高海拔地区积雪减少、气温升高和降水变异性增加，若适应速率跟不上，高海拔种群可能面临风险。来自低海拔、气候更接近未来条件的种群是否在高海拔表现更好尚不清楚。[方法] 对加州野花 Streptanthus tortuosus 开展高海拔共同园实验，移植来自全分布区气候和生活史各异的23个种群，连续两季记录存活和繁殖输出，分析气候距离对表现的影响。[发现] 1) 无论是高海拔本地种群还是其它高海拔种群，均存在适应滞后，但仅表现在某些生活史阶段；2) 低海拔种群在第一年存活率和越冬存活率更高，总适合度更高；3) 第二年的存活至繁殖比例和总繁殖输出（主要由第二年繁殖贡献）在高海拔种群中更高；4) 适应滞后因生活史阶段（如一年生与多年生投资）而异，取决于季节性时机。[贡献] 强调在评估气候适应及高海拔种群脆弱性时，必须考虑生活史变异和季节动态，为辅助基因流等保护管理提供依据。[局限] 研究基于单一物种和单一高海拔园点，结论的普遍性需更多物种和地点验证。[精读] 值得关注生活史阶段划分和统计方法，但整体与当前核心课题关联有限。

item.title: Adaptational lag at high elevations depends on life stage in a California wildflower
item.abstract: Abstract High‐elevation populations are expected to receive reduced snowpack, warmer temperatures and more variable precipitation with climate change, potentially putting them at risk if rates of adaptation do not keep pace. Populations from climates more closely aligned with changing conditions at high elevations may prove better suited to current climate than the local populations. Thus, it is essential to assess (1) whether high‐elevation populations are locally adapted to current climate or (2) whether the fitness of lower elevation populations from warmer climates is higher than for local populations in high‐elevation conditions. We conducted a common garden study with Streptanthus tortuosus at a high‐elevation site. Plants from twenty‐three populations from across the species range, which vary in climate and life history, were transplanted and subsequently measured for mortality and reproductive output across two growing seasons. We examined the effects of climatic distance from the site of origin on plant performance. We hypothesized that lower elevation populations would survive the first warm growth season well, but the seasonal constraint of cold temperatures and snowpack would reduce their survival into the second year, thus limiting their overall fitness. We observed evidence of adaptational lag for high‐elevation populations, including the local population, but only for some life stages. Lower elevation populations, with climates further from the garden, had higher survival through the first year and over winter, resulting in higher probabilities of reproducing and total fitness. However, survival to reproduction in year 2, and total reproductive output, driven largely by reproduction in the second year, were higher in high‐elevation populations, with climates closer to the garden. Thus, adaptational lag differed among life stages and depended on life history (e.g. first year versus second year fitness). Synthesis . Our results highlight the importance of considering variation in life history and seasonal timing when evaluating climate adaptation, as well as vulnerability of high‐elevation populations to climate change. Further, these findings provide information for management of populations at risk, including strategic assisted gene flow that introduces beneficial alleles from warm‐adapted populations but preserves some components of high‐elevation adaptation.

item.title: Interacting effects of water availability, neighbourhood density and ectomycorrhizal fungi on the traits and growth of a dominant Dipterocarp
item.abstract: Abstract Southeast Asian forests are increasingly impacted by global change. Precipitation reduction is a key driver whose effects on tree performance are mediated by biotic contexts such as tree density and altered soil fungal communities. Understanding tree responses to these drivers is central to predicting forest dynamics. However, these drivers are often studied independently despite their potential for interactive effects. Trait‐based approaches that ignore these interactions by assuming static trait values may provide limited or biased insights into future forests. We manipulated three key variables in a glasshouse experiment: water availability (simulating decreasing precipitation) and two biotic contexts, neighbourhood density and soil ectomycorrhizal (EcM) fungal communities. We assessed their independent and interactive effects on the growth, traits and trait–growth relationships of Parashorea chinensis , a dominant Dipterocarp species in southeast Asian tropical rainforests. Our results demonstrate that, while water availability is the dominant driver of seedling growth, the impact is magnified by seedling density. Promotion of seedling growth by soil EcM fungi is observed under wet but not dry conditions. Seedling trait–growth relationships are highly context‐dependent, varying across treatments (i.e. water availability, neighbourhood density and fungicide). For instance, while root and stem traits exhibited weak or inconsistent relationships with growth, leaf traits such as leaf area and specific leaf area correlated strongly with growth across treatments. These findings indicate that predictions based upon static species‐level trait values will be highly uncertain, revealing that trait–performance relationships are more complex than assumed. Synthesis . Our results reveal that trait–growth relationships shift across water availability, neighbourhood density and soil biotas, challenging current vegetation models that rely on mean trait values. These findings highlight the need to move beyond single‐driver studies and static trait assumptions by integrating these factors to develop more robust predictions of future forest performance.

score.summary: [背景] 叶经济谱是连接植物生活史策略与生态系统功能的核心框架，但主要基于陆生植物建立，其在淡水植物群落中的适用性及水生环境独特适应是否改变这些关系尚不清晰。不同生活型（挺水、沉水）可能对环境驱动呈差异化响应，而现有理论难以捕捉。 [方法] 本研究整合了欧洲6953个湖泊与河流植物群落的组成数据，附加叶性状和环境变量，计算挺水与沉水群落的均值性状，并利用高斯多元混合线性回归模型分别分析两类生活型叶性状与环境因子的关系，比较其相对于陆生预测的偏移。 [发现] 1) 挺水植物群落的叶性状–环境关系与陆生预测相似，高重碳酸盐、高磷和温暖条件选择资源获取型性状；2) 沉水植物群落则不同，获取型性状与高重碳酸盐和低温相关，而与磷有效性无关；3) 水生植物特有的水下气体交换和光限制等适应迫使叶形态与功能间存在独特权衡，突破了叶经济谱的原有边界，尤其表现在沉水植物上；4) 温度对水生植物生长的影响方向与陆生植物相反，提示在全球变化预测中不可直接套用陆生框架。 [贡献] 首次明确提出淡水植物叶经济谱具有领域特异性，强调了生活型在预测环境响应中的关键作用，为将功能性状方法拓展至淡水生态系统提供了新证据，并呼吁气候影响评估中需区分水生与陆生系统。 [局限] 欧洲尺度数据可能限制向其他地区的推广性；未涵盖其他可能重要的环境因子（如水流、沉积物性质），且性状数据基于数据库而非原位测量，可能引入误差。 [精读] 值得阅读其讨论部分关于水生生境如何重塑温度–性状关系的机制阐述，以及对叶经济谱概念拓展的理论贡献。
