item.title: Extending the leaf economics spectrum: Freshwater plant communities exhibit realm‐specific leaf adaptations
item.abstract: Abstract The leaf economics spectrum bridges plant demography with terrestrial biodiversity gradients, community ecology and ecosystem functions, providing a framework for the mechanisms underlying ecosystem change. However, our understanding of whether this framework applies to aquatic plant communities and how their biogeography is shaped by their unique adaptations to life in water is limited. Moreover, it remains unclear whether leaf trait expression of aquatic plants responds to changes in environmental conditions differently depending on their life form (i.e. emergent, submerged). Here, we compiled a dataset of community composition for 6953 lake and river plant communities across Europe. We appended leaf trait data and environmental data to each community. Then, we calculated the community mean traits for emergent and submerged plant communities to determine their position along the leaf economics spectrum and how they deviate from terrestrial expectations. We used Gaussian multivariate mixed linear regression models to investigate life form‐specific variation in trait‐environment relationships. We find that emergent communities exhibit trait–environment relationships comparable to terrestrial predictions, with high bicarbonate and phosphorus concentrations, and warm temperatures selecting for acquisitive leaf traits. In contrast, acquisitive submerged communities are selected for by high bicarbonate and low temperature, and not by phosphorus availability. We attribute these differences to freshwater‐specific adaptations which influence the leaf economics of submerged communities more profoundly than emergent communities, since submerged plants grow in particularly challenging conditions with respect to light and gas availability. These findings suggest that aquatic plants have adaptations to their unique environments that require trade‐offs between leaf form and function to facilitate underwater metabolism, which pushes the boundaries of the leaf economics spectrum. Synthesis . Our ability to apply existing knowledge of leaf economics based on terrestrial plants to the aquatic realm is limited, especially with respect to the influence of temperature on plant growth, which is key for predicting the impacts of climate change on vegetation globally. Our findings highlight the importance of a realm‐specific approach for linking functional traits to freshwater ecosystem functioning and biodiversity, as the distinct responses of freshwater plants to their environment are not captured by terrestrial‐derived frameworks.

item.title: Geographic variation in diaspore traits and home‐site advantage in ant‐mediated dispersal
item.abstract: Abstract Ant‐mediated seed dispersal (myrmecochory) is a widespread mutualism in which ants selectively transport diaspores based on their morphological and chemical traits. Although diaspore traits are proposed to reflect adaptation to local ant communities, empirical evidence linking geographic variation in these traits to dispersal outcomes remains limited. Here, we investigated population differentiation in diaspore traits and their consequences for ant‐mediated dispersal in the myrmecochorous plant Coreanomecon hylomeconoides , an endemic species of the Korean Peninsula. We assessed geographic variation in diaspore mass‐related traits and elaiosome fatty acid composition across seven natural populations. In addition, we conducted reciprocal cafeteria experiments across the habitats of these populations, in which diaspores from different source populations were simultaneously offered to ants at both home and away sites. Time to diaspore removal by ants was used as a proxy for a fitness component and was analysed using mixed‐effects Cox proportional hazards models. Diaspore traits varied significantly among populations, including traits that may influence ant‐carrying behaviour. Ant‐mediated diaspore removal depended on source population at four of the seven sites, with marginal evidence at one additional site. Among these five sites, diaspores from the local population were removed more rapidly than those from non‐local populations at three sites, consistent with a home‐site advantage, whereas such an advantage was absent at the other two sites. Mass‐related diaspore traits influenced ant removal responses, but the strength and direction of these effects differed among sites. Chemical traits related to fatty acid composition affected ant behaviour at two of the five sites included in trait‐based analyses. Synthesis . Our results demonstrate that ant‐mediated selection on diaspore traits varies geographically, possibly resulting in uneven expression of home‐site advantage across populations. This spatial heterogeneity is consistent with predictions from the geographic mosaic theory of coevolution and highlights the importance of evolutionary ecological context in shaping mutualistic interactions across a species' range.
authors: Dongyeob Lee, Tae‐Young Kim, Hyejin Park, Eunsuk Kim

score.title: Partitioning tree growth into light interception and use efficiencies clarifies the role of light competition in secondary forest succession
score.summary: [背景] 光竞争是驱动物种高度生长和次生演替的基本力量，但因自然林中光拦截测量困难，个体水平光拦截与生长的成本收益仍不明晰。[方法] 本研究在日本北海道12个不同林龄的次生林中，对所有胸径>1cm树木，利用3D树冠几何与林内光环境剖面原位测量光拦截，将相对生长率(RGR)分解为光拦截效率(LIE，单位地上生物量拦截的光)和光利用效率(LUE，单位拦截光获得的生物量)，即RGR = LIE × LUE。[发现] 在幼龄林，RGR与树高正相关，驱动快速垂直分层；老林则关系减弱甚至逆转。较高树木LIE始终更高，体现大小非对称竞争，但LUE持续低于较矮树木。幼林中高LIE优势超过低LUE，老林高LIE优势降低而小树LUE上升，削弱冠层个体生长优势，促进林下更新。[贡献] 提出机械论框架阐明光竞争驱动森林动态的机制：从快速分层到结构稳定的转变受控于个体大小依赖的光拦截与利用效率间平衡的移动。[局限] 仅限北海道单一区域和特定森林类型，未检验不同干扰体制或物种组成下的适用性。[精读] 光拦截测量方法和分解框架具有可复用性，值得精读方法部分。

item.title: Partitioning tree growth into light interception and use efficiencies clarifies the role of light competition in secondary forest succession
item.abstract: Abstract Light competition is a fundamental force driving tree height growth and secondary succession. However, the costs and benefits of light interception and growth at the individual tree level remain poorly understood, largely due to the technical challenges of measuring light interception in natural forests. By adopting in situ measurement of light interception with a novel analytical framework, we decomposed the individual relative growth rate (RGR) into two components: light interception efficiency (LIE), defined as light intercepted per unit of above‐ground biomass, and light use efficiency (LUE), defined as biomass gain per unit of intercepted light (that is, RGR = LIE × LUE). Using this analytical framework, we analysed individual tree growth rates in relation to light interception and use to examine how light competition drives size variations and its consequences for forest development during secondary succession. This study was carried out in 12 forest stands of varying ages in Hokkaido, Japan. For all co‐occurring trees with stem diameters >1 cm, we quantified growth and light interception using 3D crown geometries and forest light profiles. In young stands, RGR was positively correlated with tree height, driving rapid vertical growth and stratification. In older stands, this relationship weakened or reversed, contributing to size‐structure stabilization and the coexistence of different size species. Across all stages, taller trees had higher LIE, indicating size‐asymmetric competition. Conversely, taller trees had consistently lower LUE than shorter trees, likely due to ecophysiological constraints. In young stands, the advantage of higher LIE outweighed the lower LUE of taller trees, resulting in their higher RGR. In older stands, the relative benefit of higher LIE diminished while the LUE of smaller trees increased; this reduced the growth advantage of canopy individuals and promoted the regeneration of the understory. Synthesis . This mechanistic framework clarifies how light competition drives forest dynamics. The transition from rapid height stratification to structural stabilization and species coexistence is governed by the shifting balance between size‐dependent light interception and use efficiencies.
authors: Yusuke Onoda, Tomonari Matsuo, Keito Kobayashi, Tsutom Hiura

score.summary: [背景]气候变化正导致落基山脉森林更新失败，但限制更新的具体因素不明，早期阶段被认为是关键瓶颈。[方法]在科罗拉多Front Range沿大气候梯度原位播种五种常见针叶树（Picea engelmannii, Pinus contorta, Pinus flexilis, Pinus ponderosa, Pseudotsuga menziesii），每个物种使用3–5个区域种群，研究种子萌发、第一生长季存活和2–3年建立率。研究年份生长季温度跨度5°C，降水跨度175%。[发现]1）种子质量与萌发、存活及建立显著正相关；2）温度×降水交互作用显著，高温促进萌发但剧烈降低初期存活，高降水可缓解；3）所有物种在降水高于原产地20–60%时存活最优，干燥条件存活陡降；4）幼苗建立率不足初期存活一半，气候过滤持续至后期；5）物种分布模型显示即使低排放情景下，当前分布区低海拔也将大面积更新失败。[贡献]揭示了气候特别是干旱对针叶树早期更新的强烈限制，强调即使适应性种群也难以应对热干条件，对辅助迁移策略提出警示。[局限]研究限于单一区域和少数物种，未考虑干扰等其他因素；模型预测依赖排放情景。[精读]实验设计中的种子来源与种群适应差异，以及存活对降水阈值响应值得深入分析，建议精读结果部分。

item.title: Higher temperatures and low precipitation strongly decrease conifer recruitment in the Rocky Mountains even in heat‐adapted species and populations
item.abstract: Abstract Climate change is triggering recruitment failures in Rocky Mountain forests, yet the specific factors limiting regeneration remain unclear. Studies of established seedlings suggest the very earliest stages of recruitment are a key bottleneck in regeneration resilience, which we hypothesize is caused by the acute sensitivity of conifer germinants to climate. In this study, we asked how climate impacts rates of seed germination, initial (first growing‐season) survivorship and seedling establishment (2‐ or 3‐year survivorship after the first growing‐season) in Colorado Front Range forests, USA. We sowed in situ seeds of common tree species— Picea engelmannii , Pinus contorta , Pinus flexilis , Pinus ponderosa and Pseudotsuga menziesii —over a large climate gradient. Using seeds sourced across the wider region, 3–5 populations of each species were sown to explore how local adaptation in recruitment varies with climate. We expected strong inter‐ and intraspecific differences, predicting seeds from warmer and drier distributions experience higher recruitment. The study years encompassed a 5°C range in growing‐season temperatures and a 175% range in growing‐season precipitation. Rates of mean germination ( r = 0.935), initial survivorship ( r = 0.786) and seedling establishment ( r = 0.709) were strongly correlated with the seed mass of the species. For all species, temperature × precipitation interactions were important, while higher temperatures alone increased germination but markedly decreased initial survivorship. Initial survivorship was significantly higher overall in wetter conditions and for P. flexilis , P. ponderosa and P. menziesii , survivorship remained robust even in the hottest temperatures when precipitation was also high. Intraspecific differences were evident, as seedlings of all species had optimal initial survivorship in precipitation ~20%–60% higher than origin and negligible or steeply declining initial survivorship in conditions drier than origin. Synthesis . Climate was the overriding influence on regeneration patterns in this study. Although regeneration may prove resilient to hotter conditions in areas with sufficient precipitation, low recruitment for all populations when both hot and dry indicates assisted migration efforts require better‐adapted populations than used in this study. score.title: Boldness and niche width structure spatial interactions in a natural rodent community
score.summary: [背景] 动物个体间一致的行为差异（个性）可能影响空间分布和资源利用，进而影响竞争与共存，但过去研究多限于物种对，缺乏对完整多物种群落的探讨。[方法] 本研究在由四种共存的野生啮齿动物组成的自然群落中，通过野外标记重捕、行为测定（大胆程度）和空间分析，检验大胆程度对空间利用及种内、种间空间互作的预测作用，并考察生态位宽度（泛化种 vs 特化种）的调节效应。[发现] 1) 所有物种中，大胆个体拥有更大的核心领域和家域，显示个性依赖的空间利用差异普遍存在。2) 微生境利用与邻居密度与大胆程度无关。3) 个性依赖的空间结构主要体现在空间邻近度和生态相似个体间的遭遇概率上，表明行为效应具有情境依赖性，在相似竞争者及距离度量中更明显。4) 大胆程度主要关联空间利用方式，对空间遭遇网络的影响较弱，且在泛化种与特化种间表现不同。[贡献] 将个性-空间互作研究从两物种拓展至完整群落，揭示了行为类型如何促进个体生态位分化，为理解群落空间结构的行为机制提供了实证。[局限] 基于短期数据，空间遭遇为推断而非观察；未考虑季节动态；结论限于特定啮齿动物群落。[精读] 行为与群落生态交叉的创新框架值得细读，但若关注其他类群或生态系统，方法可借鉴，结论需谨慎推广。

item.title: Boldness and niche width structure spatial interactions in a natural rodent community
item.abstract: Abstract Consistent among‐individual differences in behaviour can influence how individuals distribute in and use space, and thus influence competition within and between species, with potential consequences for species coexistence. These behavioural traits help characterize ecological niches, particularly under varying intensities of interspecific competition. While previous work examined behavioural type–dependent spatial interactions between pairs of ecologically similar species, here we extend those analyses to a full multi‐species community context, including newly analysed species. In a natural rodent community of four co‐occurring species, we tested whether boldness predicts space use and spatial interactions within and across species of varying ecological similarity. Boldness covaried positively with core area and home range size across all species, indicating consistent behavioural type–dependent differences in space use. In contrast, microhabitat use and neighbour density showed little association with boldness. Evidence for personality–dependent spatial structuring emerged primarily in metrics capturing spatial proximity and ecologically similar encounters, suggesting that behavioural effects on interactions are context dependent, being most evident among ecologically similar competitors and in distance‐based measures of spatial interactions. Overall, our results suggest that boldness is most clearly linked to how individuals use space, whereas effects on spatial encounter structure within the community are weaker and appear to differ between the relatively more generalist and more specialist species in the community with respect to habitat use and diet. These findings support the idea that behavioural type–dependent space use can contribute to individual niche differentiation and may influence how potential interactions are distributed within ecological communities.

score.title: Optimising daily sampling of plant–bee interaction networks
score.summary: [背景]植物-传粉者互作在一天内可发生小时尺度变化，但野外采样常以单一时段为主，导致日内互作变异被忽视，网络结构认知不完整，并可能影响对群落过程的推断。[方法]研究在巴西Cerrado两个开花季，于白天划分6个2小时时段进行植物-蜜蜂互作高强度抽样，通过比较时段间网络β多样性和结构属性（模块化、特化、嵌套性），并利用阶乘法合并不同时段数据，评估部分天数网络与全天完整网络的差异，以及恢复全部互作信息和网络结构所需的最优时段组合。[发现]1)网络指标在白天显著变化：从早到晚模块化和特化度下降、嵌套性上升；2)互作β多样性随时段间隔增大而增加，主要由物种重连驱动；3)合并四个2小时时段（约8小时）可恢复约80%的互作对和82%的互作频率，且生成的部分网络结构与全天网络最相似；4)最优时段组合集中于日间中心时段，清晨和傍晚贡献较少但独特的互作。[贡献]为传粉网络研究提供了首个系统性的日内动态评估和采样优化框架，可推广至其他时间敏感性互作系统。[局限]研究局限于单一生境（热带稀树草原）与日间时段，结论的外推性有待验证；未考虑夜间传粉者。[精读]方法的采样策略评估框架具一定参考价值，但整体与用户当前核心研究任务相关度较低。

item.title: Optimising daily sampling of plant–bee interaction networks
item.abstract: Abstract Plant–pollinator interactions are dynamic not only across seasons but also over hourly time scales, even beyond the day–night contrast. However, capturing the daily temporal variability of pollination networks during field data collection is challenging. Consequently, our understanding of daily variation in network composition and structure remains incomplete due to limited sampling coverage. Moreover, inaccurate sampling protocols can result in missing links that impair the identification of underlying processes and emerging patterns. We address this gap by studying the fine‐scale temporal organisation of the diverse diurnal plant–bee relationships and examining how the interaction composition and network structure fluctuate throughout the day. We extensively sampled plant–bee interactions in a Brazilian Cerrado over two flowering seasons, encompassing six 2‐h sampling periods throughout the day. We compared interaction β‐diversity and network structural properties across sampling periods. A factorial approach was used to merge interactions among all combinations of sampling periods to assess how the composition and structure of the partial‐day networks deviated from those exhibited by the full‐day network (i.e. consolidating all interactions). Plant–bee interactions exhibited notable variations in network metrics across daily sampling periods. From dawn to dusk, plant–bee networks showed reduced modularity and specialisation but greater nestedness. Interaction β‐diversity between sampling periods increased progressively with wider temporal intervals, mainly explained by interaction rewiring among shared species. Combining four 2‐h sampling periods recovered up to ~80% of all pairwise interactions and ~ 82% of interaction frequencies, and generated partial‐day networks that most closely resembled the structure of full‐day networks. These best‐performing combinations consistently drew from daily central hours, whereas early‐morning and late‐afternoon periods contributed fewer but unique interactions. Our study demonstrates that plant–bee interaction networks are time‐sensitive at the intraday scale and that interaction completeness is not necessarily improved by increasing effort within a single time window, but rather by distributing sampling across, or focusing on, the most informative periods of the day. We provide a general framework to evaluate how temporal sampling design affects network representativeness in systems where interactions depend on time‐of‐day.

score.title: The role of viability selection in shaping short‐ and long‐term consequences of early‐life conditions: An experiment in the Alpine swift
score.summary: [背景] 早期环境条件能塑造个体的生长、形态和存活，并对其成年后的适合度产生持续影响，但存活至成年的个体往往经过强烈筛选，这种“缺失部分”可能导致对发育环境效应的推断产生偏差。[方法] 该研究在瑞士阿尔卑斯山的高山雨燕（Tachymarptis melba）野生种群中，通过2003–2006年对45对巢进行窝卵数操纵（扩大或缩小），改变雏鸟期同胞竞争和资源可得性，并追踪这些个体直到2019年的整个生活史，记录生长、存活、招募和繁殖表现。[发现] 1) 扩大窝卵数降低了雏鸟平均生长和存活率，但增加了表型变异；雏鸟更小、出飞更晚且招募率更低。2) 招募概率随雏鸟体型增大而升高，表明发育表型受到强烈存活选择；因此扩大窝组中成功招募的个体是非随机的、体型较大的高质量子集，成年后处理组间的形态差异消失。3) 尽管招募率低，扩大窝组个体成年后表现出同等或更高的终身繁殖产出，主要通过更频繁的繁殖尝试实现；年龄特化分析显示繁殖表现模式同时受个体内变化和选择性消失驱动。[贡献] 揭示了早期生活条件对生活史轨迹的影响并非通过直接发育效应，而是通过成年前的存活选择（viability selection）塑造了成年群体的组成，纠正了可观察到成年优势应归因于早期逆境的常见误判。[局限] 研究基于单一物种和单一环境，野外操纵未完全控制亲本质量等混杂因素，且部分长期生存数据可能受迁徙和重捕率影响。[精读] 该文清晰展示了如何通过长期数据区分选择效应和可塑性效应，其分析框架（如年龄特化模型、反事实推理）对研究生活史权衡和早期环境影响具有方法学参考价值，但若用户关注植物或群落尺度的干扰响应，则借鉴意义有限。

item.title: The role of viability selection in shaping short‐ and long‐term consequences of early‐life conditions: An experiment in the Alpine swift
item.abstract: Abstract Environmental conditions experienced early in life can shape growth, morphology and survival, and can have lasting effects on individuals that survive to adulthood. Understanding how early‐life conditions affect fitness components across the life cycle is therefore essential for predicting variation in life‐history trajectories and their ecological and evolutionary consequences. We experimentally tested for short‐ and long‐term effects of early growth conditions by manipulating brood size in a wild population of the long‐lived Alpine swift Tachymarptis melba . Enlarging or reducing brood size alters sibling competition and per capita resource availability, with potential consequences on resource allocation between growth and self‐maintenance. We manipulated 45 pairs of broods between 2003 and 2006 and followed the offspring throughout their lives until 2019. Brood enlargement reduced average growth and survival, while increasing phenotypic variability among nestlings. Nestlings from enlarged broods were smaller, fledged later, and had lower survival to fledging and recruitment. Recruitment probability increased with nestling size, indicating strong selection on developmental phenotype. Consequently, nestlings from enlarged broods that recruited were a non‐random subset of bigger, higher‐quality individuals, and morphological differences between treatments disappeared among adults. Despite lower recruitment, individuals from enlarged broods showed equal or higher lifetime reproductive output, primarily through more frequent breeding attempts. Age‐specific analyses showed that reproductive performance patterns reflected both within‐individual changes and selective disappearance among individuals. We discuss how early‐life conditions shape life‐history trajectories through both developmental effects and selection acting before adulthood, arguing that apparent advantages in adult performance among individuals from harsher developmental environments arise from viability selection rather than beneficial effects of early‐life stress. Our findings show how missing‐fraction problems can bias inferences about fitness when early‐life mortality is ignored, highlighting the need to integrate early survival when evaluating the lifelong consequences of developmental environments.

item.summary: [背景] 早期环境条件能塑造个体的生长、形态和存活，并对其成年后的适合度产生持续影响，但存活至成年的个体往往经过强烈筛选，这种“缺失部分”可能导致对发育环境效应的推断产生偏差。[方法] 该研究在瑞士阿尔卑斯山的高山雨燕（Tachymarptis melba）野生种群中，通过2003–2006年对45对巢进行窝卵数操纵（扩大或缩小），改变雏鸟期同胞竞争和资源可得性，并追踪这些个体直到2019年的整个生活史，记录生长、存活、招募和繁殖表现。[发现] 1) 扩大窝卵数降低了雏鸟平均生长和存活率，但增加了表型变异；雏鸟更小、出飞更晚且招募率更低。2) 招募概率随雏鸟体型增大而升高，表明发育表型受到强烈存活选择；因此扩大窝组中成功招募的个体是非随机的、体型较大的高质量子集，成年后处理组间的形态差异消失。3) 尽管招募率低，扩大窝组个体成年后表现出同等或更高的终身繁殖产出，主要通过更频繁的繁殖尝试实现；年龄特化分析显示繁殖表现模式同时受个体内变化和选择性消失驱动。[贡献] 揭示了早期生活条件对生活史轨迹的影响并非通过直接发育效应，而是通过成年前的存活选择（viability selection）塑造了成年群体的组成，纠正了可观察到成年优势应归因于早期逆境的常见误判。[局限] 研究基于单一物种和单一环境，野外操纵未完全控制亲本质量等混杂因素，且部分长期生存数据可能受迁徙和重捕率影响。[精读] 该文清晰展示了如何通过长期数据区分选择效应和可塑性效应，其分析框架（如年龄特化模型、反事实推理）对研究生活史权衡和早期环境影响具有方法学参考价值，但若用户关注植物或群落尺度的干扰响应，则借鉴意义有限。

score.summary: [背景] 淡水生物面临全球性威胁，人工屏障造成的片段化对鱼类迁移影响显著，但现有研究多关注成鱼迁徙阶段，缺乏对幼鱼在栖息地内的障碍物穿越行为及生态情景依赖性的了解。[方法] 本研究利用半自然水槽和析因设计，检验两种常见堰型（垂直堰和V形堰）对鲑幼鱼运动的影响，并模拟风险-奖励条件（捕食者模型和化学食饵线索），分析接近、评估、尝试和穿越行为。[发现] 1) 两种堰型均显著阻碍鱼类运动，V形堰挑战略大；2) 捕食风险显著降低鱼类接近屏障的概率和速度，缩短穿越时间；3) 食饵线索影响有限，仅与捕食者存在交互作用影响评估持续时间。[贡献] 首次揭示鲑幼鱼屏障穿越行为受捕食风险调节，强调屏障影响的情景依赖性，为屏障移除决策提供新视角。[局限] 实验在半自然水槽进行，可能未完全反映野外复杂流场和生态网络效应；仅测试了两种堰型。[精读] 可详细阅读实验设计部分对于情景依赖性分析的思路。

item.title: Enter Salmon: Trophic risk mediates riverine barrier‐crossing behaviours of parr
item.abstract: Abstract Freshwater biota are highly threatened by global stressors, among which fragmentation by artificial barriers has gained increasing attention in recent years. Barriers limit the movements of native species, notably the migrations of keystone fish, such as Atlantic salmon ( Salmo salar ), with ecological and socio‐economic consequences. The severity of barrier impacts on salmon smolt and adult migratory stages has widely overshadowed the effects on juvenile river‐resident stages, despite the importance of habitat availability during these years. We present the first study of crossing behaviours displayed by salmon parr traversing obstacles while considering trophic context‐dependencies. Using semi‐natural flume tanks and a multifactorial design, we examined two of the most common weir designs (vertical and v‐notch) and simulated risk–reward conditions (model predator and chemosensory food resource cues), with approaching, assessing, attempting and crossing behaviours analysed. We found that fish movements throughout the tank were significantly impeded by both barrier designs compared to barrier‐free controls, of which the v‐notch presented a moderately greater challenge. These effects were further mediated by perceived predatory threat, with the presence of a potential predator significantly reducing the probability and latency of fish approaching, reducing the probability of assessing the barrier, as well as shortening the average duration of barrier crossings. Resource presence had minimal effects on the behaviours investigated, except for a significant interaction with predator presence influencing assessment duration. Our study demonstrates that barriers, regardless of their design, place significant limitations on habitats available to parr by reducing overall movement in the system. However, the behaviour of salmon parr around artificial barriers is context‐dependent, highlighting the complexity of fish‐barrier interactions and raising important questions about the potential benefits and unknown consequences of barrier removals within existing ecological networks.

score.summary: [背景] 五大湖沿岸淡水湿地兼具候鸟栖息地和削减流域氮磷负荷的双重生态功能，但水鸟通过排泄物输入养分（动物地球化学效应）对此类管理湿地的养分收支和藻类群落的影响尚不明确。[方法] 研究选取伊利湖两处湿地，连续一年双周监测三种功能群水鸟密度，结合排泄物养分含量与排泄率估算年氮磷通量，并与流域径流监测负荷对比；同时开展微宇宙实验，添加不同功能群的鸟粪，测定水体养分浓度变化及底栖藻类群落响应。[发现] 鸟粪添加初期微宇宙水体氮磷浓度上升，但底泥迅速去除大部分总磷，仅去除约一半总氮；不同功能群鸟粪因其总氮含量差异，促进不同的藻类群落；水鸟养分通量在秋季迁徙期达到峰值，在养分限制时段可能局部重要，但全年通量相对于流域负荷常常可忽略。[贡献] 揭示水鸟功能群特异性养分效应，为兼顾水鸟栖息地保护与湿地脱氮除磷的管理提供依据。[局限] 实验仅限两处湿地，微宇宙条件可能高估养分去除速率，年度通量估算存在不确定性，且未考虑其他环境因素。[精读] 该研究与当前核心任务关联极低，无需精读。

item.title: Waterbird zoogeochemical effects shape wetland nutrient dynamics and algal communities in Laurentian Great Lakes coastal freshwater wetlands
item.abstract: Abstract Freshwater wetlands along the Laurentian Great Lakes provide vital ecosystem services, two of which include providing habitat for millions of waterfowl and reducing nutrient (nitrogen (N) and phosphorus (P)) runoff from the landscape. Nutrient bioavailability in wetlands is influenced by waterbirds, which shape biogeochemical dynamics through the excretion of N‐ and P‐rich guano. There has been limited focus on how waterbirds shape nutrient budgets (i.e. via zoogeochemical effects) in wetlands that are managed for both waterfowl habitat and nutrient retention. Therefore, we examined how three distinct functional groups of common waterbirds influence nutrient biogeochemistry and algal community structure in two coastal freshwater wetlands along Lake Erie (Ohio, USA). We experimentally measured how waterbird‐derived nutrient contributions shape wetland nutrient removal and elicit changes in algal community composition through experimental additions of guano to microcosms. We collected biweekly waterbird densities throughout 1 year and used guano nutrient content and dropping rates to estimate annual waterbird N and P fluxes. We then assessed the relative importance of waterbird‐nutrient contributions through comparisons to previously monitored net nutrient loads from landscape runoff. Waterbird guano additions initially increased nutrient concentrations in microcosms; however, wetland sediments rapidly removed most of the total P, but only approximately half of the total N from the water column. Waterbird guano from different functional groups favoured distinct algal communities, driven primarily by differences in guano total N content. Waterbird‐derived nutrient fluxes were highest during fall migration and may be locally important in wetlands during nutrient‐limiting times. However, annual waterbird‐derived nutrient fluxes are often negligible ( By understanding the zoogeochemical effects that waterbirds have in freshwaters, we can inform management decisions that simultaneously protect waterfowl habitat and enhance nutrient removal processes to maximize multiple ecosystem services in the Great Lakes region.

score.summary: [背景] 蚂蚁介导的种子传播是季节性干旱热带森林的关键生态服务，但在人为改造景观中可能受局地和景观尺度环境因素影响。[方法] 在巴西东北部卡廷加旱生森林的雨养耕地和自然植被残存中，通过标准化诱饵实验测量种子移除和清洁，并根据蚂蚁体型分类传播质量。[发现] 1) 耕地支持更多高质量互作，土壤pH和沙含量影响互作质量；2) 景观尺度上，水可用性和破碎化降低种子传播组分，而土地利用异质性通过小型耐干扰蚂蚁增加了总互作量；3) 不同蚂蚁类群在种子清洁和移除上存在功能互补，受栖息地和景观因子调控。[贡献] 揭示了小规模雨养农业景观仍能维持蚂蚁种子传播的功能组分，对旱生森林恢复有潜在价值。[局限] 未直接评估植物定殖和长期恢复效果。[精读] 实验设计清晰，结果对理解干扰景观中生态功能维持有参考意义，方法部分值得细读。

item.title: Landscape configuration and soil properties shape ant‐mediated seed dispersal in tropical dry forest agricultural landscapes
item.abstract: Abstract Ant‐mediated seed dispersal is a key ecological service in seasonally dry tropical forests, contributing to plant regeneration and ecosystem resilience. In human‐modified landscapes, however, the quality and quantity of these interactions may be altered by local and landscape‐scale environmental factors. We investigated how soil properties and landscape aspects influence ant‐mediated seed dispersal in rainfed croplands and natural vegetation remnants within the Caatinga, a dry forest biome in northeastern Brazil. Seed removal and seed cleaning were measured using standardized bait experiments, and interacting ant species were classified by dispersal quality based on body size. Habitat, soil and landscape context jointly shaped ant‐mediated seed dispersal. Croplands supported more high‐quality interactions, while soil pH and sand content influenced interaction quality. At the landscape scale, water availability and fragmentation reduced seed dispersal components, whereas land‐use heterogeneity increased total interactions, likely through small‐bodied, disturbance‐tolerant ants. Distinct ant groups provided different seed dispersal components (cleaning vs removal), shaped by habitat and landscape factors. While plant recruitment and long‐term recovery were not directly assessed, our findings indicate that small‐scale rainfed agricultural landscapes can support functional components of ant‐mediated seed dispersal with potential relevance for dry forest regeneration.

score.summary: [背景]高致病性禽流感暴发导致海鸟大量死亡，但传播模式和流行病学参数尚不明确。北方塘鹅是受影响严重物种。[方法]研究利用集合种群流行病学模型，拟合东北大西洋塘鹅繁殖群及周边死亡率计数数据，估计关键参数并分离外部传播途径。[发现]1) 种间传播是暴发的主要外部驱动因素，造成整个繁殖集合种群28%的额外死亡率（95% CI 21%–34%）；2) 集落内传播率随密度降低而下降；3) 集落间空间传播半距离为5 km；4) 外部感染源（可能来自其他海鸟）的半距离为66 km。[贡献]该研究展示了从死亡数据中提取流行病学见解的方法，并为跨洲传播提供了早期预警框架，主张将集群物种纳入全球禽流感监测。[局限]死亡计数数据可能低估亚致死效应和未报告死亡，且模型假设的外部感染源未经验证。[精读]该文的建模方法和多尺度分析思路值得进一步研读。

item.title: Between‐species contagion drives HPAI transmission and mass mortality in seabirds
item.abstract: Abstract The unprecedented avian panzootic caused by High‐Pathogenicity Avian Influenza (HPAI) caused widespread mortality in seabird populations, but the exact scales and patterns of transmission, basic epidemiological parameters and mortality outcomes are unknown. Mass mortalities combined with potentially detrimental sub‐lethal effects of exposure will have currently unpredictable consequences for population viability of affected wild bird species, many of which are already subjected to acute anthropogenic pressures. Here, we focus on one of the most severely affected seabird species, the Northern gannet ( Morus bassanus ). Using a metapopulation epidemiological framework, fitted to counts of dead gannets in or near gannet breeding colonies across the NorthEast Atlantic, we estimate key epidemiological parameters, quantify spatial patterns of mortality and isolate external transmission routes. Our epidemiological parameter estimates suggest that the 2022 strains of HPAI were highly virulent and transmissible over wide geographical ranges, within the gannet network and beyond. Within gannet colonies, we found evidence that transmission rates may have declined as mortality reduced local breeding density. Inter‐colony spread in the network declined with distance, and epidemiological connectivity had an estimated half‐distance of 5 km. Large‐scale outbreak initiation was best explained by external infection sources, most likely, other seabird species, with an estimated half‐distance of 66 km. Our modelling suggests that these multi‐scale, multispecies processes resulted in 28% (95% CI: 21%–34%) HPAI‐mortality across the Northeast Atlantic gannet breeding metapopulation, in addition to normal levels of annual mortality (5%–10%). Our study demonstrates that if analysed holistically, carcass data can provide epidemiological insights but also act as an early warning system for continent‐wide patterns of spread. For pandemic preparedness, it is essential that data‐integrative approaches such as ours are placed in the mainstream toolbox of planetary health monitoring. By disentangling intra‐ and inter‐specific transmission, our approach highlights the need to integrate colonial species into global avian influenza surveillance and response.
authors: Jason Matthiopoulos, Stephen Votier, Sarah Wanless, Emma Cunningham, Jude V. Lane, Jana W. E. Jeglinski

score.title: Convergent digestive adaptation to resource limitation in an insular lizard across a microgeographic archipelago
score.summary: [背景] 岛屿系统为研究生态约束驱动生理进化提供了天然实验室。尽管已知食性转变影响岛屿蜥蜴的形态分化，但其对消化生理的影响仍不清楚。[方法] 研究以斯凯罗斯岛壁蜥（Podarcis gaigeae）的10个野生种群为对象，横跨斯凯罗斯群岛，在标准化实验室条件下测定了节肢动物丰度、胃肠道形态、肠道通过时间、消化酶活性和表观消化效率（ADE）。[发现] 1) 与主岛种群相比，小岛种群肠道通过更慢、胃肠道更长、蛋白酶和脂肪酶活性更高、ADE也更高，表明在资源受限环境中消化性能增强。2) 基于AICc的模型选择显示，猎物可得性和生境类型（而非地理距离或遗传亲缘关系）最能解释种群间消化分化的格局。3) 这些结果展示了面对资源稀缺时反复且独立的适应性响应，凸显消化可塑性是维持岛屿栖息地生存的关键机制。[贡献] 首次在微地理尺度上揭示岛屿蜥蜴消化生理的趋同适应，为资源限制驱动消化表型进化提供了实证，扩展了对岛屿适应性辐射的理解。[局限] 研究仅基于单一岛屿群岛，且未直接追踪个体能量预算或繁殖产出；消化性能的适应性意义有待长期监测验证。[精读] 无需精读，与用户研究方向无关。

item.title: Convergent digestive adaptation to resource limitation in an insular lizard across a microgeographic archipelago
item.abstract: Abstract Island systems provide valuable natural laboratories for investigating how ecological constraints drive physiological evolution. Although dietary shifts are known to influence morphological divergence in insular lizards, their consequences for digestive physiology remain insufficiently understood. Using 10 wild populations of the Skyros wall lizard ( Podarcis gaigeae ) across the Skyros Archipelago, we tested whether fine‐scale variation in habitat and prey availability predicts divergence in digestive performance. We quantified arthropod abundance, gastrointestinal morphology, gut passage time, digestive enzyme activity and apparent digestive efficiency (ADE) under standardized laboratory conditions. Islet populations consistently exhibited slower gut passage, longer gastrointestinal tracts, higher protease and lipase activities, and greater ADE relative to populations on the main island of Skyros, indicating enhanced digestive performance in resource‐limited environments. AIC C ‐based model selection showed that prey availability and habitat type, rather than geographic distance or genetic relatedness, best explained patterns of digestive divergence among populations. These results demonstrate repeated and independent adaptive responses to resource scarcity and highlight digestive plasticity as a key mechanism facilitating persistence in insular habitats.

item.title: Nest‐box supplementation can amplify intraspecific exploitation: RFID reveals frequent nest switching and lower fledging success in barn owls
item.abstract: Abstract Nest‐box supplementation is widely used to increase populations of barn owls ( Tyto alba ) for environmentally friendly rodent control in agricultural landscapes. Program effectiveness is typically evaluated using coarse metrics such as nest occupancy or fledgling counts, which may overlook density‐dependent processes that reduce individual survival and recruitment. We used continuous radio‐frequency identification (RFID) monitoring to test whether high breeding density in a nest‐box network promotes nest switching by fledglings and is associated with reduced fledging success in host broods. Across two breeding seasons (2020–2021), we PIT‐tagged 464 nestlings and 108 adults and monitored 50 active nest boxes, recording over 1.2 million individual detections. Nest switching was common: 12.9% of tagged fledglings visited foreign nests, and 54% of monitored nest boxes were visited by at least one nest switcher. Nest‐switcher rate increased with local nest‐box density and decreased with host brood age but was unrelated to female provisioning, measured as parental prey‐delivery rate. The number of fledglings produced per nest was not associated with nest‐switching rate. By contrast, fledging success declined with increasing nest‐switcher rate, indicating a negative association that was not detected by brood size or fledgling counts alone. Synthesis and applications: High breeding density in nest box‐based biological control programs can unintentionally increase intraspecific exploitation, reducing fledging success even when apparent reproductive output remains high. Management evaluations should move beyond occupancy and fledgling counts to include individual‐level performance metrics, such as fledging success. Where possible, nest‐box programs should avoid extreme local clustering of simultaneously active broods and monitor high‐density breeding systems for density‐dependent interactions that can undermine long‐term effectiveness. item.title: Environmental detection of the amphibian chytrid fungus in water bodies is associated with host infection along a deforestation gradient
item.abstract: Abstract Many wildlife pathogens can persist in the environment independently of their hosts, with the habitat itself serving as a reservoir and potential source of transmission. However, reliably detecting and quantifying free‐living pathogen stages across heterogeneous landscapes using environmental DNA methods remains challenging. Understanding how landcover and habitat structure drive pathogen distribution at the environmental and host levels is critical for advancing disease surveillance and ecology. Amphibian chytridiomycosis, caused by the fungal pathogen Batrachochytrium dendrobatidis ( Bd ), provides a useful model system to address these broader challenges, yet most studies have focused on host–pathogen interactions, with less emphasis on Bd within environmental reservoirs. Using Bd as a model system, we investigated whether pathogen distribution in natural aquatic environments is associated with host infection patterns across gradients of habitat loss. We sampled four tropical amphibian species across eight rainforest landscapes and quantified Bd in paired water and host samples using a high‐capacity water filtration method coupled with digital and real‐time quantitative polymerase chain reaction detection assays. Our results revealed a strong positive correlation between Bd DNA concentrations in water and infection loads on amphibian skin, indicating that environmental Bd DNA is associated with host infection patterns. Forest cover and habitat split (i.e. spatial separation between forests and aquatic breeding sites) were the primary predictors of Bd occurrence, concentration and infection load across environmental and host‐associated forms, and both Bd ‐GPL and Bd ‐Asia‐2/Brazil lineages were detected across our study landscapes. Our study introduces and validates a robust protocol for detecting environmental Bd , providing a scalable approach to quantify pathogen–environment associations across multiple landscapes and environmental gradients. Synthesis and applications : Linking environmental pathogen detection with host infection patterns can improve surveillance of diseases involving environmental transmission, particularly where direct host sampling is logistically challenging. This approach enables the identification of areas of elevated transmission risk and supports targeted monitoring and management under habitat loss and degradation. It also provides a practical tool to guide conservation actions in landscapes undergoing rapid land‐use change.

score.title: Same forest, different story: Beetle community responses to non‐native tree species depend on the vertical stratum
score.summary: [背景] 气候变化导致森林枯死加剧，林业管理常引入耐旱的非本地树种作为适应策略，但其对生物多样性的生态影响仍不明确。以往研究多局限于单一森林层次，无法全面评估非本地树种对跨层生物多样性的影响。[方法] 本文综合分析了北美花旗松的引入如何改变中欧森林甲虫群落在不同垂直层次（地面、林下层、冠层）的分类、功能和系统发育多样性。研究比较了包含或不含花旗松的四种林分类型：欧洲山毛榉纯林、挪威云杉纯林（在自然分布区外）、花旗松纯林以及山毛榉-云杉混交林和山毛榉-花旗松混交林。通过调查甲虫多样性数据，并结合冠层开阔度、枯木量、邻木多样性等环境变量，分析林分类型和垂直层次的影响。[发现] 1) 花旗松纯林在局域和区域尺度上均支持最低的甲虫多样性，且在冠层中差异最显著；2) 混交效应取决于伴生针叶树的种类：山毛榉-云杉混交林在地面层促进甲虫多样性，而山毛榉-花旗松混交林通常缓冲了纯林中冠层多样性的损失；3) 冠层开放性、枯木量和邻木多样性是影响各层多样性的关键因素；4) 冠层群落的组成和食性集团结构随层次升高而分化，表明冠层组合对宿主树种的依赖性更强。[贡献] 研究强调了在非本地树种造林影响评估中整合垂直分层的重要性，为气候适应型森林管理提供了生态学依据，证实混交林可缓解非本地树种的负面效应。[局限] 研究区域限于中欧森林，结论向其他生态系统推广需谨慎；未涉及其他生物类群或长期动态。[精读] 方法部分关于垂直分层采样设计和多样性多维评估值得仔细参考。

item.title: Same forest, different story: Beetle community responses to non‐native tree species depend on the vertical stratum
item.abstract: Abstract Increased forest diebacks under climate change necessitate adaptation strategies of forest management, which often include the use of drought‐resistant non‐native tree species. However, their planting has raised concerns about the ecological impacts on forest biodiversity and functioning. Relevant studies are largely limited to single forest strata, often focusing on ground or subcanopy communities, which prevents a comprehensive understanding of how biodiversity responds to changes in native and non‐native tree species identity and composition across forest strata. Here, we provide a synthesis of how the introduction of North American Douglas fir alters different facets of biodiversity across vertical strata in Central European forests. We focused on beetles, a hyperdiverse group of forest biota, and considered economically important stand types including and excluding Douglas fir, namely, monocultures and mixtures of native European beech, native Norway spruce planted outside its natural range and non‐native Douglas fir. Beetle diversity varied strongly among forest strata and stand types. Douglas fir monocultures consistently supported lower taxonomic, functional and phylogenetic diversity at both local (plot) and regional (landscape) scales compared with the other stand types, with the most pronounced differences observed in the canopy. Mixture effects depended on the identity of admixed conifers: beech–spruce mixtures favoured beetle diversity on the forest floor, whereas beech–Douglas fir mixtures generally buffered canopy beetle diversity losses observed in Douglas fir monocultures. Canopy openness, deadwood volume and tree neighbourhood diversity shaped biodiversity across all strata. Subcanopy communities generally depended most on environmental features, while canopy communities were strongly driven by tree species identity. Community composition and feeding‐guild structure diverged with increasing stratum height, especially when comparing beech‐ and conifer‐dominated stands, underscoring the sensitivity of canopy assemblages to host tree identity due to their direct contact with tree‐specific habitats and resources. Synthesis and applications . Our findings emphasize the importance of integrating vertical stratification into biodiversity monitoring for a comprehensive understanding of the ecological impacts of climate‐adapted forest management with non‐native tree species. Promoting mixed stands can mitigate negative biodiversity impacts of non‐native tree species and support the maintenance of multidimensional biodiversity of associated forest biota under climate‐driven forest reorganization.
authors: Sara Piccini, Benjamin Wildermuth, Dragan Matevski, Peter Kriegel, Alice Penanhoat, Dominik Seidel, Jonas Hagge, Martin M. Gossner, Andreas Schuldt

item.title: Growth, mortality and regeneration responses to ecological forestry treatments are shaped by local factors, species, and initial treatment impact
item.abstract: Abstract Ecological forestry rooted in natural disturbance‐based silviculture (NDBS) aims to help maintain or facilitate recovery of ecosystem structure and function toward conditions found in unharvested stands. In the short term, leaving a portion of a stand's merchantable trees intact at harvest should increase similarity in composition and function relative to stands following non‐stand‐replacing natural disturbances such as low‐intensity fires, windthrow, or insect outbreaks and thus maintain biodiversity and other ecosystem services. Testing NDBS requires long‐term data, while assessing the generality of responses to NDBS requires such data from multiple experiments across diverse stand and site conditions. To date, our understanding of forest responses to NDBS has been limited by a lack of opportunities to explore responses across time. In this study, we utilized data from three long‐term experiments encompassing 21 combinations of harvest treatments by stand type plus unharvested reference stands. These experiments provide data to assess responses for 12 to 20 years post‐treatment. We quantified the direction (increasing or decreasing), duration (persisting or transient), magnitude, and temporal dynamics of responses in stand‐level tree growth, mortality, and regeneration abundances. High‐intensity treatments (≥40%) produced strong initial impacts, particularly increased tree mortality (although not statistically significant across all treatments), which in turn had prolonged effects on stand‐level growth through reduced tree density. These treatments also promoted increased broadleaf regeneration, likely due to greater canopy opening and enhanced light availability. We observed an inconsistent stand‐level growth response to treatments, with some treatments showing initial decline while others eventually resulted in higher growth in harvested stands. In mixed stands, coniferous species showed growth benefits when coexisting with broadleaf species, possibly due to reduced intraspecific competition or improved access to resources mediated by broadleaf neighbours. This growth advantage was not observed for broadleaf species, indicating asymmetric benefits in mixed stands. Response patterns and magnitude vary over time and are influenced by local factors such as stand type, overstory retention, species, and initial treatment impact. This variability highlights the potential for tailoring NDBS approaches locally to achieve desired outcomes and underscores the need to incorporate stand‐specific conditions into ecological forestry practices.

score.title: Plant populations in ancient grasslands harbour higher levels of genetic diversity
score.summary: [背景] 草地生境受土地利用变化和集约化威胁，遗传多样性丧失成为重要问题，尤其在近年土地用途剧烈变化区域。德国Allgäu地区以大面积草地闻名，但各斑块在管理强度和土地利用历史上差异显著：部分草地已有200年以上历史，其余则较为年轻。研究假设景观历史和草地管理对植物遗传变异有重要影响。 [方法] 利用多重ISSR基因分型测序（MIG-seq）技术，测定了五种典型草地物种的遗传变异，并关联生境质量、景观结构和生境年龄数据，识别遗传变异的驱动因素。 [发现] 1) 研究区域内基因流水平高，种群间遗传分化与地理距离相关。2) 遗传多样性显著依赖于生境年龄（草地越古老遗传多样性越高），而与当前生境条件或景观结构无显著关系。 [贡献] 首次明确证明草地年龄对植物遗传多样性的独立影响，为保护管理中重视土地利用历史提供了直接证据。 [局限] 研究物种仅五种常见草地植物，推广至稀有或不同功能群物种时需谨慎；基因流模式可能受区域特异性影响。 [精读] 方法部分MIG-seq的应用和遗传多样性-年龄关系分析值得参考，讨论部分关于古老草地保护优先级的见解有实践意义。

item.title: Plant populations in ancient grasslands harbour higher levels of genetic diversity
item.abstract: Abstract Land‐use change and intensification can be a threat to biodiversity of grassland habitats, including genetic diversity. This is especially true for areas where drastic changes in land use occurred in recent years. The Allgäu in Germany is known for a large proportion of grassland in its landscape. However, the sites often differ in their current management intensity and their land use history. While some sites have been used as grasslands for more than two centuries, other grasslands are much younger. We assumed that landscape history and grassland management have a significant impact on genetic variation and therefore analysed the genetic variation of five typical grassland species using multiplexed ISSR (inter‐simple sequence repeat) genotyping by sequencing (MIG‐seq). We then related data on genetic variation with data on habitat quality, landscape structure and habitat age to identify possible drivers of genetic variation. Our results indicated a high level of gene flow across the study area. Consequently, genetic differentiation among populations was correlated with geographic distance. Genetic diversity clearly depended on habitat age but was not related to habitat conditions or landscape structure. Synthesis and applications . Since ancient grasslands harbour genetically more diverse plant populations, land use history should be given more attention in conservation management.
authors: Lena Winkler, Vinzenz Gilgenreiner, Hannah Schmitt, Christoph Reisch

score.summary: [背景] 气候变化与水利工程造成的水文改变正在重塑河流生态系统，但气候变暖与水流调节如何交互影响物种种群动态仍不明确，尤其对于具有保护和游钓价值的冷水鱼类。[方法] 本研究利用60年长期监测数据，构建层次贝叶斯stock-recruitment模型，量化美国怀俄明州斯内克河上游13个黄石切喉鳟种群在气候变暖和大型水库调度下的生产力变化。[发现] 1) 季节性变暖呈现相反效应：冬、春季变暖降低生产力，而夏季变暖却提高生产力；2) 最强的驱动因子是天然与人为春季洪峰时间匹配的交互作用——二者同步出现时生产力下降，错峰则延长洪泛脉冲并使生产力增加；3) 夏季灌溉流量与秋季水位下降时间也对生产力有较小但显著的影响；4) 基于未来气候预估，持续变暖与春汛缩短将威胁鳟鱼生产力，但通过适应性调度（如人为洪峰滞后于天然洪峰、推迟秋季水位下降）可以抵消气候导致的生产力衰退。[贡献] 首次明确揭示了坝下鱼类种群对气候-水流调控交互作用的响应，并将生态价值量化为可操作的管理杠杆，为在供水协商中提升渔业和生态系统服务话语权提供了依据。[局限] 未充分考虑水权等制度约束及干旱等水文条件的限制，但所提策略可为长期规划和应急决策提供信息。[精读] 该方法学上的贝叶斯层级模型架构与交互效应解析值得参考，但与当前核心任务无直接交叉，精读优先级较低。

item.title: Strategic dam management can offset climate‐driven declines in fish production
item.abstract: Abstract Climate change and hydrologic alteration by water infrastructure are reshaping river ecosystems globally, threatening freshwater biodiversity. Effective conservation strategies for riverine species depend on understanding how climate‐driven changes in temperature and flow interact with water management to regulate population dynamics, yet these interactions remain poorly understood. Here, we use a hierarchical Bayesian stock‐recruitment model to quantify how six decades of changing climate and water management (i.e. flow regulation at a large storage dam) jointly influence the productivity of 13 populations of a cold‐water fish species of significant conservation and economic importance, Yellowstone cutthroat trout ( Oncorhynchus virginalis bouvieri ) in the upper Snake River watershed, Wyoming, USA. We show that strong seasonal warming had opposing effects on productivity, with declines in warmer winters and springs but increases in warmer summers. The strongest driver of productivity was an interaction between the timing of natural and managed peak spring flows, where matched peak flow events reduced productivity, while mismatched peaks extended the flood pulse and increased productivity. In addition, key flow management periods, including summer irrigation flows and the timing of autumn ramp down, had important but smaller effects on productivity. Future climate projections indicated that continued warming and reduced spring flood duration may threaten trout productivity. However, our results show how adaptive dam management that strategically integrates with natural flow variability could offset climate‐driven declines and sustain ecosystem function. Synthesis and applications. Our results identify actionable levers for adaptive water management in the upper Snake River: delaying managed peak releases relative to natural flood peaks to extend the spring flood pulse, and postponing autumn ramp down to maintain side‐channel connectivity. While institutional constraints (e.g. water rights obligations) and hydrologic conditions (e.g. drought) may limit implementation, our findings provide key information for both long‐term and rapid‐response decision making. Quantifying the ecological value of water, as we do here, is essential for elevating fisheries and ecosystems services in water‐use negotiations dominated by consumptive demands. Our results provide a transferable framework for adaptive water management to support riverine biodiversity under intensifying warming and water scarcity.
authors: Jeffrey R. Baldock, Timothy J. Cline, William W. Fetzer, Annika Walters

score.title: Sea level rise weakens the restoration benefit of mussel–cordgrass facilitation in salt marshes
score.summary: [背景] 海平面上升可能削弱盐沼中生物之间的促进作用，威胁恢复成效，但此前对贻贝-互花米草促进效应如何随淹水梯度变化缺乏定量认识。[方法] 在路易斯安那海岸开展野外中宇宙实验，以互花米草为研究对象，设置5个相对海拔处理（+5、0、-5、-10、-15 cm）模拟从历史低淹水到未来高淹水的情景，交叉4个贻贝密度处理（0、254、509、1018 个·m⁻²），测定植物地上与地下生物量、土壤有机质和水分等指标，并用结构方程模型分析路径。[发现] 1) 贻贝对互花米草生长的促进作用仅发生在“促进窗口”（相对海拔+5~0 cm），当相对海拔降至-5 cm及以下时，正相互作用迅速减弱，形成“解耦区”；2) 结构方程表明，较高贻贝生物量与较高的土壤有机质和地下生物量相关，而淹水频率增加则与较高的土壤含水量及较低的土壤有机质和地下生物量相关；3) 相对海拔可作为筛选适宜恢复地点和判断贻贝引入效益的简单实用指标。[贡献] 首次量化了相对海拔对贻贝-互花米草促进效应的阈值，为盐沼恢复中利用物种互作提供了可操作的筛选工具，有助于在海平面上升情景下优化恢复设计和适应性管理。[局限] 实验在单一地点进行，结论的外推需考虑不同盐沼类型的生物物理条件差异；未涉及长期地形变化和沉降过程。[精读] 实验设计、促进窗口的阈值识别以及结构方程模型的应用值得精读。

item.title: Sea level rise weakens the restoration benefit of mussel–cordgrass facilitation in salt marshes
item.abstract: Abstract Ribbed mussels are ecosystem engineers that can enhance the performance of Spartina alterniflora and contribute to shoreline protection, but it remains unclear how mussel facilitation of cordgrass growth and associated stability benefits vary across inundation gradients expected under accelerating sea level rise. Identifying where this facilitation strengthens or weakens along the elevation gradient is, therefore, essential for anticipating restoration outcomes and designing interventions that leverage biotic interactions under future inundation regimes. We conducted a field mesocosm experiment on the Louisiana coast using marsh organs planted with S. alterniflora . We exposed the plants to five elevation treatments ( E = +5, 0, −5, −10 and −15 cm relative to the present marsh surface) to generate an inundation gradient spanning a low‐inundation hindcast, present‐day conditions and future relative elevation scenarios under sea level rise, and we crossed these elevations with four ribbed mussel ( Geukensia granosissima ) density treatments ( N = 0, 254, 509 and 1018 individuals m −2 ). Our results showed that mussel–cordgrass facilitation was strongly dependent on relative elevation: increasing mussel density enhanced plant biomass accumulation only within a distinct ‘facilitation window’ where elevation keeps pace with sea level rise (+5 to 0 cm relative elevation). At relative elevations of −5 cm and lower, the positive mussel–cordgrass interaction weakened rapidly, forming a ‘decoupling zone’. Structural equation modelling further suggested that greater realized mussel biomass was associated with higher soil organic matter and below‐ground biomass, whereas greater inundation frequency was associated with higher soil water content and lower soil organic matter and below‐ground biomass. Synthesis and applications. Within a limited elevation range near the present marsh surface, ribbed mussels facilitate S. alterniflora biomass accumulation; however, this facilitative interaction is contingent on relative elevation and is likely to weaken as relative elevation declines under future sea level rise. Consequently, relative elevation provides a practical screening metric for marsh restoration efforts, helping to prioritize locations for incorporating ribbed mussels where benefits to cordgrass biomass are most likely and to avoid settings where expected benefits are low. This screening metric can inform marsh restoration project siting, monitoring and adaptive management under future sea level rise.
authors: Yaolin Guo, Skylar L. Demourelle, Megan K. La Peyre, Brian J. Roberts

item.title: Hotspots of tree richness and carbon storage in existing and potential protected areas in Mexico
item.abstract: Abstract Understanding the spatial relationship between biodiversity and carbon storage is essential for guiding conservation efforts to tackle jointly the biodiversity loss and climate change crises. Here, we assess tree richness and carbon storage patterns, their spatial congruence within and outside protected areas and to what extent existing protected areas safeguard tree diversity‐carbon storage hotspots. We used tree species richness and above‐ground carbon storage data derived from 234 national forest inventory plots to fit machine learning models using a set of climatic, topographic and edaphic predictors in northwestern Mexico. We then assessed the uncertainty and spatial congruence of predicted tree richness and carbon storage. Areas with high minimum temperature and evapotranspiration contain greater tree richness and carbon storage. These results suggest that changes in temperature and precipitation regimes have the potential to alter both plant diversity and carbon pools. Hotspots, where the top quintile values of tree richness and carbon storage overlap, occupy 10.2% of the study region; however, most lie beyond existing protected areas, which currently safeguard less than 0.2% of these hotspots. Synthesis and applications : We identified areas of potentially high conservation value, including prospective ecological reserves and corridors. We recommend policy makers and land managers to protect these hotspots of tree richness and carbon storage and establish connections with existing reserves to facilitate species movement and range expansion under changing climatic conditions. Biodiversity and carbon pools should be considered together for more effective spatial planning processes, especially at the regional scale, where management decisions can be more easily implemented and evaluated.

score.summary: [背景] 大规模死亡事件（MME）对种群动态有重要影响，但南大西洋地区海鸟的MME记录和基线死亡率数据十分匮乏，尤其是对环境敏感的信天翁和鹱形目鸟类，这阻碍了监测体系对异常死亡事件的识别。[方法] 本研究开发了一套量化框架，通过整合时间序列分解、变点分析和核密度估计，利用巴西约3320公里海岸线长达8年（2017–2024）的标准化海滩监测数据，检测和刻画海鸟MME的时空特征。[发现] 1) 发现了7次先前未报道的MME，涉及3779只鹱形目个体，主要发生在秋季的东北海岸和春季的东南-南部海岸，呈现季节性复发模式；2) 受影响的优势种包括柯氏鹱、大西洋鹱和黄鼻信天翁，幼年个体比例异常高；3) 核密度分析识别出巴西海岸的死亡热点区域，为空间预警提供了依据。[贡献] 首次系统评估了南大西洋海鸟的MME，提出了一套可迁移的统计流程，可用于其他缺乏基线死亡率信息的类群或地区，并建立了基于定量指标的大规模死亡早期预警系统。[局限] 分析完全依赖海滩监测数据，可能遗漏海洋漂浮尸体；死亡原因的归因需结合环境数据进一步验证；推广至其他物种时需调整参数。[精读] 方法部分构建的时间序列异常检测框架具有较高的迁移性，值得借鉴用于其他种群的死亡异常监测，但当前与用户核心任务关联较弱。

item.title: A quantitative analysis to detect mass mortality events (wrecks) in Procellariiformes
item.abstract: Abstract Mass mortality events (MMEs) or ‘wrecks’ represent sudden and large‐scale mortality episodes often associated with extreme environmental conditions. Despite their ecological importance, MMEs remain poorly documented in the South Atlantic, particularly for Procellariiformes, a group highly vulnerable to climate‐driven anomalies. Detecting such events in this region is challenging because baseline mortality levels are unknown, limiting the ability of monitoring programs to identify abnormal mortality episodes. We developed a quantitative framework to detect and characterize seabird MMEs by integrating time‐series decomposition, changepoint analysis and kernel density estimation. The framework was applied to 8 years (2017–2024) of standardized beach monitoring data covering approximately 3320 km of the Brazilian coastline. This approach allowed us to identify anomalous mortality peaks, estimate the temporal duration of mortality episodes and delineate their spatial extent and hotspots along the coast. We detected seven previously unreported MMEs impacting 3779 stranded Procellariiformes. Events occurred primarily during austral autumn in northeastern and during austral spring in southeastern–southern regions, revealing recurrent seasonal and spatial patterns. Cory's Shearwater Calonectris borealis , Manx Shearwater Puffinus puffinus and Atlantic Yellow‐nosed Albatross Thalassarche chlororhynchos were the most affected species, with juveniles disproportionately represented. Kernel density analysis identified recurrent hotspot regions of mortality along the Brazilian coast. We propose mortality thresholds in an early‐warning system to guide monitoring efforts during abnormal stranding events. Synthesis and applications . Our study provides the first systematic assessment of seabird mass mortality events in the South Atlantic and introduces a transferable statistical framework for detecting MMEs in other taxa and regions lacking baseline mortality information. By identifying recurrent temporal anomalies, high‐risk areas and vulnerable species, we could establish quantitative indicators of MMEs. This approach offers a practical tool for monitoring programs to improve early detection of mortality events and to implement rapid response protocols.

item.title: Regulating bark beetles with mechanical bark treatments: Trade‐offs among pest control, operational efficiency and biodiversity
item.abstract: Abstract Natural disturbances have increasingly shaped global forests in recent decades. Coniferous forests in the Northern Hemisphere are facing intensifying disturbance regimes, exacerbating the conflict between traditional management objectives and the role of disturbance‐driven dynamics for biodiversity conservation. In Europe, unprecedented amounts of Norway spruce ( Picea abies ) have been damaged in recent years by hot droughts accompanied by outbreaks of the European Spruce Bark Beetle ( Ips typographus ). To meet the demands of forest protection and secure timber production, P. abies trees colonized by I. typographus , or suitable for colonization due to abiotic stress, are either extracted by salvage logging or made unsuitable for breeding using debarking techniques. Manual techniques are inefficient for large quantities and the extraction of deadwood can compromise biodiversity. We investigated mechanical bark treatments as potential alternatives to salvage logging for bark beetle regulation in Central Europe. Our study quantified bark beetle regulation efficacy, operational efficiency, wood properties and effects on biodiversity of saproxylic beetles, fungi and bacteria, as well as woodpeckers. Processing Norway spruce logs three times with a harvester to remove bark substantially reduced bark beetle emergence, demonstrating a scalable method that may contribute to the management of pest outbreaks and disturbances at landscape scales. Motor‐manual bark gouging and debarking are flexible alternatives and effective methods for small wood quantities. With increasing bark removal intensity, species richness of saproxylic beetles and bacteria decreased, while fungi species richness increased. In all three groups, species assemblages were affected by bark treatments. Differences in moisture content between treated and control logs were the main driver for changes in fungi and bacteria community assemblages. Bark treatments did not affect net calorific value over the first 2 years, blue‐stain fungi colonization and elemental composition (H, C and N). Synthesis and applications . Three times harvester processing and motor‐manual bark gouging effectively reduce bark beetles, enabling two options: permanent on‐site retention for biodiversity conservation, or up to 2 years of intermediate on‐site storage with no treatment effect on blue‐stain fungi colonization or energy content, thereby buffering operational bottlenecks during landscape disturbances.

score.summary: [背景] 澳大利亚西南部科克本湾等工业港口区在过去半个多世纪丧失约80%的海草床，自然恢复缓慢，亟需通过科学选址提高海草恢复成功率。[方法] 在8个环境条件不同的地点设立24个20.25 m²样方，移植1536株澳大利亚波喜荡草茎，监测18个月，分析存活率、新芽产生和叶生长等指标；结合现场观测与集成的科克本湾生态系统模型（CSIEM）模拟的水动力、光照等数据，识别限制恢复的关键环境因子；进一步利用CSIEM输出和物种环境需求构建栖息地适宜性指数（HSI）模型，绘制全域恢复适宜性分布。[发现] 1) 18个月后平均存活率71.9%，但地点间变异很大，4个地点表现优异（密度明显增长），3个中等，1个失败；2) 波浪能量和湍流振荡水动力是驱动恢复成功的最主要因子，其次是生物污损和生物扰动；3）多数成活移植体在6个月后已产生新芽，叶生长平均0.84 cm²/茎/天。[贡献] 将野外移植实验与机械性生态模型相结合，为大规模海草恢复提供了定量化的栖息地适宜性评估框架，提升了选址决策的信心。[局限] 研究区域限于西南澳一个特定海湾，模型移植性需在其他区域验证；仅关注单种，未涉及多物种或群落构建。[精读] 方法部分关于环境因子聚类和HSI建模的细节值得参考，可用于其他生态系统恢复的栖息地评估。

item.title: Testing habitat suitability for seagrass restoration to inform future efforts in southwestern Australia
item.abstract: Abstract Coastal habitats underpin vital ecosystem services, yet urban and industrial expansion have driven widespread degradation, including extensive loss of seagrass meadows. With minimal natural recovery, effective seagrass restoration depends on targeting suitable habitats. Here, we assess a range of environmental factors to determine the drivers of habitat suitability in Cockburn Sound and Owen Anchorage, Perth, southwestern Australia, for future restoration efforts of the temperate foundational seagrass Posidonia australis . The region is a heavily industrialised port that has lost ~80% of its seagrass meadows and suffered ecosystem decline since the 1950–1960s. To test habitat suitability, 1536 P. australis sprigs were planted into twenty‐four 20.25m 2 plots across eight sites with differing environmental conditions and assessed over 18 months. Relationships between restoration success and biophysical processes from both in situ observations and modelled data (Cockburn Sound Integrated Ecosystem Model, CSIEM) were explored. Habitat suitability in the entire study area was further assessed by modelling Habitat Suitability Index (HSI) using the CSIEM output, based on established environmental requirements of the species, to identify areas with potential for future restoration. After 18 months, the average survival of P. australis transplants was 71.86%, however, this varied greatly between sites. Overall, we identified four well‐performing sites where shoot density showed a clear increase over time, three sites with moderate performance and one unsuccessful site. Many surviving transplants were producing new shoots after 6 months and, overall, leaf growth averaged 0.84 cm 2 shoot −1 day −1 . After exploring a wide range of site‐specific physical and biological traits (including sediment characteristics, light availability and hydrodynamic variables), the sites were grouped into clusters based on the environmental characteristics, showing that wave energy and turbulent oscillatory hydrodynamics are the major drivers of restoration success, followed by fouling and bioturbation. Synthesis and applications . Combining habitat suitability modelling with field‐based habitat assessment provides more precise inputs for mapping seagrass restoration suitability across regions and helps uncover the key drivers of restoration outcomes. This approach can greatly improve confidence in identifying the most suitable areas to maximise success in larger scale restoration efforts.
authors: Giulia Ferretto, Jennifer J. Verduin, Rachel Austin, Henry Evans, Matthew R. Hipsey, Peisheng Huang, Sherry Yi Zhai, Mike van Keulen, Gary A. Kendrick

score.title: Do field margins matter more than floral resources? Arthropod activity and limited spillover of natural enemies from perennial flower strips into adjacent crops
score.summary: [背景] 农业景观简化和农药使用导致有益节肢动物（如传粉者和天敌）减少，花带被认为可提供花资源、庇护所和越冬地，但其效果受植物组成、带龄、割草制度及天敌向作物扩散能力的影响。[方法] 本研究在2022–2024年间，于集约化管理农田中设置多年生花带和对照草带，并在相邻甜菜和谷物田中调查节肢动物活动及天敌扩散。春、夏季分别采样评估越冬成功和活动密度，重点关注天敌类群和从田缘向作物内部的溢出格局。[发现] 1) 花带与草带间节肢动物总体活动密度无显著差异，但某些天敌类群（如部分寄生蜂）在花带中更活跃；2) 田缘内部节肢动物活动显著高于邻近作物，存在强烈的边缘效应，活动密度在进入作物5 m内快速下降；3) 天敌溢出效应在花带和草带间相似，但草带附近活动从5 m至50 m下降更迅速，暗示花带可维持稍持久的梯度；4) 年际变化明显，2022年活动最高；5) 越冬成功率在花带和草带中相当，且随带龄（第二、三年）增加。[贡献] 揭示了无论花资源多寡，田间边缘均具有显著的生态保育价值，并强调针对不同功能类群需进行分类分析，而非仅依赖聚合指标。[局限] 本研究在常规管理农田进行，未直接量化生物防治效果；天敌溢出对害虫控制的实际贡献受害虫密度和景观背景制约，且在低投入或有机系统中可能更有效。[精读] 值得关注多年生花带的长期效应和类群特异性响应，可参考其实验设计和类群分析方法。

item.title: Do field margins matter more than floral resources? Arthropod activity and limited spillover of natural enemies from perennial flower strips into adjacent crops
item.abstract: Abstract The simplification of agricultural landscapes and widespread pesticide use are major drivers of biodiversity loss, particularly affecting beneficial arthropods that provide essential ecosystem services such as pollination and natural pest control. Flower strips have emerged as a promising agri‐environmental measure to mitigate these effects by offering floral resources, shelter and overwintering habitats. However, their effectiveness depends on multiple factors, including plant species composition, strip age, cutting regime, and the dispersal of natural enemies into adjacent crops. In a three‐year field study (2022–2024) in conventionally managed agricultural fields, we examined arthropod activity in perennial flower strips, control grass strips and adjacent crops (sugar beet and cereals). In spring, arthropods were sampled to assess overwintering success; in summer, we investigated arthropod activity with a focus on natural enemies and their dispersal from field margins into adjacent crops. Overall arthropod activity did not differ consistently between flower and grass strips; though certain natural enemy groups showed a preference for flower strips. A strong edge effect was observed, with arthropod activity consistently higher within strips and declining rapidly within 5 m into the crop. Spillover of natural enemies was comparable between flower and grass strips, though activity declined more sharply from five to 50 m from the grass strip in 2023 and 2024, suggesting a more sustained activity gradient near flower strips. Some groups showed higher activity densities at 5 m distances compared to 50 m distances indicating that a spillover from the margin exists but declines rapidly. Arthropod activity peaked in 2022, reflecting inter‐annual variability. Overwintering success was comparable in flower and grass strips, and overall increased from 2023 to 2024, the second and third years since strip establishment. Synthesis and applications . Both flower and grass strips supported significantly higher arthropod activity than adjacent crop fields, underlining the general ecological value of field margins regardless of floral composition. The observed group‐specific responses emphasize the need for taxa‐specific analyses within heterogeneous functional groups, rather than relying solely on aggregated patterns. While tailored flower strips can promote specific natural enemy groups and local arthropod conservation, their contribution to biological control is conditional on pest pressure and landscape context, temporally variable, and likely most effective in low‐input or organic systems where pesticide pressure does not suppress in‐field arthropod activity.

score.summary: [背景] 评估保护行动效果需稳健研究设计，但实际使用的评价设计在偏倚稳健性上差异显著，目前尚不清楚更稳健的设计是否被更频繁使用，以及其使用在不同学科领域和地理位置上有何差异。[方法] 本研究从Conservation Evidence数据库中筛选了7356项英文和1183项非英文的初级研究，这些研究测试了保护行动的效果；将每项研究的方法设计归类为五大类型（After、Before–After、Control–Impact、BACI和随机实验），并利用贝叶斯多项式逻辑回归（含研究水平随机效应）检验了设计使用与年份、国家收入、生物多样性完整性、语言和学科领域的关系。[发现] 1) 证据基础已从简单的After设计（1970年74%）逐步转向更多使用CI（39%）和更稳健的设计（随机实验15%，BACI 6%）。2) 设计使用在学科间不均衡：随机实验在栖息地和土壤类主题（如农田）中更常见，而After或BA设计在动物类主题（如鸟类和爬行类）中更常见。3) 非英语研究及低收入国家的研究更可能使用After和BA设计，而较少使用随机实验和CI设计。4) 稳健设计的地理覆盖有限：随机实验和BACI研究仅出现在少数国家，许多生物多样性高或环境退化的国家缺乏任何设计类型的评估。[贡献] 首次系统分析了保护评估研究设计随时间和空间的变化趋势，揭示了结构性约束如何影响评价严谨性，为适应性管理和循证保护实践提供了优化评价设计的建议。[局限] 仅基于Conservation Evidence数据库，可能存在文献选择偏差；未考虑设计选择的其他影响因素如研究资金和合作网络。[精读] 方法论部分严谨，可借鉴其分类和建模框架用于生态干预评价研究设计倾向的类似分析。

item.title: Temporal and spatial trends in study designs used to understand what works in conservation
item.abstract: Abstract Robust study designs are essential for estimating the effects of conservation actions, but a range of evaluation designs are used that differ markedly in their robustness to bias. However, it is unclear whether robust designs are becoming more frequently used or how usage varies across subject areas and geographies. We analysed 7356 English and 1183 non‐English language primary studies that tested the effects of conservation actions from the Conservation Evidence database. We classified each study's methodological design to one of five broad types (After, Before–After [BA], Control–Impact [CI], Before–After–Control–Impact [BACI] and randomised experiments) and fitted a Bayesian multinomial logistic regression, with study‐level random effects, to test how design usage varies by year, national income, biodiversity intactness, language and subject area. The evidence base has shifted gradually from dominance by simple After designs (1970–2023: 74% to 33%) towards greater use of CI (15% to 39%) and more robust designs: randomised experiments (0% to 15%) and BACI (1% to 6%). Design use was uneven across subjects, with randomised experiments more common in habitat and soil‐focused topics (e.g. farmland), and After or BA designs more common in animal‐focused topics (e.g. birds and reptiles). Studies in non‐English languages and lower‐income countries were more likely to use After and BA designs and less likely to use randomised experiments and CI designs. Geographical coverage of robust designs was limited: randomised experiments and BACI studies occurred in few countries, and many biodiverse and environmentally degraded countries had few or no evaluations using any design. Despite modest improvements over time, several structural and contextual constraints (linked to subject, language and resources) continue to shape where rigorous evaluation is feasible. Synthesis and applications : Conservation is shifting towards using more robust designs to evaluate actions, but these remain rare. We suggest embedding study design choice more strategically within adaptive management and evidence‐based conservation practice, encouraging cost‐efficient, context‐dependent upgrades to more robust designs. This will require targeted capacity building, researcher–practitioner partnerships and longer‐term funding—especially in biodiverse, lower‐income countries with few studies of any design, let alone more robust ones.
authors: Amelia Staples, William H. Morgan, Lynn V. Dicks, Silviu O. Petrovan, Rebecca K. Smith, William J. Sutherland, Alec P. Christie

item.title: Autumn inversion tillage reduces beneficial arthropods and delays their recovery into the following crop growing season
item.abstract: Abstract Effects of tillage in arable fields on taxonomic and functional responses of beneficial above‐ and below‐ground arthropod communities are poorly understood. We assessed arthropod communities in 30 conventionally managed crop fields in south‐western Sweden before and after autumn tillage. Treatments consisted of three levels of tillage intensity: inversion tillage, reduced tillage (non‐inversion) and no tillage (direct seeding). Reduced tillage and no tillage are considered conservation tillage practices. All fields were sown with winter cereals in autumn 2019, followed by winter oilseed rape sown in late summer 2020. Tillage occurred between cereal harvest and the sowing of winter oilseed rape. We measured soil mesofauna density, and density, taxonomic, compositional and functional diversity of ground‐dwelling predators. Inversion tillage decreased densities of above‐ and below‐ground beneficial arthropods. Conservation tillage resulted in higher species richness and lower community turnover following disturbance. Community compositional shifts following inversion tillage were characterised by lower community weighted mean (CWM) body size and reduced densities of carabids overwintering as imago in autumn, and higher spider CWM body size in spring, compared with conservation tillage treatments. Inversion tillage reduced spider density and richness throughout the following growing season, while soil mesofauna densities, carabid taxonomic diversity and functional composition recovered by spring. Synthesis and applications : Responses to tillage were taxon‐specific and likely depended on life‐stage and the dependency on structural habitat complexity. Management should balance trade‐offs between retaining local communities, meeting the needs of multiple taxa, and accounting for taxonomic and functional richness over time.

item.title: Designing effective oral rabies vaccination strategies for endangered carnivores: Lessons from bait uptake in Ethiopian wolves
item.abstract: Abstract Effective disease control is vital in mitigating devastating disease outbreaks among threatened wild animal populations living in proximity to domestic animal reservoir populations. With only ~500 individuals remaining in small, isolated populations in the Ethiopian highlands, the most immediate threat to endangered Ethiopian wolves Canis simensis is rabies transmission from nearby domestic dogs Canis familiaris . Since 2018, the Ethiopian Wolf Conservation Programme (EWCP) has conducted oral vaccinations of Ethiopian wolves to control rabies spread. Analysis of camera trap images from 580 bait stations across five Ethiopian wolf populations between 2018 and 2020 enabled species uptake to be confirmed for 416 baits. Ethiopian wolves were the main bait consumers (46%), with peak uptake occurring soon after deployment in the evening. Non‐target uptake was almost exclusively diurnal, and predominantly by rodents, birds of prey and domestic dogs (41%). Generalised linear models showed that location and vegetation type influenced bait uptake by Ethiopian wolves and indicated that interference competition with domestic dogs can reduce Ethiopian wolf bait uptake near human settlements and where dogs are more active during the day. Synthesis and application: Our methods and framework offer valuable insights for designing effective oral vaccination strategies in wild carnivores globally, especially where domestic animal interference threatens wildlife health interventions.
authors: Elizabeth Fiona Rosemary Preston, Jessica Chalkley, Muktar Abute, Alo Hussein, Eric Bedin, Jorgelina Marino

score.summary: [背景] 全球对非洲油菜（Brassica carinata）的需求增加，但对其传粉生态学的理解有限，尤其是杀虫剂和家养蜜蜂如何交互影响传粉服务。[方法] 在美国北部大平原35个地点开展两年田间实验，监测800多株目标植物，量化访花者、多样性、移动、花特征和结实率，分析杀虫剂应用如何改变传粉者行为和作物表现。[发现] 传粉者使结实率提高26.8%，共记录28种访花物种；野生传粉者每次访花贡献种子数（1.01粒）高于蜜蜂（0.79粒）。无杀虫剂田块中野生与家养传粉者间存在非加性效应，暗示背景依赖的竞争与促进。杀虫剂不成比例减少野生传粉者，蜜蜂部分补偿产量损失，但野生传粉者效率更高，尽管化学暴露下这种优势下降。传粉结果强烈依赖于尺度和背景。[贡献] 揭示了农业管理（蜂箱+杀虫剂）并不自动提高产量，强调野生传粉者的关键作用，为集约化农业体系中综合策略管理提供依据。[局限] 研究局限于单一油菜物种和北美大平原特定气候条件，向其他作物和区域的推广需谨慎；未详细探讨杀虫剂类型和暴露时间的具体影响。[精读] 讨论部分关于野生与家养传粉者互作的非加性效应以及尺度依赖性值得关注，方法中跨尺度设计可参考。

item.title: Insecticides alter wild and managed pollination dynamics on oil crop yield
item.abstract: Abstract Global production of Ethiopian rape ( Brassica carinata ) is increasing for biofuel and feed purposes, yet its pollination ecology remains poorly understood despite its similarity to other mass‐flowering Brassica crops. We experimentally investigated how floral resource availability, insecticide use, and managed honey bee hives interact to shape pollination and yield at different scales. We conducted a 2‐year field experiment across 35 sites in the Northern Great Plains, USA, monitoring over 800 focal plants. We quantified pollinator visitation, diversity, movement, flower traits, and seed set across plant, field, and site scales, and assessed how insecticide application altered pollinator behaviour and crop performance. Pollinators increased seed set by 26.8%, with 28 visiting species recorded. Wild pollinators were more efficient than honey bees, contributing 1.01 seeds per visit compared with 0.79. In pesticide‐free fields, interactions between wild and managed pollinators produced non‐additive effects, suggesting context‐dependent competition and facilitation. In contrast, insecticide application disproportionately reduced wild pollinators, while honey bees partially compensated, buffering yield losses. However, wild pollinators consistently delivered higher per‐visit efficiency across spatial scales, although this advantage declined under chemical exposure. Synthesis and applications . Our results show that combining honey bee hives with insecticide use does not automatically enhance crop yield. Pollination outcomes are strongly scale‐ and context‐dependent, with wild pollinators providing disproportionately important services. Agricultural management should therefore prioritize integrated strategies that reduce pesticide pressure, enhance habitat, and support wild pollinator diversity to maintain resilient pollination services in intensive agroecosystems.
authors: Henning Nottebrock, Shane Stiles, Alexandra‐Maria Klein, Jonathan G. Lundgren, Charles B. Fenster
