item.title: eDNA sampling reveals no evidence of negative effects of beaver recolonisation on the catchment‐scale distribution of migratory fish
item.abstract: Abstract Reintroduction of keystone species is considered part of the solution to the current biodiversity crisis. The Eurasian beaver ( Castor fiber ) is one such species, shaping its habitat by felling trees, building dams and creating wetlands. However, whilst the potential benefits to aquatic biodiversity and ecological functioning have been studied on a local scale, the impacts of beavers on catchment‐scale processes such as fish migration remain understudied. Sequencing of environmental DNA (eDNA metabarcoding) from water samples is a cost‐effective method to study species distributions across large geographical scales. Here, eDNA samples ( n = 426) were collected from 142 sites across Britain's oldest and largest established wild beaver population, located on Tayside, East Scotland and analysed using a vertebrate‐specific metabarcoding assay. We combined detection/non‐detection data from eDNA results with other environmental and anthropogenic variables to model the effects of beaver eDNA detections on the distribution of three migratory fish species. Using generalised linear models, we found no effects of the current beaver eDNA detections on the distribution of Atlantic salmon or lamprey, but a positive co‐occurrence with European eel at the catchment scale. Model outputs also reinforced previous findings on the impact of barriers to migration and other abiotic and biotic factors on fish species, demonstrating the effectiveness of eDNA sampling in rivers for understanding species distributions at a catchment scale. Synthesis and applications . This study provides novel insights into the catchment‐scale co‐distribution of beavers and migratory fish, and there was no evidence of negative effects on the catchment‐scale distribution of migratory fish species. More generally, this study highlights how catchment‐wide eDNA monitoring can be applied by environmental managers to aid decision‐making and impact assessment of multiple priority species at the catchment scale.

score.title: Mangrove expansion in a large river delta is dependent on foreshore geomorphology
score.summary: [背景] 红树林恢复策略的规模化推广需要了解整个三角洲或河口尺度上促进红树林扩张的环境条件，但目前对这种大尺度下红树林扩张的适宜地点的认识仍有限。[方法] 本研究以厄瓜多尔瓜亚斯三角洲（约3200 km²）为研究区，结合卫星遥感、无人机实地验证和统计建模，比较了有红树林活跃扩张的潮滩与红树林边缘稳定的潮滩之间的环境条件差异，分析了潮滩高程、坡度、曲率、风程、潮滩长度以及潮汐淹没时长、频率和深度等关键变量。[发现] 1) 前滩地貌形态是红树林边缘动态的关键决定因素，比常用的高程和淹没指标预测力更强；2) 红树林扩张倾向于发生在坡度低、宽度大、剖面平直的前滩，因为这些地貌特征能有效衰减波浪和潮流；3) 相反，红树林在狭窄、陡峭、凹形且位于低潮间带的前滩难以扩张，因为保护作用弱且淹没胁迫高。[贡献] 研究提出了基于前滩地貌特征（低淹没胁迫、低坡度、大宽度、凸形剖面）的大规模红树林造林选址指标，为三角洲尺度的恢复规划提供了具体指导。[局限] 研究聚焦于单一大河三角洲，地貌指标在其它区域的普适性需进一步验证；同时未考虑生物互作（如种间竞争、繁殖体供应）和人类活动的干扰。[精读] 可精读地貌变量选择与统计建模部分，其将遥感地貌特征与植被扩张概率关联的分析框架可迁移至干热河谷河道植被扩张评估。

item.title: Mangrove expansion in a large river delta is dependent on foreshore geomorphology
item.abstract: Abstract Understanding the environmental conditions facilitating mangrove expansion across the large scale of entire deltas or estuaries (~100 to 1000 km 2 ) remains limited, despite its relevance for upscaling mangrove restoration strategies, which necessitates knowledge on where active planting of mangrove seedlings has a high versus low chance of success. In this study, we investigate the environmental conditions facilitating mangrove development across the Guayas Delta in Ecuador, a large tropical river delta (~ 3200 km 2 ) where young mangrove forests are expanding across extensive intertidal mudflats. By combining satellite‐based remote‐sensing, drone‐based field verification and statistical modelling, we quantified differences in environmental conditions between mudflats showing active mangrove expansion versus mudflats with stable mangrove edges. We analysed key variables, including mudflat elevation, slope, curvature, wind fetch, mudflat length and tidal inundation duration, frequency and depth. Our results reveal that the morphology of the tidal flat foreshore is a key determinant of mangrove edge dynamics, and a stronger predictor than more commonly used inundation metrics such as the elevation, inundation duration, frequency and depth at the mangrove edge. In general, mangrove expansion is facilitated by wide foreshores that have low slopes and straight profile shapes, which are attributed to more efficient attenuation of waves and tidal currents. Conversely, mangroves are much less likely to expand when they border narrow, steeper and concave foreshores that provide minimal protection and that occur at lower intertidal elevations, where they experience increased inundation stress. Synthesis and applications . Our findings provide guidance for large‐scale mangrove restoration, particularly in tropical river deltas, by identifying sites where (1) mangroves can potentially expand in the future, and (2) conditions are favourable for active mangrove seedling planting. The presence of a mudflat in front of existing mangroves is not sufficient. Instead, mangrove planting should be prioritized on mudflats with low tidal inundation stress, low slope, large width and convex topographic profiles, while low intertidal areas with narrow, steep and concave mudflat foreshores should be avoided. These specific geomorphic mudflat characteristics may serve as indicators to select suitable mangrove planting sites at a large deltaic scale.
authors: Maria‐Esther Espinoza‐Celi, Jean‐Philippe Belliard, Gregory S. Fivash, Luis Dominguez‐Granda, Ignace Pelckmans, John Ramos‐Veliz, Jorge Peñaherrera, Stijn Temmerman

score.title: Integrating large mammalian herbivores into Dynamic Global Vegetation Models: Status and next steps
score.summary: [背景] 当前陆地生态系统模型仍以植物为中心，大型食草动物对碳、氮、磷循环的动物地球化学反馈被普遍忽略，这在动物群丧失和再野化趋势下可能导致养分循环模拟的偏差。[方法] 本文综述了全球范围内大型哺乳动物通过取食、排泄、尸体和践踏等途径影响元素循环的观测、实验和遥感证据，追溯了DGVMs中动物表达从隐式到显式的演化历程，并提出了一个基于“必要复杂性”原则的模块化框架。[发现] 1) 现有模型对动物介导的养分再分布、土壤微生物互作等关键过程表达不足；2) 基于功能性状（体型、取食策略）的动物群体可有效连接地上与地下过程；3) 需整合空间行为、捕食-猎物动态和土壤扰动来提升预测能力；4) 未来应纳入无脊椎动物和大型动物的互作以更准确模拟土壤养分循环。[贡献] 首次系统梳理了大型食草动物在DGVMs中的建模现状，提出从性状到生物地球化学的模块化方案，为地球系统模型中动物过程的显式表达提供了路线图。[局限] 该综述主要针对大型哺乳动物，未涵盖无脊椎动物和其他动物类群；框架尚待实际模拟验证；缺乏与具体生态系统管理场景的衔接。[精读] 对于从事大尺度植被模型或食草动物生态效应研究的读者，文中关于功能性状和模块化框架的部分值得精读。

item.title: Integrating large mammalian herbivores into Dynamic Global Vegetation Models: Status and next steps
item.abstract: Abstract Zoogeochemistry, the study of how animals influence elemental cycling within ecosystems, bridges the fields of zoology, ecology and biogeochemistry. Yet, most terrestrial ecosystem models, especially Dynamic Global Vegetation Models (DGVMs), remain largely plant‐centric and rarely capture animal‐driven feedbacks. This omission could lead to misrepresentation of carbon and nutrient cycling, which is particularly pertinent at a time of continued widespread defaunation but also animal introductions (trophic rewilding) gaining traction as a potential mitigation measure. Here, we review global evidence from field observations, experimental manipulations, remote sensing and modelling to understand how animals, influence carbon, nitrogen and phosphorus cycling through consumption (e.g. herbivory), transformation and redistribution (via faeces, urine and carcasses) and physical disturbances (e.g. trampling). While zoogeochemistry encompasses all animals, this review focuses primarily on terrestrial vertebrates, particularly large mammals. We then trace the historical development of how animals have been represented in contemporary DGVMs, beginning with implicit representations and progressing towards explicit representations. Persistent gaps remain in capturing key animal‐driven processes, and relating these to functional traits (body size, foraging strategy, etc.), mammal‐mediated biogeochemical cycling, animal–microbial interactions and in development of adequate model validation approaches. To address these challenges, we propose a modular framework guided by the principle of ‘complexity by necessity,’ which links trait‐based animal cohorts to above‐ and below‐ground processes through consumption, defecation and other animal‐driven inputs, capturing spatial behaviours, plant–microbe–soil interactions and predator–prey dynamics across scales. Integrating zoogeochemical mechanisms into DGVMs would replace the traditional black‐box approach to animal processes with explicit mechanistic modelling. This offers a process‐based tool to quantify local animal impacts, scale across large regions and rigorously evaluate the expected outcomes for ecosystem structure and biogeochemistry. In the future, we call for better implementation of animal interactions and habitat‐mediated feedbacks, such as behavioural effects through predation or fear (predator–prey interactions). To more accurately simulate the nutrient cycling in soil, we suggest expanding models to include interactions with soil‐engineering invertebrates and larger animals. Collectively, these improvements would advance our mechanistic understanding of animal‐driven biogeochemistry and their importance for predicting nutrient cycles and animal–plant–soil feedbacks within Earth system models. Read the free Plain Language Summary for this article on the Journal blog.

item.title: A global systematic review of the effects of hydromorphological floodplain restoration on biodiversity
item.abstract: Abstract River floodplains are among the most threatened ecosystems on Earth. Efforts at hydromorphological restoration by enhancing lateral connectivity between the river channel and former floodplain are increasingly popular as nature‐based solutions (NbS) for hydrometeorological risk, including flood management and drought resilience, while potentially improving habitat for fish and wildlife and performing other ecosystem services. However, the biodiversity conservation benefits of such interventions have not been comprehensively assessed. A comprehensive review of hydromorphological floodplain restorations and their conservation evidence is needed to guide managers in selecting interventions and understanding potential outcomes. Here we report findings from a systematic review of 100 studies monitoring ecological responses to hydromorphological floodplain restoration across 22 countries from four continents and a broad range of taxonomic groups including birds, fishes, invertebrates, plants and amphibians. Most research comes from temperate climates, especially in Europe, and assesses restoration success at local scales by comparing restored to reference sites, with less than 20% of studies using a full Before‐After‐Control‐Impact (BACI) Design. The most common interventions used were side‐channel excavation, lowering of the floodplain, levee setbacks and environmental flows, and these yielded generally positive effects on metrics of biodiversity. Studies showed variation in biodiversity response among river systems, intervention types, spatiotemporal scales and among taxonomic groups. Studies were biased towards invertebrates, plants and fish, with little research on terrestrial vertebrates (birds, amphibians, and small mammals, including bats) and soil microorganisms. Synthesis and applications . Our evidence synthesis reinforces the notion that hydromorphological floodplain restorations, as a biodiversity conservation measure or NbS, can significantly enhance local floodplain biodiversity. However, such benefits were often compromised at least in part by invasive species post‐restoration, highlighting the importance of sustained management.

item.title: Trait responses to competition are mostly parallel among competitor plants but can cause convergence or divergence in key traits
item.abstract: Abstract Plants competing for resources exhibit different traits than plants which are not. Phenotypic plasticity can shape competition by altering trait differences between competitors. Studies show that plastic traits may converge or diverge among competitors as competition intensifies. However, another possibility is that interacting species could exhibit similar trait shifts as competition intensifies (trait parallelism). We used a field experiment to assess trait responses and performance outcomes for six co‐occurring native and invasive annual California grassland species when grown together at various densities. We grew one focal individual of each species in each plot and manipulated the identity and density of competitors, from bare ground to a dense lawn. Species displayed many trait responses to competitor density, which depended on competitor identity more than focal species identity. Most trait responses were parallel among competing plants with no effect on trait differences between competitors. The exceptions were specific root length, which diverged among competitors with increased competitor density, root mass fraction and leaf dry matter content, which both converged among competitors with increased competitor density. Competitors' effects on performance were not correlated with greater responses in any trait. A few traits displayed non‐parallel responses among competing plants, altering trait differences between competitors. These traits may be of interest for future studies of plasticity's effects on competition or species coexistence. Read the free Plain Language Summary for this article on the Journal blog.

score.summary: [背景] 现有陆地生物地球化学模型主要聚焦植物和土壤微生物，但地上动物可通过营养级联、排泄物沉积和土壤物理扰动等反馈显著影响地下过程，然而缺乏整合动物效应的模型框架。[方法] 本文提出耦合地上-地下动物地球化学（CAB-ZGC）循环的概念与数学模型，明确连接动物直接效应与地下微生物过程。同时综合39项实证研究，量化动物对土壤微生物过程的影响方向和幅度。[发现] 1) 动物存在可使土壤养分有效性、微生物活性、凋落物分解及碳氮循环变化10%–219%；2) 65%的案例为增强效应，35%为减弱；3) 无脊椎动物密度是微生物活性和氮循环效应的强预测因子。[贡献] 首次提供将动物效应纳入生物地球化学模型的通用框架，并给出定量证据，为提升模型预测精度开辟新路径。[局限] 模型尚属概念阶段，需更多案例和参数（如通量率、采食量）以构建通用模型；实证综合仅纳入39项研究，可能不具普遍性。[精读] 模型构建思路和参数化方法值得参考，建议精读模型方程与实证综合部分。

item.title: Bridging the divide between models of animal‐driven and microbial‐driven biogeochemical cycling: A zoogeochemistry‐informed framework
item.abstract: Abstract Most current terrestrial biogeochemical models formalize biogeochemical cycling as predominantly controlled by processes involving plants and soil microbes. However, growing evidence indicates that above‐ground animals could exert controlling feedback effects that alter soil microbial performance via trophic interactions on plants, release of chemicals in waste matter deposition, and biophysical impacts on soil properties. We present a conceptual and mathematical framework—a Coupled Aboveground‐Belowground Zoogeochemical (CAB–ZGC) cycling model—that explicitly links above‐ground animal direct and feedback effects in models of below‐ground processes. We then provide an empirical synthesis, informed by the conceptual framework, to quantify the potential direction and magnitude of vertebrate and invertebrate animal impacts on below‐ground microbial processes. The synthesis of 39 studies provides proof‐of‐concept showing that animal presence can alter key biogeochemical processes including soil nutrient availability for microbes, microbial and fungal activity, microbial litter processing, and carbon and nitrogen cycling by between 10% to 219% relative to their absence. Effects were enhancing in 65% of cases, and reducing in 35%, and invertebrate density was a strong predictor of the effect and magnitude for microbial activity and nitrogen cycling. These findings reveal the importance of considering animal effects in biogeochemical models to improve the accuracy of model predictions and empirical assessments of biogeochemical cycling in ecosystems. We conclude by highlighting two complementary research fronts to advance terrestrial biogeochemical models: (i) model development through case studies to build a more general CAB‐ZGS model and (ii) target empirical work to measure animal parameters including flux rates, forage intake, animal respiration and waste across a range of animal densities and contexts. item.title: Reduction in litter allelochemicals promotes positive biotic interactions among alien species
item.abstract: Abstract A key focus of invasion ecology is elucidating why multiple alien species accumulate within ecosystems. The invasional meltdown hypothesis proposes that one alien invader promotes further invasions through soil legacy effects. However, whether microbial or litter legacies drive these effects, both of which are shaped by environmental heterogeneity (e.g., alien density or nutrient gradients), remains largely unexplored. We conducted a multifactorial experiment using an invasive plant species ( Phytolacca americana ) to assess how species origin affects alien plant invasion, incorporating two interacting species origins (native vs. alien), two litter treatments (with vs. without), two soil microbial conditions (inoculated vs. sterile), three soil phosphorus levels, and three planting density levels. Alien litter had lower total phenolic levels and higher C:N ratios than native litter. Phytolacca americana grew significantly better under alien litter. Path analysis revealed that this growth enhancement was driven primarily by reduced allelochemicals rather than nutrient differences, with plant density modulating this effect. Although soil microbial communities from different origins differed in diversity and functional structure, their inoculation produced no significant differential effects on P. americana growth. These results reveal a litter‐mediated mechanism that could potentially facilitate invasional meltdown by promoting positive interactions among alien plants. Our findings provide new insights into invasion mechanisms and highlight the ecological interplay between alien species. Read the free Plain Language Summary for this article on the Journal blog.

score.title: Ecohydrological characteristics of biocrusts explain divergent responses of biocrusts and grasses to rainfall reduction
score.summary: [背景] 旱地生态系统由维管植物和生物结皮共同主导，两者对降水变化的响应存在差异，但耦合响应机制尚不明确，这为预测旱地恢复力和碳水动态带来关键空白。[方法] 在温带半干旱草原开展为期4年的野外降水减少实验（-75%、-50%、-25% 和对照），设置大量重复，监测草类盖度与生物结皮盖度，并基于生物结皮的生态水文特征（最低碳增益的降雨阈值与最大吸水能力）解析水分再分配过程。[发现] 1) 草类盖度主要受降水减少处理影响，随降雨减少而持续下降；2) 生物结皮盖度对降雨减少更富弹性，但对降雨频次高度敏感，即其反应符合变水生物特性；3) 生物结皮的降雨阈值差异可调节有效水分，从而解释了两类组分的非同步响应，忽略这种水文交互会高估植物可用水。[贡献] 揭示了生物结皮通过截留降雨显著影响草类供水，为将生物结皮-植物相互作用纳入旱地模型提供了关键机制依据。[局限] 实验仅在半干旱草地单一地点进行，空间尺度有限，未涵盖长期极端事件序列；模型外推时需谨慎考虑不同生物结皮类型和土壤背景。[精读] 值得关注实验设计与生态水文阈值测定方法，讨论部分对机制的定量解析有参考价值。

item.title: Ecohydrological characteristics of biocrusts explain divergent responses of biocrusts and grasses to rainfall reduction
item.abstract: Abstract Drylands are mainly structured by both vascular plants and biological soil crusts (biocrusts), the latter often regarded as a self‐organizing component of these ecosystems. Yet how the covers of these two components respond jointly to rainfall variability remains unclear—a critical gap for predicting future dryland resilience and carbon–water dynamics. To that end, we conducted a 4‐year rainfall reduction experiment (−75%, −50%, −25% and control) in a semi‐arid grassland with a large number of replicates, allowing a robust assessment of ecosystem responses under natural conditions. We found that grass cover responded mainly to rainfall reduction treatments, showing consistent declines due to their dependence on water input. Biocrust cover was more resilient to rainfall reduction but strongly promoted by years with more frequent rainfall events, reflecting their poikilohydric nature. Ecohydrological characteristics of biocrusts—specifically their rainfall thresholds for minimum carbon gain (carbon‐balancing rainfall size) and maximum water absorption (maximum usable rainfall size)—explained these divergent responses by mediating water availability. Synthesis . Our findings show that biocrusts mediate grass water supply by intercepting a significant fraction of rainfall; failing to account for this hydrological interaction leads to a biased overestimate of plant‐available water. This underscores the need to integrate biocrust‐plant interactions into experimental and modelling frameworks to improve predictions of dryland ecosystem sustainability under climate change. score.title: Facilitation and competition between Acacia species and phosphorus‐mobilising plants in severely phosphorus‐impoverished habitats
score.summary: [背景] 在火灾频发且磷极度匮乏的环境中，植物演化出多样的磷获取策略，并与根系形态性状协调。火后土壤有效磷短暂升高，随后迅速下降，因此幼苗高效的磷获取对其存活至关重要。然而，火后更新多年生植物在不同幼苗阶段是否表达多样的磷获取策略以及根系性状如何协调尚不清楚。[方法] 以澳大利亚西南部两种本地火后更新金合欢（Acacia pulchella和Acacia lasiocarpa）为对象，设计单种和与磷活化植物班克木（Banksia attenuata）混种的处理，同时设置加磷与不加磷处理来模拟火后初期和多年后的土壤磷水平。在三个幼苗阶段测定生物量、根鞘磷酸单酯酶活性、羧酸盐浓度（以叶片锰浓度代理）、叶片磷回收效率和根系形态性状。[发现] 1) 两种金合欢表现出截然不同的磷获取策略：A. pulchella最初依赖较高的土壤磷有效性，随后受益于B. attenuata的促进效应，并始终依赖磷酸单酯酶；而A. lasiocarpa即使在较高土壤磷条件下也主要依赖羧酸盐和磷酸单酯酶来活化和获取磷。2) 根系形态性状、根鞘磷酸单酯酶、叶片锰浓度和叶片磷回收效率之间存在交互作用。3) 对两种金合欢总生物量预测最强的因子是根系形态性状。[贡献] 首次揭示了磷极度匮乏生境中火后更新固氮植物在不同土壤磷背景下的磷获取策略转变及与磷活化植物的种间促进关系，强调了根系形态性状相对于内部磷保存性状对生长的更大作用。[局限] 研究在控制条件下进行，野外磷动态和种间互作可能更复杂；仅涉及两种金合欢与一种班克木，结论的普遍性需进一步验证。[精读] 磷获取策略的可塑性及种间促进效应对于理解干扰后植被恢复机制具有参考价值，其方法框架可部分借鉴。

item.title: Facilitation and competition between Acacia species and phosphorus‐mobilising plants in severely phosphorus‐impoverished habitats
item.abstract: Abstract Plants in fire‐prone severely phosphorus (P)‐impoverished environments exhibit diverse P‐acquisition strategies coordinated with root morphological traits. Fire transiently enhances plant‐available soil P, making efficient post‐fire P acquisition crucial for seedling survival of post‐fire seeder perennials as soil P availability declines over time. However, whether post‐fire seeder perennials express a diversity of P‐acquisition strategies across three stages of seedlings after a fire and how their root morphological traits are coordinated, remains unknown. For Acacia pulchella and Acacia lasiocarpa (Fabaceae), two post‐fire seeder perennials native to southwest Australian P‐impoverished habitats, we investigated biomass, rhizosheath monophosphatase activity and carboxylate concentrations, represented by leaf manganese concentrations ([Mn]), leaf P‐resorption efficiency and root morphological traits. Seedlings were harvested at three stages in monoculture and mixture with P‐mobilising Banksia species (Proteaceae), under treatments with or without P addition to simulate soil P concentrations ([P]) immediately and many years post‐fire, respectively. The two species of Acacia exhibited distinct P‐acquisition strategies. A. pulchella initially relied on increased soil P availability and subsequently its P acquisition was facilitated by Banksia attenuata ( B. attenuata ), while consistently depending on releasing monophosphatases. Conversely, A. lasiocarpa relied on releasing carboxylates and monophosphatases to mobilise and acquire P, even at elevated soil [P]. There were efficiency interactions among root morphological traits, rhizosheath monophosphatases, leaf [Mn] and leaf P‐resorption efficiency. For both Acacia species, total biomass was most strongly predicted by root morphological traits. We conclude that traits related to the acquisition of soil P, such as root morphological characteristics, rhizosheath monophosphatases and leaf [Mn] were more evident in supporting plant growth in severely P‐impoverished ecosystems than traits associated with internal P conservation, such as leaf P‐resorption efficiency. These two types of traits interacted and functioned synergistically, enhancing total plant biomass. Read the free Plain Language Summary for this article on the Journal blog.

item.summary: [背景] 在火灾频发且磷极度匮乏的环境中，植物演化出多样的磷获取策略，并与根系形态性状协调。火后土壤有效磷短暂升高，随后迅速下降，因此幼苗高效的磷获取对其存活至关重要。然而，火后更新多年生植物在不同幼苗阶段是否表达多样的磷获取策略以及根系性状如何协调尚不清楚。[方法] 以澳大利亚西南部两种本地火后更新金合欢（Acacia pulchella和Acacia lasiocarpa）为对象，设计单种和与磷活化植物班克木（Banksia attenuata）混种的处理，同时设置加磷与不加磷处理来模拟火后初期和多年后的土壤磷水平。在三个幼苗阶段测定生物量、根鞘磷酸单酯酶活性、羧酸盐浓度（以叶片锰浓度代理）、叶片磷回收效率和根系形态性状。[发现] 1) 两种金合欢表现出截然不同的磷获取策略：A. pulchella最初依赖较高的土壤磷有效性，随后受益于B. attenuata的促进效应，并始终依赖磷酸单酯酶；而A. lasiocarpa即使在较高土壤磷条件下也主要依赖羧酸盐和磷酸单酯酶来活化和获取磷。2) 根系形态性状、根鞘磷酸单酯酶、叶片锰浓度和叶片磷回收效率之间存在交互作用。3) 对两种金合欢总生物量预测最强的因子是根系形态性状。[贡献] 首次揭示了磷极度匮乏生境中火后更新固氮植物在不同土壤磷背景下的磷获取策略转变及与磷活化植物的种间促进关系，强调了根系形态性状相对于内部磷保存性状对生长的更大作用。[局限] 研究在控制条件下进行，野外磷动态和种间互作可能更复杂；仅涉及两种金合欢与一种班克木，结论的普遍性需进一步验证。[精读] 磷获取策略的可塑性及种间促进效应对于理解干扰后植被恢复机制具有参考价值，其方法框架可部分借鉴。

score.title: Elevated CO2 advances vegetation phenology
score.summary: [背景] 大气CO2浓度持续上升正深刻改变陆地生态系统的结构与功能，植物物候作为生态系统过程变化的早期预警指标，其与CO2升高的关系仍不明确。[方法] 该研究对39项已发表研究中624组实验记录进行了荟萃分析，系统评估了CO2升高对植物物候的影响，并量化了气候变量、土壤因子、CO2升高幅度和实验持续时间的相对重要性。[发现] 1) CO2升高显著使总体物候提前2.50天（-1.99%），其中展叶提前3.00天（-2.38%），成熟提前4.09天（-3.24%）；2) CO2升高对植物生长季长度无显著影响；3) 模型选择显示，植物功能群并非物候变化的关键预测因子，物候变化主要由年均温（MAT）和CO2升高幅度驱动。[贡献] 首次通过综合定量分析揭示了CO2升高对物候的提前效应及其主要驱动因子，强调在生态系统和地球系统模型中纳入CO2驱动的物候响应的重要性。[局限] 实验多在受控环境实施，可能未充分反映野外的复杂交互作用；Meta分析受限于可用研究数量和空间覆盖度。[精读] 可精读方法部分了解Meta分析设计，结果对全球变化生态学有参考价值，但与用户核心方向关联较弱，无需进一步跟踪。

item.title: Elevated CO2 advances vegetation phenology
item.abstract: Abstract The continuous rise in atmospheric CO 2 concentration has profoundly altered vegetation structure and function across terrestrial ecosystems. Among various indicators, vegetation phenology is conventionally considered an early warning indicator of changes in other ecosystem processes. However, the relationship between vegetation phenology and elevated CO 2 (eCO 2 ) remains highly elusive. Here, we conducted a comprehensive meta‐analysis of 624 experimental records from 39 published studies to evaluate eCO 2 effects on vegetation phenology and quantify the relative importance of climate variables, soil factors, eCO 2 magnitude and experimental duration. The findings showed that eCO 2 significantly advanced overall vegetation phenology by 2.50 days (−1.99%), with leaf‐out advancing by 3.00 days (−2.38%) and maturity by 4.09 days (−3.24%). Elevated CO 2 exerted a negligible overall effect on plant growing season length. Importantly, model selection showed that plant functional groups were not essential predictors of phenological shifts. Instead, phenological shifts were primarily predicted by mean annual temperature (MAT) and eCO 2 magnitude. These results provide new insights into the mechanisms linking atmospheric change with plant developmental timing and highlight the need to explicitly incorporate CO 2 ‐driven phenological responses into ecosystem and Earth system models. score.summary: [背景] 退化荒漠草原恢复常面临土壤碳、磷等养分限制，微生物代谢限制影响生态系统功能。生物有机肥结合有机碳源、有益微生物和养分，与传统施肥不同，其对微生物资源限制和碳利用效率（CUE）的影响尚不明确。[方法] 通过野外试验比较生物有机肥、微生物肥、保水剂和自然恢复处理，利用三种酶化学计量模型（向量模型、向量-阈值元素比模型、阈值模型）量化微生物碳、磷限制并计算CUE，测定土壤理化性质、微生物生物量及酶活性。[发现] 1) 所有恢复措施均影响土壤化学计量失衡：与对照相比，处理组C:N失衡更高，而C:P和N:P失衡更低；2) 三种模型均未发现微生物氮限制，但均显示存在碳和磷限制；3) 向量模型和V-T模型表明生物有机肥缓解了碳限制，未显著改变磷限制，而阈值模型显示其缓解碳限制但加剧了磷限制；4) 生物有机肥提高了微生物碳利用效率，主要调控因子为土壤微生物生物量。[贡献] 该研究证实酶化学计量在评估退化草地微生物资源生态中的有效性，为制定靶向恢复措施提供了理论依据。[局限] 研究局限于单一荒漠草原站点，未考虑时间动态和植物-微生物反馈，磷限制加剧的长期后果需进一步评估。[精读] 酶化学计量方法部分值得参考，但整体与核心任务关联较弱，无精读必要。

item.title: Bio‐organic fertilizer alleviated soil microbial C limitations, aggravated P limitations and increased microbial C use efficiency in a degraded desert steppe
item.abstract: Abstract Bio‐organic fertilizer (BOF), which integrates organic carbon sources, beneficial microorganisms and essential nutrients, represents a distinctive approach to grassland restoration that differs fundamentally from conventional fertilization practices. Ecoenzymatic stoichiometry theory (EEST) provides a powerful framework for evaluating microbial nutrient limitation and carbon use efficiency (CUE) via analysis of the metabolic activities of extracellular enzymes involved in nutrient acquisition, supporting research on their responses to carbon‐rich amendments and informing the optimization of restoration strategies. In this study, we investigated the responses of microbial metabolic limitations and CUE to different ecological restoration measures: bio‐organic fertilizer (BOF), microbial fertilizer (MF), super absorbent polymers (SAP) and a natural restoration control (CK). We quantified microbial metabolic limitation using three soil enzyme stoichiometry models (vector model, vector‐TER (threshold element ratio) (V–T) model and threshold model), calculated microbial CUE across all treatments and examined the regulatory effects of environmental factors on both microbial metabolic nutrient limitations and CUE. Different restoration measures significantly affected soil physicochemical properties, microbial biomass, extracellular enzyme activities and their stoichiometric characteristics. All three restoration measures altered stoichiometric imbalance: compared with CK, BOF, MF and SAP treatments exhibited higher C:N imbalance but lower C:P and N:P imbalances. All three models consistently indicated the absence of soil microbial N limitation across all restoration measures, with all three models confirming the presence of C and P limitations. Both vector and V–T models showed that BOF alleviated C limitations with no significant differences in P limitations among treatments, whereas the threshold model revealed that BOF relieved C limitations but exacerbated P limitations. Additionally, BOF improved CUE. The main factors that influenced C and P limitations were soil available resources. Meanwhile, soil microbial biomass was the main factor influencing CUE. This study demonstrates the utility of EEST in elucidating microbial resource ecology in degraded desert grasslands, providing a basis for targeted restoration measures in degraded ecosystems. item.title: Elevated UV‐B alters anti‐herbivore plant defence allocation, while silicon supplementation maintains resistance
item.abstract: Abstract The impacts of elevated surface ultraviolet‐B (UV‐B) on ecological processes, such as anti‐herbivore defence in plants, remain poorly understood. Many cereal crops depend on accumulating silicon (Si) in their tissues to resist insect herbivory. UV‐B is known to affect oxidative signalling, which is an early signal triggered by herbivore attack and hence could potentially impact upon subsequent defence allocation. We tested how UV‐B light, Si supplementation and herbivory interact to impact plant defence and insect performance. We conducted a fully factorial glasshouse experiment using hydroponically grown wheat ( Triticum aestivum ), manipulating three UV‐B levels (low, moderate and high) and Si supply, before subjecting plants to herbivory by Helicoverpa armigera . Elevated UV‐B increased oxidative signalling (+52%) and antioxidant capacity but slightly reduced foliar Si accumulation (−8.6%). Silicon supplementation reduced lipid peroxidation and altered defence allocation, lowering UV‐B‐ and herbivory‐induced phenolic production while increasing polyphenol oxidase activity and Si concentration. Phenolics increased under elevated UV‐B (up to +13%), and herbivory increased phenolics only in plants without Si supplementation (up to +30%). Under herbivory, Si reduced phenolic levels (17% lower than −Si plants) and suppressed phenolic induction by 25%. Larvae feeding on Si‐supplemented plants showed a 35% reduction in growth rate, which persisted despite UV‐B‐driven reductions in foliar Si. High UV‐B depleted larval energy reserves, with carbohydrate levels declining by 52%, alongside reduced lipid and triglyceride stores and a 40% increase in protein. Silicon altered larval energy allocation, increasing carbohydrate reserves (2.5‐fold) and glycogen (up to 2.9‐fold), while larvae feeding on −Si plants retained higher lipid and triglyceride stores. Collectively, these results demonstrate that Si helps maintain plant resistance under simultaneous UV‐B exposure and herbivory by altering defence investment and increasing metabolic costs to herbivores. These findings provide broader implications for understanding how crops maintain resistance under future changes in UV‐B light conditions. score.summary: [背景] 动物面临有限的能量和氧气供应，必须在代谢需求之间权衡，气候变化下了解这些权衡对预测适应性至关重要。 [方法] 本研究利用河口洄游鱼类Galaxias maculatus的三个大型数据集，分析幼鱼和繁殖成鱼在15、18、20和23°C四个驯化温度下的代谢率（标准代谢率SMR和最大代谢率MMR），结合个体生长率和繁殖成熟度的自然变异，探讨代谢与生活史性状的关系。 [发现] 1) SMR的异速生长随升温而改变：截距增加，斜率减小，较大个体SMR对温度反应较小；2) MMR的异速生长截距随温度变化，但斜率无明显差异；3) 个体生长表型与SMR仅在部分温度下有弱正相关，与MMR无相关；4) 极端温度下繁殖成熟个体减少，而配对t检验显示成熟个体的SMR显著低于未成熟时，且MMR与成熟度在18°C呈负相关。 [贡献] 研究揭示了代谢率与生长、繁殖之间的复杂关系，挑战了经典的能量分配权衡理论，为整合生活史和代谢响应以预测气候变化影响提供了新视角。 [局限] 研究基于实验室驯化，野外环境复杂性未涵盖；相关性分析未能阐明因果关系，且成熟个体的代谢变化机制尚待明确。 [精读] 方法学中SMR和MMR的测量与生活史状态的联系设计值得借鉴，讨论部分对权衡理论的反思具有启发性。

item.title: Life history attributes influencing metabolic variation in an estuarine fish
item.abstract: Abstract Considering that energy availability and oxygen transport potential are limited in supplying metabolic requirements, all animals face trade‐offs between competing metabolic demands. A key interest of eco‐physiologists is to understand these trade‐offs and determine which strategies might prove the most efficient in the face of environmental challenges like climate warming. Here, we analysed three large datasets on a diadromous fish species, Galaxias maculatus, to assess metabolic rates of juveniles and reproductive adults across four acclimation temperatures (15, 18, 20 and 23°C). We used natural variations in growth rate and reproductive maturation level between and within individuals at different life history stages to test for potential relationships with different levels of aerobic metabolism from resting (standard metabolic rate, SMR) to maximal (maximum metabolic rate, MMR) We found that allometry of SMR differed predictably with warming temperature, whereby the intercept (scaling coefficient) increased and the slope (scaling exponent) decreased. This was driven by a trend in which the SMR of larger fish was less responsive to temperature relative to smaller fish. MMR allometry showed differences in intercept, but negligible differences in slope with temperature. Linear regression analyses on mass‐standardized variables showed individual growth phenotypes have a weak positive correlation with SMR at some, but not all, temperatures. This suggests that SMR may be a contributing determinant of growth, or the measurement of SMR could be impacted by residual growth even when fish have been fasted. No correlation between individual growth and MMR was seen at any temperature. We found a reduction in the number of individuals that reproductively matured at the lowest and highest temperatures. While there was no discernible correlation between the level of reproductive maturation and SMR, a paired t ‐test on a subset of fish showed that SMR was significantly lower in individuals when they were mature relative to when they were immature. There was also a negative relationship between maturation and MMR at 18°C, raising questions around the whole‐animal metabolic consequences of allocating energy to reproduction. We suggest that metabolism, growth and reproductive investment may not trade‐off as clearly as theory predicts, and we propose future research directions to untangle the complicated balance of these traits for maximizing lifetime fitness under a changing climate. Read the free Plain Language Summary for this article on the Journal blog.
authors: Elizabeth C. Hoots, Luis L. Kuchenmüller, Michael R. Skeeles, Timothy D. Clark

score.title: The negative effects of an allelopathic invader on native plant photosynthesis are amplified after tree canopy closure
score.summary: [背景] 许多入侵植物产生化感物质破坏本地植物的真菌共生，进而影响光合作用，但化感作用是否直接降低光合能力以及该效应在生长季内如何变化尚不清楚。[方法] 在一个自2006年开始的长期野外实验中，研究者于树冠闭合前后两个时期测量了两种林下本地植物（Trillium spp.和Maianthemum racemosum）的光合气体交换，比较了入侵植物葱芥（Alliaria petiolata）未移除与持续移除处理下的差异。[发现] 1) 未移除葱芥处理中，两种本地植物的净光合速率均显著降低；2) 机制上，Trillium spp.表现为表观光合能力下降，暗示养分胁迫，而M. racemosum则因气孔导度降低导致气孔限制增加，暗示水分胁迫；3) 树冠闭合后，葱芥对两种植物光合作用的负面影响均被放大。[贡献] 首次揭示了化感入侵对本地植物光合生理影响存在季节依赖性及种间机制差异，并指出林冠遮阴会加剧这些负效应，拓展了入侵生态学中非生物环境与生物互作交互作用的理解。[局限] 研究仅针对两种本地种，实验无法完全排除其他环境因素干扰，结论的普适性需更多物种和生境验证。[精读] 长期实验设计和光合生理与物候的耦合测量方法值得借鉴，可用于分析入侵种对群落功能影响的动态机制。

item.title: The negative effects of an allelopathic invader on native plant photosynthesis are amplified after tree canopy closure
item.abstract: Abstract Many invasive plants produce antimicrobial allelopathic compounds that disrupt plant–fungal symbioses of native species in the communities they invade, influencing nutrient and water provisioning that support photosynthesis. Previous studies have linked these disruptions to reductions in photosynthesis and stomatal conductance, but whether these effects are tied to reductions in photosynthetic capacity remains unclear, limiting inferences about the mechanisms driving physiological responses of native species. Furthermore, how these responses vary temporally across the growing season is unknown. To investigate the temporal dynamics of native plant responses to allelopathic invasion, we measured gas exchange in two understory native species ( Trillium spp. and Maianthemum racemosum ) at two points during the growing season—before and after tree canopy closure. Plants were measured in a long‐term field experiment where Alliaria petiolata , an allelopathic invader known to disrupt AM fungal symbioses, has been removed or left at ambient levels since 2006. Both native species exhibited significantly reduced net photosynthesis rates under ambient A. petiolata levels compared with the weeded treatment. This response was due to a reduction in apparent photosynthetic capacity in Trillium spp. and a reduction in stomatal conductance that increased stomatal limitation in M. racemosum . Photosynthetic responses to A. petiolata in both species were amplified after tree canopy closure. Alliaria petiolata reduced native plant net photosynthesis either by increasing nutrient stress, as indicated by the reduction in apparent photosynthetic capacity ( Trillium spp.), or by increasing water stress, as indicated by the reduction in stomatal conductance ( M. racemosum ). These responses were amplified only after the tree canopy closed. Our findings highlight the importance of seasonal changes that can regulate plant physiological responses to allelopathic invaders and demonstrate the diversity of mechanisms by which allelopathic invaders can influence native plant physiology. Read the free Plain Language Summary for this article on the Journal blog.

item.title: Global threats, local opportunities: ice‐related landforms provide refugia for high‐elevation plants and arthropods
item.abstract: Ice‐related landforms in mountain areas have been hypothesized to play a key role in the survival of cold‐adapted species threatened by climate change. However, our understanding of such landforms acting as refugia remains speculative. Here we analyse occurrence data, collected through a standardized sampling at 471 sampling points across the European Alps in relation to landform type and other environmental predictors, to identify the drivers of local presence for 209 high‐elevation plant and arthropod species. Forty‐three species show a negative response to temperature; the occurrence of debris‐covered glaciers and rock glaciers weakens the negative relationship with temperature of nine of them (21%). This finding highlights the role of ice‐related landforms for the survival of an important fraction of species threatened by climate change, although their role is taxon‐related, being maximum for carabid beetles and not observed for spiders. Fine‐scale landscape heterogeneity therefore plays a key role in mediating species responses to climate change. By integrating ecological and geographic perspectives, this study provides a framework for identifying refugia and assessing their biodiversity to target conservation measures for mountain areas worldwide.
authors: Mauro Gobbi, Barbara Valle, Mattia Brambilla, Duccio Tampucci, Marco Caccianiga

score.title: Latitudinal effect on the structure of snake–prey interaction networks is mediated by snake species richness
score.summary: [背景] 尽管近年来食物网研究增多，但对蛇类等陆生脊椎动物在广阔环境梯度下的营养网络结构仍认识不足。蛇类分布广泛、食性多样，是连接不同生态系统的关键捕食者。现有工作缺乏对其大尺度营养格局的整合。[方法] 该研究搜集了46个全球分布的蛇-猎物互作网络，采用路径分析检验纬度对网络结构的影响，并量化了蛇类丰富度、分类差异度和体重在当地群落尺度上的中介作用。[发现] 1) 总体上，蛇-猎物网络中等连接、嵌套且非模块化；2) 蛇类丰富度和体重变异与纬度负相关；3) 丰富度与连接度和特化度负相关，但与嵌套度正相关；4) 热带网络中蛇类多样性高、体型变异大，但每个物种的平均互作连接更少，特化和泛化种间的生态位重叠更高；5) 蛙类、蜥蜴、鸣禽和小型哺乳动物是所有网络中最常被取食的猎物类群。[贡献] 揭示了纬度通过蛇类丰富度间接调节网络结构，且网络模式在全球尺度上相对保守，为理解蛇类群落的稳定性提供了框架。[局限] 分析仅基于已发表的食性记录，可能忽略局地未被记录的关系；未考虑系统发育信号；路径分析未纳入环境异质性等其它潜在因子。[精读] 方法上，路径分析的因果假设设定与结果解读值得关注，讨论中关于热带与温带网络差异的机制解释可深入参考。

item.title: Latitudinal effect on the structure of snake–prey interaction networks is mediated by snake species richness
item.abstract: Despite the growing number of studies on trophic networks in recent decades, there are still important gaps in our understanding of how these networks are structured across broad environmental gradients. These gaps are even greater in some groups of terrestrial vertebrates, such as snakes, requiring a cohesive synthesis of their broader trophic interaction patterns. Snakes are widely distributed and inhabit diverse environments, being important predators of terrestrial, aquatic, fossorial, and even marine fauna. Their prey varies widely taxonomically and in body size, and their diets range from highly specialized to highly generalized. Here, we evaluate how latitude affects the structure of 46 broadly distributed snake–prey networks, through factors acting at the local community scale (snake species richness, taxonomic distinctness, and body mass) using path analysis. We expected that the greater snake richness in the tropics would favor specialization, resulting in less connected, more specialized, more nested, and more modular networks compared to those in temperate regions. We also investigated the differential importance of prey groups in the structure of snake communities. Our results showed that, generally, snake–prey networks were moderately connected, nested, and non‐modular. Snake richness and body mass variance were negatively associated with latitude, and richness was also negatively related to connectance and specialization, but positively related to nestedness. Networks in tropical regions comprised greater richness and body size variation among the snakes but also exhibited proportionally fewer interactions per species (i.e. lower connectance) and greater niche overlap among specialist and generalist snakes. Anurans, lizards, songbirds, and small mammals were the most consumed prey in all networks. Our results indicate that despite the great variation in snake richness and resource use, network patterns were generally consistent, suggesting that latitude exerted an indirect effect on the structure of snake–prey networks, which could represent stable community components worldwide.
authors: Daniela Pinto‐Coelho, Kate P. Maia, Laura R. V. Alencar, Marcio Martins, Paulo R. Guimarães
item.summary: [背景] 尽管近年来食物网研究增多，但对蛇类等陆生脊椎动物在广阔环境梯度下的营养网络结构仍认识不足。蛇类分布广泛、食性多样，是连接不同生态系统的关键捕食者。现有工作缺乏对其大尺度营养格局的整合。[方法] 该研究搜集了46个全球分布的蛇-猎物互作网络，采用路径分析检验纬度对网络结构的影响，并量化了蛇类丰富度、分类差异度和体重在当地群落尺度上的中介作用。[发现] 1) 总体上，蛇-猎物网络中等连接、嵌套且非模块化；2) 蛇类丰富度和体重变异与纬度负相关；3) 丰富度与连接度和特化度负相关，但与嵌套度正相关；4) 热带网络中蛇类多样性高、体型变异大，但每个物种的平均互作连接更少，特化和泛化种间的生态位重叠更高；5) 蛙类、蜥蜴、鸣禽和小型哺乳动物是所有网络中最常被取食的猎物类群。[贡献] 揭示了纬度通过蛇类丰富度间接调节网络结构，且网络模式在全球尺度上相对保守，为理解蛇类群落的稳定性提供了框架。[局限] 分析仅基于已发表的食性记录，可能忽略局地未被记录的关系；未考虑系统发育信号；路径分析未纳入环境异质性等其它潜在因子。[精读] 方法上，路径分析的因果假设设定与结果解读值得关注，讨论中关于热带与温带网络差异的机制解释可深入参考。

score.title: Climate‐driven resource availability drives medium‐ and broad‐scale temporal changes in owl–prey interactions over 24 years in a semi‐arid ecosystem
score.summary: [背景] 气候变化可能破坏捕食者-猎物互作，影响生态系统功能。在半干旱生态系统中，降水波动导致的资源可用性变化可能迫使猫头鹰调整食性，但不同时间尺度（季节、ENSO、长期趋势）的响应尚不清楚。本研究利用智利Bosque Fray Jorge国家公园24年的猫头鹰食团数据，探究气候变化对三种猫头鹰食物网结构的多尺度影响。 [方法] 收集1990-2015年间229次月度调查的16,932个食团，记录小型哺乳动物猎物组成；结合降水量、小型哺乳动物丰度和生态系统生产力数据，采用不对称特征向量图框架（AEM）分解时间序列，识别中等尺度（3.4-9.4年）和大尺度（15-24年）的生态位重叠、食性特化、营养位宽度和猎物丰富度的变化模式。 [发现] 1) 猫头鹰营养特征在中、大时间尺度上均表现出显著的时间结构，中等尺度与ENSO等气候振荡同步，大尺度与2003年后的降水和温度长期下降趋势吻合；2) 中等尺度上，低降水、低猎物丰度和低生产力导致生态位重叠降低、营养位宽度变窄，支持资源匮乏时的食性特化假说；3) 大尺度上，2003年后生态位重叠下降同时伴随猎物丰富度增加，表明猫头鹰可能整合了先前未利用的猎物种类，机制更复杂；4) 温度而非资源变量是驱动大尺度猎物丰富度变化的主要因素。 [贡献] 首次在单一系统中长时间尺度上揭示气候-资源-捕食者互作的多尺度响应，强调温度在食物网重组中的独立作用，为气候变化下的群落动态预测提供依据。 [局限] 研究限于单一半干旱地点，食团分析仅反映捕食事件，无法区分猎物可及性与偏好；未考虑猫头鹰种群动态和种间竞争细节。 [精读] 值得阅读其时间尺度分解方法和多尺度统计框架，但直接应用于干热河谷植物入侵或火动态的迁移性较低。

item.title: Climate‐driven resource availability drives medium‐ and broad‐scale temporal changes in owl–prey interactions over 24 years in a semi‐arid ecosystem
item.abstract: Predator–prey interactions are vital to ecosystem functioning but may be disrupted by climate change. We investigated a food‐web network involving three owl species over 24 years in a semi‐arid ecosystem at Bosque Fray Jorge National Park, Chile. We hypothesized that years of low precipitation cause resource scarcity, prompting dietary niche partitioning by owls via diet specialization or differential diversification. Because climate varies across multiple temporal scales (seasonal variability, medium‐scale changes influenced by El Niño–Southern Oscillation cycles, and long‐term shifts associated with climate change), we expected food‐web characteristics to exhibit matching multi‐scale temporal structure. Using 16 932 owl pellets collected over 229 monthly surveys between 1990 and 2015 and analyzed with an asymmetric eigenvector map framework, we assessed temporal patterns in niche partitioning, diet specialization, trophic niche breadth, and prey richness across time scales to evaluate climatic and biotic drivers. Owl trophic characteristics exhibited significant temporal structure at medium (3.4–9.4 years) and long (15–24 years) timescales, the former aligning with climatic oscillations and the latter with decadal shifts. Consistent with the prediction that resource scarcity promotes diet specialization, decreases in precipitation, small‐mammal abundance, and ecosystem productivity led to reduced niche overlap and narrower niche breadth at medium scales. At the larger scales, a major shift after 2003 coincided with declines in both precipitation and temperature. Detected changes were also consistent with niche theory but suggest more complex mechanisms at play at this timescale, since decreases in niche overlap were associated not only with diet specialization but also with increases in overall prey richness, indicating the incorporation of unused prey species. Temperature was the strongest driver of large‐scale structure in prey richness, exceeding resource‐based variables. Together, our results highlight the complex interplay between climatic factors and resource availability in shaping owl–prey networks, and underscore their fragility under ongoing climate change.

pre.oneLine: 研究通过空间显式状态转变模型评估火烧、地形、气候及非本地物种对温带湿性森林“火陷阱”动态的影响。

score.title: Regeneration failure, fire, topography, and climate interact to drive temperate wet forest landscapes into fire traps
score.summary: [背景] 当早期演替植被比老龄林更易燃时，火与植被的正反馈可将森林景观推入“火陷阱”，即火烧促进更多火烧。气候变化增加易燃性、非本地易燃植物入侵以及食草或传播限制导致的更新减缓均会放大这种反馈。前期新西兰研究显示火、种子/幼苗捕食和食草作用可驱动森林向易燃早期植被占优的状态转变，但地形和气候的交互影响尚不明确。[方法] 本研究构建空间显式状态转变模型，评估地形（沟谷作为老龄植被避难所）、气候、非本地哺乳动物食草及非本地植物入侵对演替速率和火陷阱风险的综合影响。模型纳入空间异质性，模拟不同火烧频次、更新障碍和外来种占比下的景观动态。[发现] 1) 仅增加火频率即可将景观推入火陷阱，但非本地哺乳动物通过减缓更新、延长早期高易燃阶段显著放大该效应；2) 频繁火情有利于易燃、适应火的非本地木本物种，其存在进一步强化火-植被正反馈；3) 沟谷地形提供避难所，延缓老林丧失，但扩散限制和周边景观基质可削弱其缓冲作用；4) 火体制与景观背景（如周围斑块类型）的交互会增强反馈动态，增加恢复难度。[贡献] 首次系统量化地形异质性和食草动物对火陷阱的调控，揭示了多种压力源协同作用加速景观状态突变的机制，并为温带湿润森林管理提供了基于过程的模拟框架。[局限] 模型参数基于新西兰暖温带雨林特定系统，向其他生态区域推广需谨慎；未考虑气候变化情景的动态演进，且食草动物作用仅聚焦哺乳动物。[精读] 该模型的空间显式结构和参数设定可用于借鉴，以构建干热河谷火-入侵-食草反馈的模拟研究。
score.oneLine: 本研究通过空间显式状态转变模型探讨了森林更新失败、火干扰、地形和气候以及外来物种如何通过正反馈驱动温带湿润森林进入火陷阱，属于生态建模与景观生态学领域的模拟研究。
score.reason: 研究火、地形与食草动物交互驱动森林火陷阱的机制，与当前干热河谷植物入侵-野火反馈和火-食草动物-地形互作的核心任务高度相关，虽生态系统类型不同，但过程机制和模型方法具有直接参考价值。

item.title: Regeneration failure, fire, topography, and climate interact to drive temperate wet forest landscapes into fire traps
item.abstract: Where early successional forests are more flammable than old‐growth forests, forested landscapes are vulnerable to shifting into ‘fire traps' through positive feedbacks, where fire leads to more fire. These feedbacks are amplified by increased flammability driven by climate change, the presence of non‐native flammable plant species, and slowed regeneration due to herbivory or dispersal limitation. In simulated landscapes with topographic variation, gullies act as refugia for older vegetation, modifying successional trajectories. Previous studies in Aotearoa–New Zealand have shown that fire, seed and seedling predation, and herbivory can interact to drive warm‐temperate forest landscapes toward states dominated by flammable, early‐successional vegetation (fire traps). We build on those previous studies, using a spatially explicit state‐and‐transition model to evaluate how topography and climate affect succession rates and the risk that landscapes could become fire traps. We also used the model to evaluate whether and how interactions among topography, climate, non‐native mammalian herbivores, and non‐native plants influenced the rate of succession. Although increased fire frequency was sufficient to drive landscapes into fire traps, non‐native mammals intensified these effects by slowing regeneration and prolonging the period that vegetation remained in a high flammability, early successional state. Invasion by flammable, fire‐adapted non‐native woody species was favoured by frequent fire, and their presence further amplified positive fire–vegetation interactions. Interactions between fire regime and landscape context, such as the nature of the surrounding landscape mosaic, can further intensify these feedback dynamics. Ecosystem changes that are driven and reinforced by positive feedback dynamics challenge restoration efforts. Minimising the risk of warm temperate rainforest landscapes tipping into fire traps will require managing them through vulnerable flammable early successional communities as quickly as possible by 1) suppressing fire during this period and 2) minimising the effects of stressors that impede regeneration.

item.title: Synergistic mechanisms foster declines in native fish community stability following the introduction of non‐native species
item.abstract: Non‐native species introductions profoundly alter freshwater communities, yet the mechanisms by which non‐native fishes affect native community stability remain unclear. Using a multi‐decadal dataset on fish community composition and abundance collected across France, we quantified native community stability and decomposed this metric into its main constituents: population variability and synchrony. We examined how non‐native fish richness, eco‐evolutionary features of non‐native and native fishes, and environmental gradients influence the two components of community stability. Our results revealed that increased non‐native richness elevated population variability by expanding interspecific functional trait divergence and through persistent disruptive effects on native species resulting from intensified interspecific competition. At the same time, the presence of non‐native species amplified temporal synchrony through a contraction in phylogenetic distances of resident communities. Population variability was further regulated by environmental gradients, whereas synchrony was unrelated to the environmental template. In summary, declines in community stability associated with non‐native fishes' stem from the synergistic interplay of multiple mechanisms: increased richness of non‐native fish species fostered a functional reorganization of native communities that amplified population fluctuations, whereas reduced interspecific phylogenetic distances enhanced temporal synchrony, with environmental gradients exerting additional modulation on these relationships. The study highlights that non‐native fishes undermine freshwater community stability through interacting functional, phylogenetic and environmental mechanisms, providing insights for addressing biodiversity changes associated with the establishment and spread of non‐native species.
authors: Chengzong Tian, Mengzhen Xu, Congcong Wang, Wei Xin, Xiongdong Zhou, Jorge García‐Girón

score.title: Global Quantification of the Ecological Footprint of Freshwater Fish Invasions
score.summary: [背景] 淡水生态系统是全球受威胁最严重的生态系统之一，外来鱼类入侵通过捕食、竞争和生境改变等多途径影响多营养级群落，但其影响规模、途径及与入侵者食性的关系尚缺乏统一的全球量化。[方法] 该研究整合了149项已发表研究、1055个入侵案例，采用多水平混合效应荟萃分析方法，评估了入侵鱼类对鱼类、两栖类、大型无脊椎动物、水生植物、浮游动物、浮游植物和附生藻类等七个功能类群的影响，并区分了杂食性鲤科鱼类和肉食性鲑科鱼类的效应差异。[发现] 1) 入侵鱼类普遍降低本地鱼类、两栖类和大型无脊椎动物的丰度与多样性，同时通过资源竞争和生境改变减少水生植物和浮游动物；2) 入侵鱼类引发的营养级联效应和生物扰动可刺激浮游植物和附生藻类增殖，驱替生态系统越过阈值向浑浊、富营养化的替代稳定态转变；3) 杂食性入侵者常作为生态系统工程师产生广泛的生态系统级效应，而肉食性入侵者主要通过下行控制改变群落结构。[贡献] 该研究首次在全球尺度上建立了入侵鱼类食性、多营养级响应与淡水生态系统稳态转换之间的机制联系，为预测和管理淡水入侵风险提供了量化框架。[局限] 纳入研究存在地理和分类群覆盖偏倚，未充分考量非生物环境背景的调节作用，且个别营养级的数据量较少。[精读] 值得精读其荟萃分析方法和效应量计算细节，以及讨论部分关于营养级联与稳态转换的推演逻辑。

item.title: Global Quantification of the Ecological Footprint of Freshwater Fish Invasions
item.abstract: ABSTRACT Aim Biological invasions are widely recognised as a major driver of global change, yet their mechanisms and impacts remain unevenly quantified across ecosystem dimensions. Freshwater ecosystems, among the most threatened worldwide, offer a critical arena to test invasion theory, from Elton's hypothesis on biotic resistance to contemporary models of trophic cascades and ecosystem regime shifts. Here, we aim to quantify the global impacts of invasive freshwater fish on biodiversity and ecosystem functioning across multiple trophic levels and to identify patterns related to invader feeding strategy and ecosystem sensitivity. Location Global; freshwater ecosystems worldwide. Time Period 1986–2024. Major Taxa Studied Freshwater fish, amphibians, macroinvertebrates, macrophytes, zooplankton, phytoplankton and periphyton. Methods Synthesis of 149 published studies encompassing 1055 invasion cases. A multi‐level mixed‐effects meta‐analysis was used to assess invasion impacts across seven aquatic functional groups, accounting for cross‐trophic interactions and invader feeding strategy. Results We show that invasive fish consistently depress abundance and diversity of native fish, amphibians and macroinvertebrates, while reducing macrophytes and zooplankton through resource competition and habitat alteration. In parallel, invasive species can trigger trophic cascades and bioturbation processes that stimulate phytoplankton and periphyton proliferation, pushing ecosystems across ecological thresholds towards alternative turbid and eutrophic stable states. Impacts pathways differ according to invader feeding strategy: omnivorous cyprinids often function as ecosystem engineers with broad ecosystem‐level effects, whereas carnivorous salmonids primarily alter communities through top‐down suppression. Main Conclusions By identifying taxa that respond consistently to fish invasions across trophic levels (fish, amphibians, macroinvertebrates, macrophytes) and by highlighting omnivorous and carnivorous invaders as key drivers of ecosystem restructuring, our findings link invasion dynamics to predictable freshwater regime shifts. This study provides a mechanistic framework linking invasion ecology, trophic cascades and ecosystem transitions, with important implications for biodiversity conservation and ecological restoration under accelerating global change.
authors: Bo Yang, Rodolphe E. Gozlan, Yushun Chen

score.title: Community Assembly Processes Change With Location and Environmental Distinctiveness in River Networks
score.summary: [背景] 在河流网络中，生物扩散与环境选择驱动群落组装，但以往研究多将整个集合群落视为同质，忽略位点间过程重要性的差异。该研究首次对河流附着藻类进行位点特异性分析，探讨空间连接与环境条件如何影响局部组装过程。[方法] 研究选取肯尼亚Mara、瑞士Thur和阿尔巴尼亚/希腊Vjosa三个河流网络，于2018-2019年进行五次野外采样，获得高分类分辨率的分子生物学数据。利用联合物种分布模型，从空间和环境变量对群落组成的影响推断各采样点分散与环境选择的相对重要性，并使用广义加性模型揭示这些过程随集水面积和环境独特性变化的趋势。[发现] 主要发现包括：1) 环境选择在中等大小溪流及环境条件独特的位点作用最强；2) 分散在连接良好的大河中最重要，可能与质量效应有关；3) 在Thur河的空间隔离源头，检测到分散限制迹象；4) 三个河流网络中均呈现组装过程随河网位置和环境独特性系统变化，环境选择主导的位点群落与环境条件紧密关联。[贡献] 该研究突破了传统均值化视角，首次在位点水平上量化了河流网络群落组装过程的异质性，为理解河流生物多样性维持和生态系统功能提供了新见解，并有助于识别保护关键区。[局限] 研究对象限于附着藻类，外推到其他类群需谨慎；虽然涵盖三个地理区域，但结论的普遍性有待更多河流网络验证。[精读] 该文的方法学（位点特异性群落模型）值得参考，但主题与当前核心任务关联极弱，可在积累生态学理论时浏览。

item.title: Community Assembly Processes Change With Location and Environmental Distinctiveness in River Networks
item.abstract: ABSTRACT Aim Organisms disperse in space, thereby connecting local communities to metacommunities. Dispersal and environmental selection are two community assembly processes ultimately driving biodiversity and potentially scaling to ecosystem functioning. So far, these processes have mainly been generalized to entire metacommunities, ignoring their variability among constituent sites. This limits our understanding of community assembly in river networks, where unidirectional water flow connects, but also isolates, environmentally heterogeneous sites across the network from headwaters to large rivers. For the first time, we aimed at a site‐specific description of periphyton community assembly processes to investigate how the relative importance of dispersal and environmental selection at the local scale relates to spatial connection among sites and their environmental conditions. Location Three river networks: The Mara (Kenya), the Thur (Switzerland) and the Vjosa (Albania and Greece). Time Period We collected data during five field campaigns from January 2018 to October 2019. Major Taxa Studied Algae attached to streambed sediments (periphyton). Methods We fitted joint species distribution models to taxonomically highly resolved molecular biological datasets. We inferred the site‐specific importance of dispersal and environmental selection from effects of spatial and environmental variables on community composition. We then used generalized additive models to reveal shifts in the relative importance of assembly processes along catchment area and environmental distinctiveness. Results Environmental selection was particularly important in midsized streams and at sites with more distinct environmental conditions. Dispersal developed the greatest role in large rivers—possibly due to mass effects in well‐connected large rivers. We also found indication for dispersal limitation to affect spatially isolated headwaters in the Thur. Main Conclusions We revealed a systematic shift in assembly processes along river size and with environmental distinctiveness across all three river networks, advancing understanding and generalization of assembly processes within river networks. Sites with environmental selection result in communities that are closely linked to prevailing environmental conditions, which can enhance ecosystem functioning. The ability to identify such sites could improve biodiversity conservation and help maintain ecosystem functioning.
authors: Thomas Fuß, Lukas Thuile Bistarelli, Lauren Talluto, Rubén del Campo, Florian Altermatt, Frank O. Masese, Gabriel Singer

score.title: Defaunation Maps for Tropical Mammals and Birds
score.summary: [背景] 过度捕猎是热带生态系统动物群减少的重要驱动力，但传统方法难以量化其物种水平的影响和空间分布。现有模型仅在群落尺度识别热点，缺乏物种特异性空间预测，限制了全面的生物多样性评估。 [方法] 本研究汇编了1980–2025年全球已发表的狩猎区与未狩猎区配对丰度数据，结合环境预测因子，为3680种鸟类和1312种哺乳动物生成了1公里分辨率的去动物化指数栅格地图，并提供原始丰度数据集。 [发现] 1) 首次在泛热带尺度上实现了单个物种的去动物化空间预测，揭示了物种间对狩猎压力的响应异质性；2) 地图可用于定位受威胁最严重的区域和物种，支持保护优先级划分；3) 数据揭示了狩猎压力与物种功能性状之间的潜在关系。 [贡献] 填补了全球生物多样性评估中物种级去动物化空间数据的空白，为研究者和决策者提供了精细化的评估工具。 [局限] 数据依赖已发表的配对研究，可能隐藏空间采样偏差；模型假设狩猎压力关系恒定，未考虑未来土地利用或气候变化；地图代表2020年状况，亟需更新。 [精读] 该数据集对从事生物多样性空间风险评估和保护规划的学者有参考价值，但因其主题与用户核心研究任务（光伏入侵、野火反馈等）关联度低，仅作为空间方法参考，可选择性阅读。

item.title: Defaunation Maps for Tropical Mammals and Birds
item.abstract: ABSTRACT Motivation Overhunting is a major driver of defaunation in tropical ecosystems, yet its impacts and spatial extent remain challenging to quantify through conventional remote sensing approaches. Novel modelling frameworks based on quantitative relationships between impacts on wildlife populations and the main drivers of hunting pressure have provided a mean to identify hotspots of defaunation for avian and mammalian communities at a pantropical scale. However, the absence of spatially explicit predictions of hunting impacts at the species level hinders comprehensive assessments of biodiversity loss. Here, we present species‐specific defaunation raster maps for 4992 birds and mammals. Main Types of Variables Contained Raw abundance datasets reporting paired abundance estimates in hunted and unhunted areas, year and location of data collection, reference of the original study, taxonomic information, and predictor variables. Defaunation index maps in raster format at 1 km × 1 km resolution for 3680 species of birds and 1312 species of mammals. Spatial Location Pantropical. Time Period and Grain 1980–2025 for the abundance estimates, 2020 for the defaunation rasters. Major Taxa and Level of Measurement Tropical bird and mammal species. Software Format One dataset in csv format with raw abundance estimates from local studies, 4992 raster files in tif format with defaunation values per grid cell.

item.title: Macroecology of Microbial Performance Across Earth's Biomes
item.abstract: ABSTRACT Aim A central goal of global ecology is to determine whether widespread spatial distribution reflects broad ecological performance. For microorganisms, this remains unresolved because occurrence and performance are rarely evaluated together across biomes. Here, we examine how global distribution and ecological performance are linked across Earth's biomes. Location Global. Major Taxa Studied Bacteria and archaea. Methods We analysed 576,531 publicly available microbial communities spanning 24 biomes across host‐associated and free‐living systems worldwide. We developed the Baas‐Becking score (BB‐score), a taxon‐level metric that combines occupancy and relative abundance while penalising absences to quantify relative taxa performance within biomes. Here, the BB‐score was applied to data of OTUs with 99% identity cut‐off. We then used network analysis to measure biome connectivity based on similarities in their top‐performing microbial subcommunities. Results Approximately 64% of microbial taxa occurred in both host‐associated and free‐living biomes, indicating that ecological flexibility across this major lifestyle boundary is common. Biome specialisation was rare, with the highest biome‐restricted taxa found in saline biomes. Most microbial taxa emerged as high performers in only a few biomes. By contrast, only a small set of taxa repeatedly ranked among the top performers across many biomes, revealing a strong decoupling between widespread occurrence and high performance. Network analysis of shared high‐performing taxa further identified the atmosphere, phyllosphere and freshwater as the main hubs linking Earth's ecosystems. Main Conclusions Widespread occurrence does not necessarily indicate high ecological performance in microbes. Instead, global microbial biogeography reflects the combined effects of dispersal and biome‐specific performance, with biome connectivity structured by shared high‐performing taxa and a small set of hub biomes.

score.title: Increased Atmospheric CO2 Adversely Affects Large Pollinators, but Benefits Small Pollinators
score.summary: [背景] 大气CO₂浓度持续上升可能通过改变植物资源或直接生理影响传粉昆虫，但体大小依赖的响应机制尚不明确。现有研究多集中于温度或土地利用变化，缺乏对CO₂本身、尤其是其体型特异性效应的野外实证。[方法] 在巴基斯坦Pothwar高原海拔350–2291 m的5个地区随机选取25个样点，2018年9月至2022年5月（不含12–1月）以50 m样线法每周监测传粉昆虫丰度与多样性。用Temtop M2000数字仪在1 m高度测量CO₂浓度。按体长将蜂类（≥15 mm）、蝇类（≥10 mm）划分为大体型组。采用广义线性混合模型（GLMM）分析传粉昆虫数量、CO₂浓度及其他非生物因子的关系。[发现] 1) 大体型传粉昆虫的丰度和多样性随CO₂浓度升高显著下降，而小体型传粉昆虫则呈正向关联；2) 这种体型依赖性在不同样点间表现一致，CO₂是可靠的预测变量；3) 推测大体型昆虫更高的代谢耗氧需求使其对CO₂更敏感。[贡献] 首次在野外尺度上揭示大气CO₂浓度对传粉昆虫群落的体型特异性重塑效应，为气候变化对授粉网络级联影响提供新的经验证据。[局限] 研究区域局限于单一高原，未控制其他共同变化因子（如植被组成、土地利用）的潜在混淆效应；仅关注CO₂浓度，未综合评估与其他气候变量（如温度）的交互作用。[精读] 方法部分GLMM的固定/随机效应设定及模型比较值得借鉴，但结论对当前核心任务无直接启发。

item.title: Increased Atmospheric CO2 Adversely Affects Large Pollinators, but Benefits Small Pollinators
item.abstract: ABSTRACT Aim This study examines the impact of atmospheric CO 2 concentration on pollinator communities, focusing on body size‐related responses. It aims to understand how natural CO 2 variability influences pollinator abundance and diversity, and to assess potential ecological consequences for pollination services and ecosystem stability. Location The study was conducted across the Pothwar Plateau in Punjab, Pakistan, covering five districts: Murree, Rawalpindi/Islamabad, Jhelum, Chakwal and Attock. Time Period Field data were collected from September 2018 to May 2022, excluding December and January when pollinator activity was low. Major Taxa Studied The study focused on insect pollinators, including bees and hoverflies, and classified them into large‐ and small‐bodied groups based on size thresholds (e.g., bees were classified as large if their body length was ≥ 15 mm, and flies were classified as large if their body length was ≥ 10 mm). Methods A total of 25 study sites were randomly selected across an elevational gradient ranging from 350 to 2291 m. Atmospheric CO 2 concentrations were measured using a Temtop M2000 2nd digital meter at a standardized height of 1 m. Pollinator abundance and diversity were monitored using a transect‐based observation method (50 m transects, four per site). Sampling was conducted weekly from September to May, excluding December and January. Pollinators were identified in the field or collected for species‐level identification in the laboratory using morphological and image‐based techniques. Body size was measured using digital callipers. Statistical analyses were performed using Generalized Linear Mixed Models (GLMMs) to evaluate the relationship between pollinator populations, atmospheric CO 2 levels and other abiotic factors, while accounting for body size. Results A significant size‐dependent response to atmospheric CO 2 concentrations was observed. Larger‐bodied pollinators showed declines in abundance and diversity with increasing CO 2 levels, likely due to higher metabolic oxygen demands. In contrast, smaller‐bodied pollinators showed a positive association with elevated CO 2 concentrations. The relationship between CO 2 and pollinator communities remained consistent across different sites, confirming CO 2 as a reliable predictor variable. Main Conclusions Rising atmospheric CO 2 concentration could restructure pollinator communities by favouring smaller‐bodied species while negatively affecting larger‐bodied pollinators. This shift may have cascading effects on pollination networks and ecosystem stability. Conservation strategies should account for size‐specific vulnerabilities to climate‐induced CO 2 changes and prioritize protecting larger‐bodied pollinators, as they are more susceptible to CO 2 ‐related declines.
authors: Shahmshad Ahmed Khan, Muhammad Tanveer, Kit Prendergast, Taimoor Hussain, Arslan Shehryar, Asif Mehmood

score.title: Spatial and Seasonal Variation in Avian Dietary Strategies
score.summary: [背景] 食性是脊椎动物生活史的核心，影响存活、补充和适合度。鸟类食性的空间变异已有研究，但物种和集合水平的季节动态及其环境驱动仍知之甚少，阻碍了对生物多样性格局和过程的理解。该文旨在进行首次全球尺度鸟类食性空间季节性变异的评估。[方法] 整合超10000种鸟类的季节性分布与SAviTraits 1.0数据库（物种特异性食性偏好的年内变化），利用对数比率分析概括鸟类食性空间，通过主成分分析识别其季节性变异的主成分，量化物种水平食性特征的年内变异性评估其对集合水平季节性的贡献，最后采用逻辑分位数回归检验集合水平食性变异与温度、降水、总初级生产力季节性和可预测性的关联。[发现] 集合和物种水平的食性空间均存在强烈季节变异，北半球温带和寒带地区最为显著。该季节性源于两个关键过程：1) 迁徙物种的季节性再分布（占据食性空间不同区域）改变集合组成从而影响食性空间；2) 物种内食性转变。食性的时间变异在不同纬度关联不同环境驱动，北方以温度季节性为主导，南方则降水季节性影响更大。[贡献] 首次揭示全球鸟类食性维度的季节性动态及其空间异，提出将性状视为动态系统的新框架，有助于捕捉性状-环境关联的时间复杂性，为理解群落结构和保护行动提供新视角。[局限] 依赖现有数据库的食性信息精度，未纳入个体发育或年际尺度的食性变化；对热带地区季节性不显著的原因解释有限。[精读] 不推荐精读，除非对宏观食性生态学方法或性状动态框架特别感兴趣。

item.title: Spatial and Seasonal Variation in Avian Dietary Strategies
item.abstract: ABSTRACT Aim Diet is a fundamental aspect of vertebrate life history, shaping survival, recruitment, and fitness. While spatial variation in avian dietary characteristics has been studied, seasonal dynamics at species and assemblage levels remain largely unexplored, hindering our understanding of biodiversity patterns and processes. We present the first global‐scale assessment of seasonal variation in avian dietary space and its environmental drivers. Location Global. Time Period Contemporary. Major Taxa Studied Birds. Methods We integrated seasonal species distributions for over 10,000 bird species with the SAviTraits 1.0 database, a compilation of intra‐annual variation in species‐specific dietary preferences. We summarized the avian dietary space using a Log Ratio Analysis and identified the dominant components of seasonal variation in avian dietary space using a Principal Component Analysis. To assess species contributions to the seasonality of assemblage‐level dietary space, we quantified species‐level annual variability in dietary characteristics. Finally, we examined correlations of assemblage‐level dietary variability with temperature, precipitation, and GPP seasonality as well as with predictability of seasonal changes using logistic quantile regressions. Results Strong seasonal variation in dietary space exists at both assemblage and species levels, and is most pronounced in temperate and boreal regions of the Northern Hemisphere. This seasonality arises from two key processes: (1) the seasonal redistribution of migratory species, which occupy distinct regions of dietary space, alters assemblage composition and thus dietary space, and (2) within‐species dietary shifts. We also find that temporal variation in avian diets is linked to different environmental drivers across latitudes, with temperature seasonality playing a dominant role in northern regions and precipitation seasonality being more influential in southern regions. Main Conclusions Viewing species' traits as dynamic systems provides a powerful framework to capture the temporal complexity of trait‐environment associations, understand factors shaping community structure, and advance conservation efforts.

score.summary: [背景] 节肢动物被诱捕可能对植物有多种益处，但很少有研究探究其潜在代价。马利筋属植物依赖传粉者携带花粉块穿过花的狭缝完成授粉，但蜜蜂常被陷阱致死。本文通过野外实验考察死亡蜜蜂陷阱对马利筋花访花率的影响。[方法] 研究者在马利筋花上设置死亡蜜蜂处理与对照，记录访花者类型和数量，同时监测蚂蚁密度，并利用路径分析区分直接威慑效应和间接的天敌威慑效应。[发现] 1) 与对照相比，死亡蜜蜂使总访花率降低37%；2) 这种效应在蜜蜂访花者中比非蜜蜂访花者更强；3) 死亡蜜蜂处理使蚂蚁密度增加51%，蚂蚁存在本身使访花率降低30%；4) 路径分析表明直接威慑通路解释了总效应的91%，表明蜜蜂有回避同种尸体的行为。[贡献] 首次量化了马利筋陷阱对植物的生态代价，揭示了传粉者致死陷阱可能直接威慑其他传粉者，从而降低植物适合度。[局限] 实验仅在一年一地开展，未评估对结实率等适合度指标的影响，社区后果不明。[精读] 值得关注实验设计的细节和路径分析框架，可为传粉互作研究提供方法参考。

item.title: Trapped honey bees reduce floral visitation on milkweed flowers
item.abstract: Abstract Trapped arthropods have been shown to benefit plants in several ways, but few studies have examined the potential costs of arthropod entanglement. Milkweeds ( Asclepias spp.) have an unusual pollination system that requires relatively large packets of pollen (pollinia) to become attached to the appendages of insect pollinators and be pulled through a narrow opening in the flower. Honey bees ( Apis mellifera ) commonly become trapped and die with their legs still attached to milkweed flowers. In this study, we conducted a field experiment to examine how dead trapped honey bees affect floral visitation. We expected that the presence of a dead trapped bee would reduce floral visitation via two non‐mutually exclusive pathways: (1) a direct deterrent effect on floral visitors and (2) an indirect deterrent effect mediated by an increased abundance of scavenging predators such as ants. The presence of a dead bee reduced floral visitation by 37% compared with controls, and this effect was stronger and more robust for honey bee visitors than non‐ Apis visitors. While ant densities were 51% higher on floral umbels with a dead bee and ants reduced floral visitation by 30%, our path analysis indicated that the direct deterrent pathway explained 91% of the total effect, consistent with an aversion to dead conspecifics among honey bees. Our results suggest that the lethal entanglement of honey bees is likely to incur an ecological cost for milkweed flowers, although the deterrence of honey bees could also shift the pollinator communities on milkweeds with unexpected consequences.
authors: Ian D. Jett, Louie H. Yang

score.title: A salinity gradient mediates plant diversity–function–stability relationships across a coastal marsh landscape
score.summary: [背景] 生态系统功能和稳定性在实验中常与物种丰富度正相关，但在自然界中，非生物梯度可能掩盖或改变丰富度的影响。现有研究多关注平均环境条件，对非生物条件变异性（如盐度波动）的作用认识不足。[方法] 该研究在美国乔治亚州沿海盐沼的七个植物群落中，利用25年年度生物量数据，分析了盐度梯度（平均盐度及年内高潮盐度范围）、植物多样性、生物量生产功能及其稳定性之间的关系。[发现] 1) 与预期相反，植物生物量及其稳定性均与物种丰富度无显著相关。2) 植物丰富度与年内高潮盐度范围呈正相关，并在中等平均盐度时达到峰值。3) 生物量稳定性随平均盐度升高而下降，但与盐度范围无关。4) 低丰富度站点的稳定性由优势种主导，而中等盐度、高多样性站点的稳定性可能源于物种异步性。[贡献] 强调研究环境变异性（而非仅均值）的重要性，揭示自然系统中多样性与稳定性的关系可能被环境梯度所掩盖，挑战了多样性-稳定性普遍正相关的观点。[局限] 结果来自单一河口梯度，普适性需验证；异步性机制仅为间接推断；未考虑其他长期环境变化干扰。[精读] 方法部分的时间序列分析值得参考，但对当前课题的直接启发有限，可不精读。

item.title: A salinity gradient mediates plant diversity–function–stability relationships across a coastal marsh landscape
item.abstract: Abstract Ecosystem function and stability are often positively related to species richness in experiments, but in nature, abiotic gradients may over‐ride or obscure the effects of richness on function and stability. In addition, community stability may be driven by distinct mechanisms along diversity or abiotic gradients and exhibit different responses to differing degrees of variability in an abiotic condition. We explored relationships between salinity, plant diversity, ecosystem function (annual biomass production), and stability of biomass over 25 years for seven coastal marsh plant communities arranged across an estuarine salinity gradient in Georgia, USA. In contrast to expectations, neither plant biomass nor its stability was related to species richness. Plant richness was positively correlated to within‐year high tide salinity range and peaked at intermediate values of mean salinity. Biomass stability was negatively correlated with mean salinity but was unrelated to salinity range. Stability was driven by dominant species at sites with low richness, but asynchrony likely contributes to stability at intermediate salinity sites with higher diversity. Our results illustrate the importance of studying variability in abiotic conditions in addition to their mean and demonstrate that stability and richness may not necessarily be correlated in nature due to underlying abiotic gradients affecting both.
authors: Robert P. Dunn, Steven C. Pennings

score.title: Fuzzy relationships among plant dispersal mechanisms, syndromes, and animal vectors
score.summary: [背景] 种子传播是理解植物群落生态与进化的关键，但既往研究多聚焦单一动物类群或传播机制，缺乏跨类群、跨机制的大尺度整合认识。[方法] 本研究利用覆盖欧洲的大规模种子传播互作数据集，包含447种动物与1901种植物通过四种传播机制（内携、外携、动物主动搬运、蚁传）形成的互作记录，通过互作网络分析量化不同动物类群和传播机制的相对重要性，并检验基于果实性状的传播综合征对实际传播机制的预测能力。[发现] 1）鸟类和哺乳动物的内携传播占所有互作记录的90%；2）哺乳动物物种支持的植物种类更多，但鸟类多样性高，更多植物依赖鸟类的累积服务；3）肉质果植物仅占动物传播植物的15%，但动物伙伴更多，且被选择特异性更强；4）不同动物类群倾向使用不同传播机制，外携传播几乎仅由哺乳动物完成；5）基于散布体性状分配的传播综合征仅中等程度预测实际传播机制，动物传播的植物种类远超性状推断，包括缺乏明显特征的植物。[贡献] 提供了跨类群、跨机制的整合证据，揭示种子传播互作网络的复杂性和传播综合征预测的局限性，强调互补性传播服务的重要性。[局限] 数据限于欧洲，未考虑其他生物地理区；互作记录可能存在采样偏差；未探讨传播对植物种群动态的功能后果。[精读] 值得精读方法部分的数据整合与网络分析框架，以及传播综合征预测能力的定量评估结果。
score.oneLine: 该研究通过欧洲多类群种子传播数据集，综合分析植物种子传播机制与动物类群的关系，揭示传播综合征的预测能力有限，为种子传播生态学提供新见解。
score.reason: 该研究属于种子传播与动物互作的基础生态学，提供跨类群数据集和分析方法，对理解植物扩散具有普遍参考价值，但与当前光伏入侵、干热河谷野火等核心课题直接关联较弱，作为泛生态过程支撑打分50。

item.title: Fuzzy relationships among plant dispersal mechanisms, syndromes, and animal vectors
item.abstract: Abstract Knowledge of which animal clades and dispersal mechanisms contribute to seed dispersal is critical for understanding the ecology and evolution of plant communities. However, a broad understanding is limited by a focus on single clades and mechanisms. Here, we analyzed a Europe‐wide multi‐clade seed dispersal dataset with interactions among 447 animal species and 1901 plant species via four dispersal mechanisms: endozoochory (ingestion followed by egestion), epizoochory (external attachment), synzoochory (actively carried by vertebrates), and myrmecochory (dispersal by ants). We aimed to (1) characterize the relative importance of animal dispersal clades and biotic dispersal mechanisms; (2) evaluate links among clades and mechanisms; (3) compare dispersal of dry‐ and fleshy‐fruited diaspores; and (4) evaluate the predictive power of seed dispersal syndromes with empirical data on observed dispersal mechanisms. This revealed that endozoochory by birds and mammals encompasses 90% of plant–animal interaction records. Mammal species tend to have more plants depending upon their dispersal services; however, due to the larger diversity of bird species, more plants depend upon the cumulative services of birds (followed by mammals, insects, and reptiles). Plants with fleshy fruits comprise only 15% of all plant species dispersed by animals but had more animal partners per plant species than plants with dry fruits. Fleshy‐fruited plant species were more specifically selected by dispersers, while selection of dry‐fruited plants depended more on their relative abundance. Different animal clades tend to disperse plant species via different mechanisms. Endozoochory is the most recorded interaction for birds, mammals, and reptiles. Epizoochory is almost exclusively carried out by mammals, with a negligible role of birds, insects, and reptiles. Synzoochory is performed chiefly by ants (via myrmecochory), followed by birds and then mammals. Predicting vector importance by assigning dispersal syndromes based on diaspore traits (including endozoochorous, epizoochorous, synzoochorous, and myrmecochorous syndromes) only moderately predicted empirically observed dispersal mechanisms. Animals disperse many more species than inferred from diaspore traits, including plants with abiotic syndromes and plants without clearly visible morphological traits. Our results suggest that different animal clades perform complementary dispersal services via multiple mechanisms to plant species with fleshy as well as dry fruits.
authors: Casper H. A. van Leeuwen, Ruben Heleno, Andy J. Green, Esther Sebastián‐González, José Miguel Costa, Christophe Baltzinger, Evan Fricke, Ádám Lovas‐Kiss, Irene Castañeda, Isabel Donoso, Alistair G. Auffret, Sara B. Mendes

item.title: Species interactions shape the thermal performance curve and distribution of tropical Drosophila species
item.abstract: Abstract Decades of research have demonstrated the importance of temperature in dictating species distributional limits. We know species interactions also play a key role, but we lack a predictive framework for understanding when and where species interactions will be more important than temperature in shaping distributional limits. In the current study, we determine how species interactions impact thermal performance for egg‐to‐adult viability (as a proxy for fitness), a commonly used method for predicting climate change vulnerability. We do so by contrasting thermal performance curves (TPCs) with and without species interactions in six species of Drosophila (three tropical and three subtropical species) across a range of temperatures (16–30°C). We found that thermal optimum ( T OPT ) was largely insensitive to species interactions, but the presence of species interactions altered the thermal sensitivities in several species and lowered the maximum performance ( P MAX ) compared to single‐species cultures. This suggests that competition was the dominant form of species interactions rather than facilitation. While theory proposes species interactions are more important in shaping warm‐range limits (equatorial/low elevation/low latitude) but not cool‐range limits (poleward/high elevation/high latitude), we found evidence that species interactions have larger effects at the cool range of the TPC. Moreover, species that were more sensitive to species interactions (i.e., experienced the largest effect on egg‐to‐adult viability) tended to be tropical species with restricted distributions, further supporting species interactions as an essential element shaping cool‐range distributional limits. Given that species interactions can influence thermal performance and are likely to shape species range limits, integrating species interactions into predictive models will be necessary to predict how species distributions will shift under climate change.
